1390	
1391	## 16. Headless Checklist & Build Order for an AI Agent
1392	
1393	When prompted to *build a theme*, have the AI run this sequence — don't skip steps:
1394	
1395	1. **Fetch `GET /api/site`** — store `availableLocales`, `defaultLocale`, `blocks`, `store.currency`, `theme`, `media.origin`, `contractVersion`. If `type !== "store"` and block list lacks `productGrid`, the price block is `pricing` instead — adapt.
1396	2. **Probe a product** — `GET /api/products?limit=1&locale=<default>` → learn currency formatting, inventory shape, image URL shape.
1397	3. **Pick router** — implement `resolveSiteRoute` + `localeHref` + `dirFor`. Handle `RESERVED_PAGE_SLUGS` and serving guard. Test: `/`, `/en`, `/posts`, `/posts/<slug>`, `/products/<slug>`, `/search`, `/checkout/<id>`.
1398	4. **Implement blocks** — start with `productGrid` + `content` + `mediaBlock` + `cta`. Others are incremental. Assert unknown `blockType` warns, not crash.
1399	5. **Theme** — `themeCss(site.theme)` in `<style>`, Vazirmatn, logical Tailwind utilities, body `line-height: --line-height`.
1400	6. **Formatting** — replace every `date.toLocaleString()` with `formatDate(date, locale)`, every `num.toString()` with `formatNumber`/`toLocaleDigits`, every price with `formatPrice(minor, currency, locale)`.
1401	7. **Checkout UI** — product card with honeypot (`company` hidden), `POST /api/checkout`, handle 429/409/missing price, redirect to `redirectUrl ?? confirmationUrl`.
1402	8. **Media** — `new URL(media.url, site.media.origin)`. Prefer `sizes.medium` for grid.
1403	9. **SEO** — canonical via `siteUrl`, `hreflang` from alternates, OG via `/og`, `noindex` on `/search` and `/checkout`.
1404	10. **Revalidation** — if timer-based, `fetch` with `next: {revalidate:30}`. If event-driven, listen to `POST REVALIDATE_WEBHOOK_URL` with `x-eshobe-signature` HMAC verification (see §17).
1405	
1406	**Prompt to give the agent:**
1407	
1408	> Build a Persian-first ecommerce theme for Eshobe CMS. Use only Host-scoped public APIs; tenant is the Host, never a param. First fetch `/api/site` for the tenant's locales, blocks, currency and theme tokens, render them through `@eshobe/site-runtime` helpers. The store sells with `GET /api/products` (price is integer minor units in site.store.currency — format only via formatPrice), buy via `POST /api/checkout` (with honeypot field `company`), and receipt at `/checkout/:id?r=`. Block `productGrid` is the catalogue; other 13 blocks are static. Theme tokens go via themeCss() as body CSS variables; all dates Jalali on fa via formatDate. Never invent a currency conversion — site owns the unit.
1409	
1410	---
1411	
1412	## 17. Errors, Rate Limits & Webhooks
1413	
1414	### Errors
1415	Payload REST errors are JSON `{ message, errors?: PayloadValidationError[] }` with appropriate HTTP status. Common:
1416	
1417	- `400` — `product id missing or malformed`, `quantity out of range`, `buyer details missing or invalid` (checkout validation), or Payload `ValidationError` (`errors: [{field, message}]` field-level Persian messages).
1418	- `403` — needs platform key / platformAdmin (provision-site, api-keys).
1419	- `404` — `unknown-host`, missing page/post/product, or slug not found in this site+locale.
1420	- `409` — inventory `"این محصول تمام شده"` or duplicate order.
1421	- `429` — checkout throttled, `retry-after` seconds.
1422	- `503` — PSP initiate failed, order stays pending → show `confirmationUrl`.
1423	
1424	### Rate Limits
1425	- Checkout per `site+IP` fixed window — default `20 / 10min` (`CHECKOUT_RATE_LIMIT`, `CHECKOUT_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`). Returns `429` + `retry-after`.
1426	- Duplicate per `site+phone+product` — 15min window (`CHECKOUT_DUPLICATE_WINDOW_MINUTES`). Returns `409` without receipt link (anti-oracle).
1427	
1428	### Webhooks
1429	
1430	#### Renderer Revalidation — `POST ${REVALIDATE_WEBHOOK_URL}`
1431	Payload fires on every `afterChange` (pages/posts/etc.) via `src/hooks/revalidateSiteDoc.ts` → `notifyRenderers`.
1432	```http
1433	POST https://your-renderer.example.com/revalidate
1434	x-eshobe-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(PAYLOAD_SECRET, rawBody)>
1435	x-eshobe-timestamp: 2024-05-17T10:00:00Z
1436	content-type: application/json
1437	
1438	{ "paths": ["/acme.ir/en/pricing", "/acme.ir/pricing"], "tags":["site:...:page"], "resources":["page"], "siteId":"...", "timestamp":"2024-05-17T10:00:00Z" }
1439	```
1440	Verify the HMAC over the **raw body bytes only** with `PAYLOAD_SECRET` (a deployed theme: its `ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET`, §17b); then purge cache / revalidate path. `resources` and `tags` are additive semantic hints for page/post/listing/category/navigation/branding/theme-setting invalidation; v1 receivers may continue reading only `paths`. `x-eshobe-timestamp` is informational and is **not** part of the v1 signature — do not prepend it when verifying. (The platform webhooks in `docs/platform-control-api.md` sign `<timestamp>.<body>`; this one does not, and a timestamped renderer signature would be a v2 contract.) Best-effort, 3s timeout, at-most-once — if you need at-least-once, consume jobs queue instead.
1441	
1442	#### Domain-check (Caddy)
1443	`GET /api/domain-check?domain=<host>` → `200 {authorised:true}` if site active+verified else `404`. Caddy's `on_demand_tls { ask http://web:3000/api/domain-check }` gates TLS issuance (prevents CA rate-limit burn). Not theme-related but required for custom domains.
1444	
1445	#### Jobs Queue (scheduled publish)
1446	`versions.drafts.schedulePublish` queues `schedulePublish` job with `waitUntil`. Web container's `getPayload({cron:true})` + `jobs.autoRun: "* * * * *"` runs it (VPS only — never serverless, duplicates on multi-replica). For themes: draft pages appear when job fires; webhook above notifies.
1447	
1448	---
1449	
1450	## 17b. Deployable Themes and `eshobe.theme.json`
1451	
1452	A deployable Theme is one `theme-packages` row in the CMS. The UI calls it **Theme / پوسته**;
1453	the internal slug remains `theme-packages` for database/API compatibility. A Theme owns the
1454	GitHub source, manifest, design defaults, build/registry contract, runtime schemas and the
1455	versions/artifacts built from it. It does **not** own a live site's custom design tokens:
1456	`theme-packages.designDefaults` is copied into the site's `theme` document only when the site
1457	first adopts a different Theme after a successful production health check, or when an operator
1458	explicitly chooses **Apply theme defaults**.
1459	
1460	### Three connection patterns
1461	
1462	#### A. Same-domain production renderer
1463	
1464	```text
1465	https://shop.example.com
1466	```
1467	
1468	The browser calls CMS-owned paths on the same origin:
1469	
1470	```text
1471	/api/site
1472	/api/pages
1473	/api/posts
1474	/api/products
1475	/api/checkout
1476	/api/payments/methods
1477	/api/media/file/*
1478	```
1479	
1480	In legacy `edge` mode, Caddy keeps `/api/*` on the CMS and proxies page traffic to the theme.
1481	In Coolify-first `direct` mode the customer DNS points at the theme container, so the theme
1482	must proxy the CMS-owned `/api/*` paths back to `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` and preserve the original
1483	`Host` header. That promise is the manifest flag `proxiesApi: true`; production `direct`
1484	deploys are refused without it. Theme-owned routes such as HTML pages, assets, `/api/health`,
1485	and `/api/revalidate` stay in the theme app.
1486	
1487	#### B. Server-side CMS access with a Site API Key
1488	
1489	A managed deployment receives these platform variables (the theme cannot override them):
1490	
1491	```text
1492	ESHOBE_CMS_URL
1493	ESHOBE_API_KEY
1494	ESHOBE_SITE_ID
1495	ESHOBE_SITE_DOMAIN
1496	ESHOBE_DEFAULT_LOCALE
1497	ESHOBE_LOCALES
1498	ESHOBE_SITE_TYPE
1499	ESHOBE_CURRENCY
1500	ESHOBE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
1501	ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET
1502	ESHOBE_CONTRACT_VERSION
1503	```
1504	
1505	Server code may call:
1506	
1507	```http
1508	GET ${ESHOBE_CMS_URL}/api/site
1509	Authorization: Bearer ${ESHOBE_API_KEY}
1510	```
1511	
1512	Tenant identity comes from **Host** or from **`Authorization: Bearer <site key>`**. It never
1513	comes from `?site=`, a public body `siteId`, or a tenant query parameter. Public host-resolved
1514	`GET /api/site` never returns internal package IDs, Coolify UUIDs, server UUIDs, deployment
1515	secrets, registry credentials, site API keys, revalidation secrets, tenant secret values or
1516	ciphertext.
1517	
1518	#### C. Preview deployment
1519	
1520	A preview has its own Theme Binding and Coolify application, usually on a wildcard hostname
1521	such as:
1522	
1523	```text
1524	https://<site>-<theme>-preview.sites.example.com
1525	```
1526	
1527	Preview uses CMS credentials injected by the platform, but `ESHOBE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` is the
1528	preview origin, not the canonical site domain. Preview never changes production routing,
1529	`sites.renderedBy`, `sites.activeDeployment`, or the live site's design tokens. A failed
1530	preview is only a failed deployment row.
1531	
1532	### Public and private GitHub repositories
1533	
1534	Public repositories are read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` without private credentials.
1535	Private repositories use the platform's `GITHUB_THEME_TOKEN` integration. Tokens stay in the
1536	CMS/Coolify control plane; they are never exposed to tenants, theme containers, manifests,
1537	logs or deployment history. Repository names are parsed as GitHub `owner/name` only, and refs
1538	are validated before they are used.
1539	
1540	### Manifest location and parser
1541	
1542	Commit `eshobe.theme.json` at the repository root. The CMS reads it during manual sync and
1543	GitHub push webhook sync. Sync validates strictly; on failure it records `syncError` and keeps
1544	the previous valid manifest, commit and design defaults. A webhook sync only marks update
1545	availability — it never auto-deploys production.
1546	
1547	Complete example using the current field names:
1548	
1549	```json
1550	{
1551	  "contractVersion": 1,
1552	  "key": "graphite",
1553	  "name": "Graphite",
1554	  "nameFa": "گرافیت",
1555	  "siteTypes": ["business", "portfolio", "store"],
1556	  "locales": ["fa", "en"],
1557	  "previewUrl": "https://example.com",
1558	  "proxiesApi": true,
1559	  "capabilities": { "commerce": true },
1560	  "design": {
1561	    "primary": "#0f766e",
1562	    "accent": "#f59e0b",
1563	    "background": "#ffffff",
1564	    "foreground": "#0a0a0a",
1565	    "radius": "md",
1566	    "lineHeight": 1.8
1567	  },
1568	  "deployment": {
1569	    "strategy": "registry_image",
1570	    "registryProvider": "ghcr",
1571	    "registryImageRepository": "ghcr.io/owner/theme",
1572	    "registryVisibility": "public"
1573	  },
1574	  "build": {
1575	    "buildPack": "dockerfile",
1576	    "baseDirectory": "/",
1577	    "dockerfileLocation": "Dockerfile",
1578	    "installCommand": null,
1579	    "buildCommand": null,
1580	    "startCommand": null,
1581	    "publishDirectory": null,
1582	    "port": 3000,
1583	    "healthCheckPath": "/api/health",
1584	    "isStatic": false
1585	  },
1586	  "env": [
1587	    {
1588	      "key": "EXAMPLE_API_KEY",
1589	      "source": "tenant",
1590	      "required": false,
1591	      "secret": true,
1592	      "labelFa": "کلید API",
1593	      "help": "Value is encrypted and injected only at deploy time."
1594	    }
1595	  ],
1596	  "settings": {
1597	    "showSectionNumbers": {
1598	      "type": "boolean",
1599	      "default": true,
1600	      "labelFa": "نمایش شماره بخش‌ها"
1601	    }
1602	  },
1603	  "contentSlots": [
1604	    {
1605	      "key": "home",
1606	      "type": "page",
1607	      "required": true,
1608	      "labelFa": "صفحه اصلی"
1609	    }
1610	  ]
1611	}
1612	```
1613	
1614	### Manifest fields
1615	
1616	| Field | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / validation | Security meaning and runtime effect |
1617	|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
1618	| `contractVersion` | integer | yes | — | `>=1` and `<=` platform `contractVersion` | Refuses themes written for a newer public renderer contract. Optional fields such as `design` do **not** bump v1. |
1619	| `key` | string | no | slugified `name` | ASCII slug produced by the parser | Public theme identity (`themeRuntime.theme.key`). Use a stable explicit key; changing it creates a new identity. |
1620	| `name` | string | yes | — | non-empty | Operator/customer display name. |
1621	| `nameFa` | string/null | no | `null` | non-empty string if present | Persian display name. |
1622	| `siteTypes` | array | no | `business`, `portfolio`, `store` | only `business`, `portfolio`, `store`; non-empty if supplied | Deploy-time compatibility. The package row may narrow this further. |
1623	| `locales` | string[] | no | `["fa"]` | non-empty strings | Theme UI locale support metadata. The site still decides its served locales. |
1624	| `previewUrl` | string/null | no | `null` | HTTPS only | Catalogue/demo link. Parser also accepts legacy `preview`. |
1625	| `proxiesApi` | boolean | no | `false` | boolean only | Required for Coolify-first direct production because `/api/*` hits the theme container. |
1626	| `capabilities` | object | no | `{}` | `Record<string, boolean>`; non-true values become `false` | Metadata for filtering/reporting; not an execution surface. |
1627	| `design` | object | no | `{}` | keys exactly `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground`, `radius`, `lineHeight` | Optional design defaults copied on adoption/reset only. Unknown keys reject the manifest. |
1628	| `deployment` | object | no | omitted | see below; unknown deployment keys reject | GHCR/registry strategy synced into the theme package on manifest sync. |
1629	| `build` | object | no | `{}` | see below; unknown build keys reject | Instructions projected to Coolify. Treat as untrusted repository input. |
1630	| `env` | array | no | `[]` | max 50 entries; see below | Deployment environment declarations. Values are never taken from the manifest. |
1631	| `settings` | object | no | `{}` | max 50 entries; see below | Safe runtime presentation settings returned through `GET /api/site`; no rebuild needed. |
1632	| `contentSlots` | array | no | `[]` | max 50 entries; see below | Tenant-scoped content binding schema. |
1633	
1634	#### `design`
1635	
1636	| Key | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values | Runtime effect |
1637	|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
1638	| `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground` | string | no | omitted | hex color accepted by the site theme schema (`#rgb` or `#rrggbb`) | Copied into `theme` only on first successful different-theme production adoption or explicit reset. |
1639	| `radius` | string | no | omitted | `none`, `sm`, `md`, `lg` | Same as site `theme.radius`. |
1640	| `lineHeight` | number | no | omitted | `1.4` through `2.4` | Same as site `theme.lineHeight`. |
1641	
1642	Changing `design` in GitHub and syncing the Theme does not repaint existing sites.
1643	
1644	#### `build`
1645	
1646	Current build packs are exactly:
1647	
1648	```text
1649	nixpacks
1650	dockerfile
1651	static
1652	dockercompose
1653	```
1654	
1655	| Key | Type | Required | Default | Validation / effect |
1656	|---|---|---:|---|---|
1657	| `buildPack` | string | no | `nixpacks` | One of the build packs above. Legacy `pack` is accepted for old manifests. |
1658	| `baseDirectory` | string | no | `/` | Safe path only, no `..`; must start with `/`. |
1659	| `dockerfileLocation` | string/null | no | `null` | Optional safe path for `dockerfile`; <= 500 chars, no control characters or `..`. |
1660	| `installCommand` | string/null | no | `null` | Passed to Coolify only after validation: a single package-manager/framework command (`pnpm`, `npm`, `yarn`, `bun`, `node`, `npx`, `next`, `vite`, `astro`, `nuxt`, `remix`, `gatsby`, `serve`) with simple arguments. Shell operators, quotes, pipes, redirects and control characters are rejected. |
1661	| `buildCommand` | string/null | no | `null` | Same. `null` means let the build pack decide. |
1662	| `startCommand` | string/null | no | `null` | Same. |
1663	| `publishDirectory` | string/null | no | `null` | Static output directory; safe path only. |
1664	| `port` | number/string | no | `3000` | Integer 1–65535. |
1665	| `healthCheckPath` | string/null | no | `null` | Safe path; must start with `/` when present. Coolify's container health check curls it from inside the container against `127.0.0.1:<port>` — IPv4 loopback on purpose (`localhost` resolves to `::1` on IPv6-first images and the check refuses to connect), so the server must answer on IPv4. |
1666	| `isStatic` | boolean | no | `true` only when `buildPack`/legacy `pack` is `static`, else `false` | Coolify static flag. |
1667	
1668	Unknown build keys (for example `build.command`) are rejected instead of ignored because they
1669	are execution-adjacent input from an untrusted repository.
1670	
1671	#### `deployment`
1672	
1673	Optional. When present, manifest sync copies these fields onto the theme package row so
1674	preview/production use immutable GHCR digests instead of Coolify source builds.
1675	
1676	| Key | Type | Required | Validation |
1677	|---|---|---:|---|
1678	| `strategy` | string | yes | `coolify_build` or `registry_image` |
1679	| `registryProvider` | string | yes when `strategy` is `registry_image` | `ghcr` |
1680	| `registryImageRepository` | string | yes when `strategy` is `registry_image` | `ghcr.io/owner/image` |
1681	| `registryVisibility` | string | no | `public` (default) or `private` |
1682	
1683	#### `env`
1684	
1685	Each entry declares one environment variable shape:
1686	
1687	| Key | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
1688	|---|---|---:|---|---|
1689	| `key` | string | yes | — | `/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$/`; duplicates rejected. |
1690	| `source` | `platform`/`tenant` | no | `tenant` | Who supplies the value. |
1691	| `required` | boolean | no | `false` | Required tenant value before deploy. |
1692	| `secret` | boolean | no | `false` | Tenant value is encrypted and write-only. |
1693	| `labelFa` | string/null | no | `null` | Persian form label. |
1694	| `help` | string/null | no | `null` | Help text. |
1695	
1696	`platform` values are controlled by CMS. `tenant` values are supplied through **Site → Theme
1697	Settings** and validated against the manifest. A theme cannot make a protected platform key a
1698	tenant question. Current protected `PLATFORM_ENV_KEYS` are:
1699	
1700	```text
1701	ESHOBE_CMS_URL
1702	ESHOBE_SITE_DOMAIN
1703	ESHOBE_SITE_ID
1704	ESHOBE_API_KEY
1705	ESHOBE_DEFAULT_LOCALE
1706	ESHOBE_LOCALES
1707	ESHOBE_SITE_TYPE
1708	ESHOBE_CURRENCY
1709	ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET
1710	ESHOBE_CONTRACT_VERSION
1711	ESHOBE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
1712	```
1713	
1714	Secret lifecycle:
1715	
1716	```text
1717	Theme declares requirement
1718	→ customer enters value in Site Theme Settings
1719	→ CMS encrypts value at rest
1720	→ deploy job decrypts only while creating/updating the Coolify environment
1721	→ secret is never returned by API, admin reads, logs, deployment history or errors
1722	```
1723	
1724	Tenant values are limited to 2048 characters. Platform values are written **after** tenant
1725	values in the Coolify environment so protected keys cannot be shadowed even if a future bug
1726	relaxes validation.
1727	
1728	#### Runtime `settings`
1729	
1730	Runtime settings are not environment variables. They are safe presentation/runtime choices that
1731	can change without rebuilding the container and are returned under `GET /api/site` →
1732	`themeRuntime.settings` after validation.
1733	
1734	`settings` is an object whose keys match `/^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}$/`. Each value supports:
1735	
1736	| Key | Type | Required | Meaning |
1737	|---|---|---:|---|
1738	| `type` | string | yes | `boolean`, `text`, `number`, or `select`. |
1739	| `default` | boolean/number/string | no | Must match `type`; for `select`, must be one of the option values. |
1740	| `min`, `max` | number | no | Enforced for `number` values. |
1741	| `options` | array | required for `select` | 1–50 options, each `{ value, labelFa?, labelEn? }`, value <= 100 chars. |
1742	| `labelFa`, `labelEn` | string/null | no | Form labels. |
1743	| `help` | string/null | no | Help text. |
1744	
1745	Stored values are validated before save and again before returning through `/api/site`; unknown
1746	or incorrectly typed settings are rejected.
1747	
1748	Themes implement presentation behaviour (for example a home-page logo intro); the CMS only
1749	declares the schema, validates tenant overrides, and exposes merged values on
1750	`themeRuntime.settings`.
1751	
1752	Example (Graphite home intro — animation logic lives in the theme repository):
1753	
1754	```json
1755	{
1756	  "settings": {
1757	    "introAnimation": {
1758	      "type": "boolean",
1759	      "default": true,
1760	      "labelEn": "Home logo intro animation",
1761	      "labelFa": "انیمیشن لوگوی صفحه اول"
1762	    },
1763	    "introDuration": {
1764	      "type": "number",
1765	      "default": 7000,
1766	      "min": 0,
1767	      "max": 20000,
1768	      "labelEn": "Intro duration in milliseconds",
1769	      "labelFa": "مدت انیمیشن به میلی‌ثانیه"
1770	    }
1771	  }
1772	}
1773	```
1774	
1775	#### `contentSlots`
1776	
1777	`contentSlots` is an array of content binding declarations. Supported types are exactly:
1778	
1779	```text
1780	page
1781	post
1782	category
1783	form
1784	media
1785	```
1786	
1787	Each slot has `{ key, type, required?, labelFa?, labelEn?, help? }`; `key` uses the same
1788	`/^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,63}$/` pattern and cannot repeat.
1789	
1790	Flow:
1791	
1792	```text
1793	Theme declares slot
1794	→ Site owner chooses content in Site Theme Settings
1795	→ CMS validates the selected document belongs to the same site
1796	→ CMS stores the binding
1797	→ GET /api/site returns a resolved binding
1798	→ Theme renders it
1799	```
1800	
1801	Example response:
1802	
1803	```json
1804	{
1805	  "themeRuntime": {
1806	    "theme": { "key": "graphite" },
1807	    "settings": { "showSectionNumbers": true },
1808	    "bindings": {
1809	      "home": { "id": "...", "type": "page", "slug": "home", "title": "خانه" }
1810	    }
1811	  }
1812	}
1813	```
1814	
1815	Cross-tenant binding IDs are refused and unresolved/deleted targets return `null` for that slot.
1816	
1817	##### How a theme should consume bindings
1818	
1819	A binding is the **customer's choice of content**; the URL it appears at is **the theme's**.
1820	Keep the two separate and a customer can call their About page anything.
1821	
1822	1. **Routes are the theme's.** A theme that has an "About" section serves it at a fixed path of
1823	   its own choosing (`/about`). Never derive that path from the bound document's slug — a
1824	   Persian site's page is called `درباره-ما`, and nav, sitemap and canonical URLs would all
1825	   move when somebody renames it.
1826	2. **Look the document up by `id`, not by slug.** `bindings.<key>.id` is stable; the slug is
1827	   editable and localized. Read it with the request's `locale` and `fallbackLocale=false`. A
1828	   bound document that has no translation in that locale is *missing* there (404 or an empty
1829	   state) — do not substitute a different page that happens to share a slug.
1830	3. **Slug is only a first-run hint.** With no binding saved (a freshly provisioned site
1831	   before anybody opened «تنظیمات پوسته»), a theme may look for a document whose slug equals
1832	   its section key. The hint applies **only when the slot is unbound** (`null`/absent), never
1833	   as a second opinion next to a binding.
1834	4. **One canonical URL per bound page.** When a visitor reaches a bound page through its own
1835	   slug (a rich-text link, an old bookmark), redirect to the section route. Internal
1836	   references in CMS navigation carry the document `id`, so match on that.
1837	5. **Resolve in one place.** Routes, navigation, sitemap and structured data must all go
1838	   through the same lookup, or a menu item points at a page the route will not render.
1839	
1840	The Graphite theme is the reference: `src/lib/theme/sections.ts` (rules, pure) and
1841	`src/lib/cms.ts` (`getSectionPage`, `getHomePage`, `getSectionCategories`).
1842	
1843	The operator console's **«آمادگی پوسته»** checklist (`GET …/deployment/readiness`) reports
1844	required slots that are unbound, bound documents that are drafts or deleted, and bound pages
1845	missing a served locale — the three ways a correct deploy still renders an empty page.
1846	
1847	### Revalidation contract
1848	
1849	When CMS content changes, the CMS sends a best-effort signed request to every live deployment's
1850	application hostname:
1851	
1852	```http
1853	POST https://<application-host>/api/revalidate
1854	content-type: application/json
1855	x-eshobe-timestamp: 2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z
1856	x-eshobe-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, rawBody)>
1857	
1858	{"paths":["/acme.ir/fa/pricing"],"resources":["page"],"siteId":"...","tags":["site:...:page"],"timestamp":"2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z"}
1859	```
1860	
1861	The secret is the deployment's `ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET`. Verify the signature over the exact
1862	raw request body bytes only. Do **not** sign or verify `<timestamp>.<body>` for this v1
1863	renderer contract; `x-eshobe-timestamp` is sent but not signed. A timestamp-signed scheme would
1864	be a versioned v2 contract so existing themes do not silently reject every notice.
1865	
1866	Delivery is at-most-once with a 3 second timeout. A failed receiver does not fail the CMS write.
1867	
1868	### GHCR / immutable artifact flow
1869	
1870	Registry-image Themes use immutable artifacts instead of mutable tags:
1871	
1872	```text
1873	GitHub repository
1874	  ↓ CI
1875	  ↓ GHCR image
1876	  ↓ POST /api/platform/theme-packages/:id/artifacts
1877	  ↓ verified digest
1878	  ↓ preview
1879	  ↓ production
1880	```
1881	
1882	The theme package may declare `deployment.strategy: registry_image` in `eshobe.theme.json`
1883	(manifest sync copies it to the CMS row) or set `deploymentStrategy`, `registryProvider`,
1884	`registryImageRepository` and `registryVisibility` manually in the admin. The manifest still
1885	controls the runtime/build contract. The CI callback supplies repository, commit SHA, image repository,
1886	`sha256:` digest, workflow URL/id, SBOM/provenance flags and timing. The CMS verifies:
1887	
1888	- callback HMAC `X-Eshobe-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC raw body>` with
1889	  `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET`;
1890	- source repository matches the Theme package;
1891	- image repository matches `registryImageRepository`;
1892	- commit SHA and digest syntax are strict;
1893	- duplicate package + commit + digest is idempotent.
1894	
1895	Registry deploys always run `ghcr.io/owner/image@sha256:<digest>`, never a mutable tag. Existing
1896	`theme-artifacts` rows remain immutable rollback inputs. The CI side (the three repository
1897	secrets `ESHOBE_CMS_URL`, `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET`, `ESHOBE_THEME_PACKAGE_ID`, a signing
1898	step, and the response codes) is in [`theme-artifacts.md`](./theme-artifacts.md). Making the
1899	GHCR package public or private changes only how Coolify pulls it.
1900	
1901	### Operational flow
1902	
1903	```text
1904	GitHub push
1905	  ↓
1906	CMS webhook verifies GitHub signature
1907	  ↓
1908	manifest sync validates and stores manifest/designDefaults/syncedCommitSha
1909	  ↓
1910	Sites show “update available” when their deployed commit differs
1911	  ↓
1912	Operator deploys preview or production explicitly
1913	```
1914	
1915	There is no automatic production deployment in v1. Preview and production use separate
1916	Theme Bindings; production promotion happens only after health verification, and a failed
1917	production attempt never destroys the previous healthy state.
1918	
1919	### Performance and stability for deployed themes
1920	
1921	What the platform does around a deployed theme, and what that asks of the theme:
1922	
1923	- **Cache `GET /api/site`; do not fetch it per request.** Called with the site key it answers
1924	  `cache-control: private, no-store` and is rebuilt on every call (several queries: site,
1925	  store, theme, branding, settings, bindings). Hold it in memory and drop it when a
1926	  revalidation notice arrives. The same goes for page, post and product reads: cache by
1927	  path/tag and let `/api/revalidate` invalidate them.
1928	- **Also expire caches on a timer.** Revalidation is at-most-once with a 3 s timeout and is
1929	  never retried. A notice lost to a restart or a slow handler means stale content until
1930	  something else invalidates it, so keep a time-based fallback (minutes, not days).
1931	- **Answer `/api/revalidate` fast.** Verify the signature, record what to purge, return 2xx,
1932	  then do the work. A handler that rebuilds pages before answering will hit the 3 s timeout.
1933	- **Serve stale when the CMS is unreachable.** A CMS restart or deploy should not take every
1934	  storefront down with it; keep the last good response and retry in the background.
1935	- **Keep the health endpoint cheap and local.** Coolify runs the container health check
1936	  continuously against `127.0.0.1:<port><healthCheckPath>`, and it should not call the CMS,
1937	  a database or anything remote. If it does, a CMS blip marks every theme container
1938	  unhealthy at once, and the proxy may stop routing to them. Return 200 from the process
1939	  itself, listen on IPv4 (`0.0.0.0`), and declare `build.healthCheckPath`: without it
1940	  Coolify has no health check, the CMS probes `/` instead, and a broken new container can be
1941	  swapped in for a working one.
1942	- **The promotion probe expects a 200.** After a build the CMS probes the app hostname and
1943	  waits out 404/502/503/504 and connection errors for up to 10 minutes. Any other non-2xx
1944	  answer fails the deploy, including a redirect from a declared `healthCheckPath`. Start
1945	  fast, and do not block startup on warming caches.
1946	- **Ship an image, not a source build.** With `registry_image` the preview and production run
1947	  the same digest and a rollback is a pull. With a source build every deploy, including the
1948	  production publish of a reviewed commit, is a fresh build on the Coolify server
1949	  ([`theme-artifacts.md`](./theme-artifacts.md#which-strategy-to-use)).
1950	
1951	### Security checklist for theme authors
1952	
1953	- Never accept `?site=`, `tenant`, or public `siteId` as tenant authority.
1954	- Never log `ESHOBE_API_KEY`, `ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET`, tenant secrets or registry credentials.
1955	- If `proxiesApi: true`, proxy only CMS-owned API paths and keep `/api/revalidate` local.
1956	- Verify revalidation signatures before purging cache.
1957	- Treat `themeRuntime.settings` and `bindings` as validated presentation input, not secrets.
1958	- Use immutable image digests for registry deployments.
1959

**Response:**

1	# Deployable themes — from a GitHub repo to a running site on Coolify
2	
3	**Status: implemented (Wave 11).** This document describes the system as it runs. The
4	author's side of the contract — `eshobe.theme.json`, the environment a theme receives,
5	the revalidation webhook — is [`docs/THEME_API.md`](./THEME_API.md) §17 and §17b. The
6	HTTP surface is [`docs/platform-control-api.md`](./platform-control-api.md) §9. Immutable
7	GHCR builds, placement layouts, CI registration, promotion, and digest rollback are documented
8	in [`docs/theme-artifacts.md`](./theme-artifacts.md).
9	
10	A theme built against the Theme API lives in its own GitHub repository. The operator
11	registers it, assigns it to a site, deploys a **preview** on the operator's preview Coolify
12	project, verifies the customer's domain, then **publishes** on the production Coolify project.
13	The normal product flow no longer chooses between Caddy `edge` and Coolify `direct` — production
14	is Coolify-first. Legacy `edge` remains behind `ESHOBE_LEGACY_CADDY_EDGE=1` for existing sites.

17	
18	## 0. The short version
19	
20	Eight tables exist so that each thing has one owner. You do not need to think about most of
21	them. A site goes live in six steps, and the **«آمادگی پوسته»** checklist at the top of the
22	site's «استقرار پوسته» tab tells you which one is open (`GET …/deployment/readiness`):
23	
24	| # | Step | Who | Where |
25	|---|---|---|---|
26	| 1 | Register the theme repo, **sync**, **publish** | operator | `theme-packages` |
27	| 2 | CI builds the image and registers its digest (registry strategy; needs three repo secrets, see `theme-artifacts.md`) | automatic | `theme-artifacts` |
28	| 3 | **Assign** the theme to the site | operator | site → «استقرار پوسته» |
29	| 4 | Choose the theme's pages/categories and fill its variables | customer or operator | site → «تنظیمات پوسته» |
30	| 5 | **Deploy preview**, look at it | operator | site → «استقرار پوسته» |
31	| 6 | Verify DNS, then **publish** to the domain | operator | site → «استقرار پوسته» |
32	
33	Steps 4 and 6 can be done in either order; a preview never needs a verified domain. If
34	something looks wrong on the live site, «بازگشت به رندرکنندهٔ داخلی» (revert) always works.
35	Everything else in this document is what those six steps do underneath.
36	
37	A page the theme shows is **never found by its slug** once the customer has chosen it in step
38	4 — the theme's URLs are fixed, the content behind them is bound. See `THEME_API.md`
39	(«How a theme should consume bindings»).
40	
41	---
42	
43	## 1. Who decides what
44	
45	Deployable themes are **operator-managed**. Which package a site runs, on which server, in
46	which domain mode, is decided by platform staff — the «استقرار پوسته» tab on a site, or
47	`/api/platform/sites/:id/deployment*` from the sibling console. There is no customer
48	theme picker and no customer deploy button, and that is a product decision rather than a
49	missing feature: a deploy puts third-party code in front of a customer's domain, and the
50	safety checks around it (verified domain, `proxiesApi`, a health check before anything
51	switches) are operator judgement calls.
52	
53	A customer's staff decide exactly one thing: the answers to the variables the theme asked
54	*them* for (§8). They never name a repository, a package, a server or a mode.
55	
56	---
57	
58	## 2. The pieces
59	
60	| Concept | Slug | Owner | What it holds |
61	|---|---|---|---|
62	| Per-site tokens | `theme` | site | Colours/radius — unchanged by any of this. |
63	| Design defaults | `theme-packages.designDefaults` | platform | Copied only when a site first adopts a different theme or an operator explicitly applies defaults. |
64	| **Deployable theme** | `theme-packages` | platform | Repository visibility, strategy, manifest, synced/pinned commit, and optional allowed GHCR repository/visibility. |
65	| **Immutable build** | `theme-artifacts` | platform | One commit's verified image repository + digest, workflow provenance, and build state. |
66	| **Coolify connection** | `deploy-targets` | platform | Encrypted API token, lane placements, Git capabilities, and registry capabilities. |
67	| **One attempt** | `site-deployments` | site | Auditable history: status, lane/mode, hostnames, ref/commit, log tail. |
68	| **Coolify identity** | `theme-bindings` | site | One row per (site × package × lane): `appUuid`, pinned project/server, app name. |
69	| **Intent** | `sites.assignedThemePackage` | site | Which published package is assigned before any container exists. |
70	| **Tenant answers** | `site-theme-settings` | site | The customer's values for the manifest's `source: "tenant"` variables (one document per site). |
71	
72	`theme-packages` and `deploy-targets` are platform-wide (the documented exception to the
73	multi-tenant registration rule, and in `platformWide` in `tests/int/store.int.spec.ts`).
74	`theme-bindings`, `site-deployments` and `site-theme-settings` are registered with the multi-tenant plugin.
75	
76	`sites.renderedBy` (`platform` | `deployment`) and `sites.activeDeployment` say who serves
77	the customer's domain. Both are written only by the deploy service (field access denies
78	every caller, including platform admins, so a stale admin form cannot put an old value
79	back).
80	
81	---
82	
83	## 3. Registering a theme
84	
85	1. Create a `theme-packages` row: repository (`owner/name`), visibility, default ref, and
86	   optionally a **pinned commit** (every new deploy then builds exactly that commit),
87	   a default target, a `requiredFeature` (a plan feature key) and design defaults copied on adoption.
88	2. **«همگام‌سازی از گیت‌هاب»** (`POST /api/platform/theme-packages/:id/sync`) reads
89	   `eshobe.theme.json` at the ref, validates it (`parseThemeManifest` refuses rather than
90	   coerces), projects it into read-only fields, and stores `syncedCommitSha` — the commit
91	   the ref pointed at. A failed sync keeps the previous manifest and records `syncError`.
92	   Editing `defaultRef` by hand afterwards clears `syncedCommitSha` until the next sync.
93	3. **«انتشار»** (`POST …/publish`, admin session only) refuses a package with no manifest,
94	   no contract version, or no active deploy target.
95	4. **(اختیاری) وب‌هوک گیت‌هاب** — `POST /api/platform/theme-packages/github-webhook` on the
96	   control-plane host only. Configure GitHub `push` events with the same secret as
97	   `GITHUB_THEME_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. When a push lands on a package's `defaultRef`, the CMS
98	   re-syncs that package (same rules as manual sync). **No site is redeployed**; operators
99	   only see «نسخهٔ جدید موجود است» until they preview or redeploy explicitly. Duplicate
100	   `X-GitHub-Delivery` ids are ignored.
101	
102	Only a published package can be deployed. `siteTypes` is checked twice: the manifest's list
103	(the author's claim) and the row's (the operator's narrowing).
104	
105	A `deploy-targets` row needs its self-test (`POST /api/deploy-targets/self-test`) green
106	before a deploy is worth trying; its token is encrypted with `src/lib/deploy/crypto.ts`,
107	masked on read, and blank-on-save means unchanged.
108	
109	---
110	
111	## 4. Lanes (preview and production)
112	
113	| Lane | Coolify project | Hostnames | Effect on live site |
114	|---|---|---|---|
115	| `preview` | `deploy-targets.previewProjectUuid` | Wildcard preview only | Rehearsal — does not change `renderedBy` |
116	| `production` | `deploy-targets.productionProjectUuid` | Verified primary domain on Coolify | After health check, sets `activeDeployment` + `renderedBy: deployment` |
117	
118	API and admin UI prefer `lane`. Older callers may still send `domainMode=preview` or
119	`domainMode=direct` (mapped to production). New `edge` deploys are rejected unless
120	`ESHOBE_LEGACY_CADDY_EDGE=1`.
121	
122	Operator flow — one console, one order:
123	
124	1. Register/sync/publish the package.
125	2. Assign the package to the site (`POST …/theme-assignment` or admin UI).
126	3. Deploy preview → review on wildcard URL.
127	4. Verify customer DNS.
128	5. Publish production (`lane=production`) — reuses the same production binding/app on updates.
129	
130	The console is the **«استقرار پوسته»** tab on the site document
131	(`/admin/collections/sites/:id/deployment`) — platform staff only; a customer's own
132	staff do not see the tab, the view refuses them, and every route behind it re-checks.
133	It is laid out as the flow itself — a readiness checklist, a «روی دامنه» / «پیش‌نمایش»
134	status pair saying which commit runs where, then three numbered steps with one primary
135	action each:
136	
137	| Step | Button | Request |
138	|---|---|---|
139	| ۱ انتخاب پوسته | «ثبت این پوسته برای سایت» | `POST …/theme-assignment { package }` |
140	| ۲ پیش‌نمایش | «ساخت پیش‌نمایش» | `POST …/deployment { lane: "preview", package }` — the package's latest commit |
141	| ۳ انتشار روی دامنه | «انتشار نسخهٔ ‹sha› روی دامنه» | `POST …/deployment { lane: "production", package, artifact }` — the **live preview's artifact**, so what ships is what was reviewed (registry strategy only, see below) |
142	
143	Step 3 also has «اجرای دوبارهٔ نسخهٔ فعلی» (`POST …/redeploy { lane: "production" }`):
144	the current production version again, for changed «تنظیمات پوسته» variables, a new
145	primary domain (`needsRedeploy`) or a broken container. `/redeploy` resolves its source
146	row within the `lane` it is given, so a preview redeploy can never rebuild production.
147	
148	Both buttons pin a version. Step 3 sends the live preview's `artifact` *and* its commit
149	as `ref` (only when the preview is of the package being published), and redeploy reuses the
150	source row's artifact and commit. With `registry_image` production runs the reviewed digest;
151	with `coolify_build` it rebuilds the reviewed commit, which is the same source but not the
152	same bytes ([`theme-artifacts.md`](./theme-artifacts.md#which-strategy-to-use)). Only an
153	explicit upgrade, or an API caller that omits `ref`, resolves a branch. Stop, revert
154	and rollback live in the collapsed «توقف و بازگشت» and «تاریخچهٔ استقرارها» sections.
155	A direct link to the tab sits on
156	the **«نمای ۳۶۰ مشتری»** overview pane. Rows in **«انتشارها»** (`site-deployments`) are
157	history: `create` on that collection is closed to everybody, admins included — a row is
158	born in `createDeployment` with its artifact and hostnames already resolved, and a
159	hand-made row (no artifact, no preview hostname) is a row that can only fail at run time.
160	
161	---
162	
163	## 4 (legacy). The three domain modes (historical rows)
164	
165	| Mode | Customer DNS | Coolify app answers on | Caddy | `renderedBy` after success |
166	|---|---|---|---|---|
167	| `preview` | unchanged | `<site-key>-<key>-preview.<wildcard>` only | not involved | unchanged |
168	| `edge` *(recommended)* | Caddy | `<site-key>-<key>.<wildcard>` only | proxies **pages** of the customer domain to the app; `/api/*` stays on `web:3000` | `deployment` |
169	| `direct` | Coolify | `<site-key>-<key>.<wildcard>`, plus the customer domain once healthy (§5 step 5) | not in the path any more | `deployment` |
170	
171	- `<site-key>` is the first 12 hex digits of the site id — the same key the Coolify
172	  application name uses — so the whole theme key fits in the label
173	  (`f8ce1dbaeeeb-cms-arch3-theme-preview.theme.eshobe.com`). Older rows keep the
174	  long `<site-id>-…` names they were created with until their next deploy.
175	- Anything but `preview` requires `domainVerified`.
176	- `direct` is refused unless the manifest declares `proxiesApi: true` — otherwise checkout,
177	  forms and media stop working the moment DNS moves.
178	- A preview is a **rehearsal**: it has its own Coolify application and hostname, so
179	  previewing a new version never rebuilds the container production runs on; a preview
180	  going live never supersedes an `edge`/`direct` deployment and never touches the site.
181	- `/api/domain-check` refuses a certificate for a hostname a *live `direct`* deployment has
182	  taken off the edge; `edge` sites keep getting theirs.
183	
184	---
185	
186	## 5. A deployment's lifecycle
187	
188	```
189	POST …/deployment ─► queued ─► creating ─► building ─► verifying ─► live
190	                        │          │           │   ▲        │
191	                        │          │           │   └────────┤ direct: domain moved, restart
192	                        └──────────┴───────────┴────────────┴─► failed ─► (retry = new row / queued)
193	                                                                live ─► stopped
194	```
195	
196	1. **Create** (`POST /api/platform/sites/:id/deployment`, 202). Every refusal that needs no
197	   network happens here, before a row exists: site not active, package unpublished,
198	   wrong site type, plan without `requiredFeature`, no target, unsafe ref, unverified
199	   domain for `edge`/`direct`, `direct` without `proxiesApi`, target without a wildcard
200	   domain. The ref is `effectiveRefFor`: explicit ref › pinned commit › default ref.
201	2. **Run** — the jobs queue (`advanceDeployments`, once a minute; `POST …/poll` does the
202	   same step on demand). Each tick takes at most 10 in-flight rows, oldest `updatedAt`
203	   first, and works through them **one after another**, on the same `default` queue as
204	   scheduled publishing. The row is claimed `queued → creating`, the site is re-checked
205	   (a site suspended while its deploy waited is refused), and then:
206	   - an incomplete row is repaired first, before anything plans from it: a registry row
207	     that arrived without its artifact link gets the ready artifact for its commit
208	     (its own ref when that is a sha, else what the package would deploy now — never
209	     overriding an artifact an operator chose), and a row missing its preview hostname
210	     gets one derived exactly as `createDeployment` derives it;
211	   - the Coolify application is found by its deterministic name or created — **`appUuid` is
212	     stored before anything else can fail**; a reused application is re-pointed at the new
213	     branch/commit/image and hostnames before it builds, via `PATCH` with only the fields
214	     Coolify's update route accepts (no placement or credential fields, which its allowlist
215	     rejects);
216	   - a `role: "site"` API key is minted for this deployment;
217	   - the environment is written (`buildEnvironment` — platform values last, so a tenant
218	     value can never shadow them; tenant secrets decrypted only here);
219	   - the build starts → `building`.
220	3. **Poll** — Coolify's build status moves the row to `verifying` or `failed`.
221	4. **Verify** — refused if the site is no longer active, or (for `edge`/`direct`) if the
222	   site's primary domain is not the one this build was made for or is unverified. Then a
223	   health check against the **application's own hostname** (the preview name — the
224	   customer domain may still point at Caddy, whose built-in renderer would answer 200),
225	   at the manifest's `healthCheckPath` (else `/`). The probe does not follow redirects. A
226	   2xx passes; a 3xx passes only on the `/` fallback, never on a declared health path.
227	   A 404/502/503/504 or a network error (DNS, refused, timeout) means "not answering yet":
228	   it is retried within the tick (`DEPLOY_HEALTH_ATTEMPTS`, default 6, `DEPLOY_HEALTH_RETRY_MS`,
229	   default 5000 apart) but never past `DEPLOY_HEALTH_BUDGET_MS` (default 30 s) per row per
230	   tick, then retried on later ticks until `DEPLOY_HEALTH_DEADLINE_MS` (default 10 min)
231	   after the first unanswered probe, which fails the row. Any other status fails it at once.
232	5. **Take the domain** (`direct` only, `moveSiteDomain`). A `direct` application is
233	   created on its own hostname only: the customer's domain usually still belongs to the
234	   theme being replaced, and Coolify refuses a hostname two applications claim
235	   (`Domain conflicts detected`). Once the build is healthy, the domain is removed from
236	   the configuration of the site's application that holds it — whose *running* container
237	   keeps its routing labels and goes on serving — added to this one, and this one is
238	   restarted (no rebuild). The row goes back to `building` to follow that restart, then
239	   through the health check again, and only then is promoted. So switching a site from
240	   one theme to another, and back, works every time and without a gap. A domain held by
241	   an application that is not this site's is never taken: the row fails and says whose it
242	   is. If the deployment fails after taking the domain, `returnSiteDomain` gives the
243	   domain back to the site's active application and stops the failed one.
244	6. **Promote** — the row becomes `live` first, then what it replaces is stopped (every
245	   other row of the site for `edge`/`direct`; only other previews for `preview`), then for
246	   `edge`/`direct` the package's design defaults are copied only if this is the
247	   first successful adoption of a different theme, then `renderedBy`/`activeDeployment` switch.
248	
249	A row whose `updatedAt` has not changed for an hour is failed by the queue. A `verifying`
250	row rewrites `lastError` on every retry, so it is bounded by the health deadline above
251	instead; while it waits, `healthCheckedAt` holds the time of the first unanswered probe.
252	**A failed deploy changes
253	nothing but its own row**: the previous live deployment and the site stay exactly as they
254	were. One caveat, from sharing an application between redeploys of the same theme: the
255	new container replaces the old one through Coolify's own deploy of that application. A
256	build that fails leaves the running container in place; whether an *unhealthy* new
257	container is swapped in is Coolify's rolling-update behaviour, which depends on the
258	application having a health check — so declare `healthCheckPath` in the manifest.
259	
260	---
261	
262	## 6. Redeploy, upgrade, rollback, stop, revert
263	
264	- **Redeploy / upgrade** — `POST …/deployment/redeploy` (the console's «اجرای دوبارهٔ نسخهٔ
265	  فعلی») creates a *new* row from the latest deployment in the requested `lane` (its
266	  package and target), for the site's *current* primary domain. It runs every check a
267	  create does. The body is `{ lane?, ref?, domainMode?, artifact?, upgrade? }`:
268	  - by default it runs the source row's own version: its artifact (registry, no build) and
269	    its commit (`coolify_build` rebuilds that commit);
270	  - `upgrade: true` takes what the package would deploy now: the ready artifact for the
271	    pinned/synced commit (registry), or the effective ref, pin else `defaultRef` HEAD
272	    (`coolify_build`). An explicit `artifact` or `ref` overrides either.
273	- **New version available** — `GET …/deployment` reports `update: { deployedCommit,
274	  latestCommit, packageRef, updateAvailable }` for a live deployment. `latestCommit` is the
275	  pin, else `syncedCommitSha`; the comparison is between commit shas, never branch names,
276	  and it is "different from what the package would deploy now" — the CMS does not order
277	  commits. No GitHub request is made to answer it; **run a sync to learn about a new
278	  commit** (upgrades are opt-in per site, `is_auto_deploy_enabled` is `false` on every
279	  application). The console shows «نسخهٔ جدید موجود است».
280	- **Rollback** — `POST …/rollback { deployment }` redeploys that row's `commitSha` as a new
281	  row, in that row's lane. A registry row reuses its artifact and digest, with no build. A
282	  `coolify_build` row is rebuilt: the sha goes to Coolify as `git_commit_sha` on the default
283	  branch. An explicit commit beats the package's pin.
284	- **Stop** — `POST …/stop { deployment }` stops the Coolify application (never deletes it),
285	  marks the row `stopped`, revokes its API key and, if it served the site, hands the site
286	  back to the built-in renderer. Repeating a stop only repeats the Coolify call — which is
287	  how an operator retries a stop Coolify did not acknowledge (the row's `lastError` says so).
288	- **Revert** — `POST …/revert` stops everything the site has running and sets
289	  `renderedBy: platform`. The escape hatch that makes the feature safe to try.
290	
291	---
292	
293	## 7. The site's lifecycle
294	
295	A hook on `sites` (`src/deploy/lifecycle.ts`) applies the same rules whichever path wrote
296	the site — the admin form, `PATCH /api/platform/sites/:id`, `PATCH /api/site/domain`, the
297	subscription lifecycle.
298	
299	- **Suspended or archived** — every deployment holding (or about to hold) an application
300	  is stopped through `stopDeployment`: live, preview, in-flight and queued rows, plus failed
301	  rows whose container may still be up. Applications are kept, history is kept, keys are
302	  revoked, the site returns to the built-in renderer, whose holding page answers for it.
303	  Best-effort: a Coolify outage does not block the suspension; it is logged and written
304	  onto the row so the operator can press stop again.
305	- **Reactivated** — nothing is restarted and nothing is queued. The site is *eligible* to
306	  be deployed again; an operator redeploys when they choose to.
307	- **Primary domain changed** — a live `edge`/`direct` deployment built for the old domain
308	  is left running but is reported `needsRedeploy` by `GET …/deployment`, with the message
309	  «دامنهٔ اصلی سایت پس از این استقرار تغییر کرده است. برای فعال‌شدن پوسته روی دامنهٔ جدید،
310	  استقرار مجدد انجام دهید.» The routing table drops it (the new domain is served by the
311	  built-in renderer meanwhile), promotion of any build made for the old domain is refused,
312	  and `domainVerified` is reset by the domain change itself. Verify the new domain, then
313	  redeploy. `needsRedeploy` is derived from the rows on read, never stored — it cannot drift.
314	
315	---
316	
317	## 8. Tenant settings («تنظیمات پوسته»)
318	
319	The customer-facing half. A document tab on the site, visible to the site's own staff and
320	to operators, generated from the manifest of the theme the site runs (the live production
321	deployment, else a live preview, else the most recent attempt — a first deploy that failed
322	for want of a required value is exactly when the form is needed). No theme → an
323	explanatory empty state.
324	
325	Backed by `GET|POST /api/site-theme-settings/current?site=<id>` (collection endpoints):
326	
327	- an admin **session** only; the caller must be a member of that site (or platform staff).
328	  Owners write, editors read. A site key, another site's staff and anonymous callers get
329	  403. The package is resolved server-side; a package or site in the body is ignored.
330	- deployment environment accepts only keys the manifest declares `source: "tenant"`; a platform variable
331	  (`ESHOBE_*`) or an undeclared key is a 400 and nothing is written; values are capped at
332	  2048 characters.
333	- secrets are write-only: encrypted at rest, masked on every read (an `afterRead` hook the
334	  deploy job bypasses with a context flag), reported only as "set". A blank secret box
335	  means *unchanged*; «حذف مقدار ذخیره‌شده» is the explicit clear.
336	- runtime settings are generated from the manifest's closed schema and take effect immediately without a deployment;
337	- content selectors are generated from `contentSlots`, and every selected relationship is checked against the same tenant;
338	- the raw `site-theme-settings` collection's create/update are platform-only.
339	
340	Environment values take effect on the next deployment. Runtime settings and bindings trigger
341	signed renderer revalidation on save. A value a newer manifest no longer declares is ignored,
342	not a deploy failure.
343	
344	---
345	
346	## 9. Routing through Caddy (`edge` mode)
347	
348	`buildRoutingTable` (`src/deploy/routing.ts`) emits a route only for a deployment that is
349	`live`, in `edge` mode, on an `active` site whose primary domain is verified and still equal
350	to the deployment's `domain` — plus that site's *verified* aliases. It is served as
351	`GET /api/platform/routing` and rendered into `theme-routes.caddy`:
352	
353	```caddy
354	map {host} {theme_upstream} {
355		default ""
356		acme.ir acme-ir-bazaar.sites.example.com
357	}
358	```
359	
360	The Caddyfile's `@themed` matcher proxies non-API paths to `https://{theme_upstream}` with
361	the upstream's own `Host` and `X-Forwarded-Host: {host}`; every `/api/*` carve-out precedes
362	it, and `/admin*` on a customer domain stays a 404.
363	
364	**Automatic regeneration.** When `THEME_ROUTES_FILE` is set, the web process rewrites the
365	file itself:
366	
367	- requested after every transition that can change it — an edge deployment going live,
368	  stopping or being superseded (rollback and redeploy included), revert, and a site's
369	  status, primary domain, verification or verified aliases changing while it is themed;
370	  not requested for previews, `direct` rows or sites with no deployed theme;
371	- coalesced for one second, then built from committed state on a fresh connection;
372	- written atomically (temporary file + rename) and skipped when no route changed;
373	- best-effort: a failure is logged and the previous map stays; nothing that requested it
374	  fails. The queue task also regenerates once a minute as a safety net (unchanged maps
375	  are not rewritten).
376	
377	In `docker-compose.prod.yml` the map lives in the `theme_routes` volume: written by `web`
378	at `/app/theme-routes/theme-routes.caddy`, mounted read-only into Caddy at
379	`/etc/caddy/theme-routes/`, which runs with `--watch` and reloads when the adapted config
380	changes. A directory volume rather than a bind-mounted file, because a rename is invisible
381	through a single-file bind mount. The image seeds the volume with the committed empty map;
382	a missing import is a Caddy that will not boot, which is also why `theme-routes.caddy` is
383	committed.
384	
385	**Without `THEME_ROUTES_FILE`** (a topology where the web process cannot write Caddy's
386	file) run the script from cron or after a deploy:
387	
388	```sh
389	CMS_URL=https://admin.example.com PLATFORM_API_KEY=eshobe_live_… \
390	  node scripts/render-theme-routes.mjs /etc/caddy/theme-routes/theme-routes.caddy
391	```
392	
393	It shares the renderer, exits non-zero without touching the file on any failure, and
394	needs `caddy reload` unless Caddy runs with `--watch`.
395	
396	The srv1/Komodo deployment does not run the bundled Caddy (customer-domain TLS is out of
397	scope there), so it has no theme routes; `preview` works everywhere a target exists.
398	
399	---
400	
401	## 10. Content changes reach the theme
402	
403	`notifyRenderers` posts to every live deployment of the site at
404	`https://<application host>/api/revalidate` (the preview hostname — in `edge` mode the
405	customer domain's `/api/*` belongs to the CMS), signed with that deployment's own
406	`ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET`, plus the global `REVALIDATE_WEBHOOK_URL` fallback.
407	
408	The v1 signature is `x-eshobe-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, rawBody)>` — the
409	raw body only. `x-eshobe-timestamp` is sent but **not** signed. This differs from the
410	platform webhooks (`<timestamp>.<body>`) on purpose: deployed themes verify the published v1
411	scheme, and changing it would make every one of them reject every notice silently. A
412	timestamped signature is a v2 contract change, made in `THEME_API.md` first.
413	`tests/int/renderer-webhook.int.spec.ts` pins the exact bytes.
414	
415	---
416	
417	## 11. Secrets
418	
419	| Secret | At rest | Leaves the process |
420	|---|---|---|
421	| Coolify token (`deploy-targets.apiToken`) | AES-256-GCM, `src/lib/deploy/crypto.ts` | never; masked on read, blank = unchanged, `clearApiToken` to wipe |
422	| Tenant secret answers (`site-theme-settings.secretValues`) | AES-256-GCM | only into the Coolify environment at deploy time |
423	| Deployment site key | hash only (`api-keys`) | once, into the Coolify environment; revoked on stop/supersede |
424	| Revalidation secret (`site-deployments.revalidateSecret`) | AES-256-GCM | into the Coolify environment; field unreadable |
425	
426	`ESHOBE_API_KEY` and `ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET` are runtime-only variables. Coolify's error
427	bodies and log tails are scrubbed (`scrubDetail`) before they reach a row. No API response
428	carries ciphertext. Rotating `DEPLOY_SECRET_KEY` (or `PAYLOAD_SECRET` when it is unset)
429	invalidates every stored token and tenant secret; there is no re-encryption job.
430	
431	---
432	
433	## 11b. Control-plane configuration
434	
435	Read per call from the **web** process's environment. Every compose file passes `web` an
436	explicit allowlist, so a variable set in Komodo/Coolify but missing from that list never
437	reaches the process. `docker-compose.srv1.yml` passes the four secrets below (blank by
438	default); the tuning variables use their defaults there.
439	
440	| Variable | Needed for | Unset means |
441	|---|---|---|
442	| `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET` | `registry_image` CI callbacks | Callback answers 503; no artifact can be registered, so no registry deploy can run. |
443	| `GITHUB_THEME_TOKEN` | Sync of a **private** theme repository (read-only PAT) | Sync of a private repo fails; public repos are unaffected. |
444	| `GITHUB_THEME_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | `POST /api/platform/theme-packages/github-webhook` | Webhook answers 503; manual sync still works. |
445	| `DEPLOY_SECRET_KEY` | Encrypting Coolify tokens and tenant secrets | Falls back to `PAYLOAD_SECRET`. Setting it later makes every stored value undecryptable (§11). |
446	| `DEPLOY_CMS_URL` | `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` given to themes. Must be reachable from the theme containers without a Host/SNI-routing proxy in between (internal network address); a change reaches running apps only on redeploy, and live rows report `needsRedeploy` until then | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL` |
447	| `DEPLOY_PUBLIC_SCHEME` | `http` for local Coolify only | `https`. |
448	| `DEPLOY_HEALTH_ATTEMPTS`, `DEPLOY_HEALTH_RETRY_MS`, `DEPLOY_HEALTH_BUDGET_MS`, `DEPLOY_HEALTH_DEADLINE_MS` | Tuning the promotion probe (§5) | 6 attempts, 5000 ms apart, 30 s per tick, 10 min overall. |
449	| `THEME_ROUTES_FILE` | Legacy `edge` only (§9) | Routes are rendered by the script instead. |
450	| `JOBS_AUTORUN` | Running the queue that advances deployments | Rows stay «در صف» unless «بررسی وضعیت» is pressed. |
451	
452	### After a CMS upgrade
453	
454	Schema changes to the deployment collections, and to anything Payload itself expects (the
455	Payload 3.90 upgrade added columns in `20261004_130000_payload_390_columns.ts`), ship as
456	migrations. In production the one-shot `migrate` service applies them before `web` starts,
457	and a failed migration keeps the new `web` from starting at all. A deploy console that
458	errors with `column … does not exist` after an upgrade means that step did not run against
459	this database (`pnpm payload migrate:status`).
460

462	
463	## 12. Troubleshooting
464	
465	| Symptom | Look at |
466	|---|---|
467	| Stays «در صف» | The jobs queue is not running (`JOBS_AUTORUN`, `src/instrumentation.ts`); «بررسی وضعیت» advances it by hand. |
468	| Stays «در حال بررسی سلامت» with «پوسته پاسخ نداد» in `lastError` | The application hostname does not resolve or refuses connections from the CMS. It is retried every minute and fails at the health deadline (§5); fix DNS/proxy and redeploy. |
469	| `failed` with «بررسی سلامت پاسخ 30x گرفت» | The declared `healthCheckPath` redirects. It must answer 200 itself. |
470	| CI registration answers 503 / 401 / 422 | 503: `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET` is not in the web process (§11b). 401: the secret differs or the body was re-serialised after signing. 422: `repository` or `image` does not match the package row. See `theme-artifacts.md`. |
471	| CI registration answers 404 from a customer domain | `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` in the theme repo must be the control-plane origin; `/api/platform/*` is not routed on customer domains. |
472	| Production shows code that was not in the preview | The deploy was made over the API without `ref`, or with `upgrade: true`, on a `coolify_build` package; those build `defaultRef` HEAD (§4). |
473	| `failed` with «تنظیمات پوسته کامل نیست» | A required tenant variable is empty — the customer fills it in «تنظیمات پوسته», then redeploy. |
474	| `failed` at verification with the domain message | The primary domain changed during the build. Verify the new domain, redeploy. |
475	| `failed` with «برای این کامیت هنوز تصویر آماده و تأییدشده‌ای وجود ندارد» | A registry-strategy package whose commit has no ready `theme-artifacts` row. The CI callback (see `docs/theme-artifacts.md`) registers one; wait for the build or deploy the artifact that exists. A row that arrives without an artifact is repaired automatically at run time — this message now means the registry genuinely has nothing ready for that commit. |
476	| `failed` at re-pointing with Coolify «Validation failed» | The PATCH contract changed: `src/deploy/coolify.ts` `repointApplication` builds the body from Coolify's update-route allowlist; its doc comment records the shapes (digest pin as `repo@sha256` name + bare-hash tag). |
477	| Domain or preview URL 503 «no available server» | Coolify's container health check could not connect: apps get `health_check_host: 127.0.0.1` pinned for exactly this (IPv6 `localhost` → `::1` refused). If a container is unhealthy, its port binding is the next thing to check. |
478	| Live, but the customer domain shows the built-in site | `edge`: is the site's domain verified and equal to the row's `domain`? Is `theme-routes.caddy` current (`GET /api/platform/routing`, the web log's `theme routes:` lines)? Is Caddy running with `--watch`? |
479	| `needsRedeploy` in the console | §7 — the domain moved after the deploy. |
480	| «نسخهٔ جدید موجود است» never appears | Run a sync: the notice compares against the commit the last sync resolved. |
481	| A stop left a container running | The row's `lastError` says Coolify refused; press stop again. |
482	| Everything disappeared after a key rotation | §11 — re-enter the Coolify token and ask customers to re-enter secrets. |
483

485	
486	## 13. Not built
487	
488	Stated so nobody reads their absence as a bug:
489	
490	- a customer-facing theme picker or deploy button (§1);
491	- deleting Coolify applications — the platform only stops them; the `removed` status
492	  records one an operator deleted by hand;
493	- automatic GitHub polling for new commits — a sync is the operator's action;
494	- ordering commits ("newer" vs "different") — `updateAvailable` means "different from what
495	  the package would deploy now";
496	- a timestamp-signed revalidation webhook (a v2 contract).
497	
498	## Tenant runtime configuration boundary
499	
500	Code, repositories, targets, deployment environment, promotion and logs remain operator
501	concerns. Site owners manage reusable branding, generic design tokens, manifest-declared
502	runtime options and content mappings. These values are delivered through `/api/site` and
503	updated without a Coolify rebuild; editor-facing presentation toggles must not use `env`.
504

**Response:**

1	# Immutable theme images
2	
3	Eshobe supports two independent deployment strategies on the existing deployment lifecycle:
4	
5	- `coolify_build`: Coolify clones GitHub and builds the manifest's Nixpacks, Dockerfile, static, or Compose source.
6	- `registry_image`: CI builds once, pushes GHCR, registers the resulting digest, and Coolify pulls that exact image.
7	
8	Repository visibility and image visibility are independent. A single deploy target can enable public Git, GitHub App, deploy-key fallback, anonymous registry pulls, and a private GHCR credential reference simultaneously.
9	
10	## Which strategy to use
11	
12	**Prefer `registry_image` for anything a customer sees.** It is the only strategy where
13	the bytes that run in production are provably the bytes that passed preview:
14	
15	| | `registry_image` | `coolify_build` |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| Production publish from the console | Ships the live preview's artifact (same digest) | Rebuilds the live preview's commit; same source, not the same bytes |
18	| «اجرای دوبارهٔ نسخهٔ فعلی» (redeploy) | Reuses the current artifact, no build | Rebuilds the current row's commit |
19	| Rollback | Pulls the old digest, no build | Rebuilds the old commit |
20	| Build load on the Coolify server | None (a pull) | A full build per deploy, preview and production separately |
21	
22	A `coolify_build` deployment resolves a *branch* only when it is asked for one: a
23	`POST …/deployment` without `ref`, or a redeploy with `upgrade: true`, builds
24	`effectiveRefFor` (explicit ref › `pinnedCommit` › `defaultRef` HEAD) at the moment the
25	job runs. The console never does that for production: it sends the preview's commit.
26	A caller of the API that omits `ref` for production gets HEAD, so pass the commit.
27	
28	## Recommended repository workflow
29	
30	A theme repository should run: checkout → validate `eshobe.theme.json` → install → lint → typecheck → tests → build → container smoke test → Docker Buildx → push GHCR → inspect pushed digest → register it with Eshobe. Tags such as the commit SHA, semantic version, branch, and `latest` are useful labels only. Eshobe deploys `ghcr.io/owner/image@sha256:…`; it never uses a mutable tag as production identity.
31	
32	### What has to exist before the first CI run
33	
34	On the CMS (`theme-packages` row):
35	
36	- `deploymentStrategy: registry_image` and `registryProvider: ghcr` (set by manifest sync
37	  from `deployment` in `eshobe.theme.json`, or by hand in the admin);
38	- `repository` equal to the CI repository's `owner/name` (compared case-insensitively);
39	- `registryImageRepository` equal to the image CI pushes, without tag or digest
40	  (`ghcr.io/owner/image`). Anything else is refused with 422.
41	
42	On the CMS server: `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET` in the **web** process environment. Without
43	it the endpoint answers 503 to every callback. Compose files pass an explicit allowlist to
44	`web`, so the variable has to be listed there too. `docker-compose.srv1.yml` lists it; set its
45	value in Komodo and redeploy the stack.
46	
47	In the theme repository, three GitHub Actions secrets:
48	
49	| Secret | Value |
50	|---|---|
51	| `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` | The control-plane origin, e.g. `https://admin.example.com` (`NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL`). **Not** a customer domain: `/api/platform/*` has no Caddy carve-out, so on a customer domain the callback is a 404. |
52	| `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET` | The same value as the CMS server's variable. |
53	| `ESHOBE_THEME_PACKAGE_ID` | The `theme-packages` row's UUID: the id in the admin URL (`/admin/collections/theme-packages/<uuid>`), or `id` in `GET /api/platform/theme-packages`. Not the theme `key`. |
54	
55	`ESHOBE_CMS_URL` here is a CI secret. It shares a name with the runtime variable the platform
56	injects into a deployed container, but CI never sees that one.
57	
58	### Registering the image
59	
60	A minimal step after `docker/build-push-action` (with `id: push`):
61	
62	```yaml
63	- name: Register the image with Eshobe
64	  env:
65	    ESHOBE_CMS_URL: ${{ secrets.ESHOBE_CMS_URL }}
66	    ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET }}
67	    ESHOBE_THEME_PACKAGE_ID: ${{ secrets.ESHOBE_THEME_PACKAGE_ID }}
68	    IMAGE: ghcr.io/owner/theme # must equal the package's registryImageRepository
69	    DIGEST: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
70	  run: |
71	    body=$(jq -cn \
72	      --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
73	      --arg commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --arg image "$IMAGE" --arg digest "$DIGEST" \
74	      --arg runId "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
75	      --arg runUrl "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
76	      '{repository:$repository, ref:$ref, commit:$commit, registry:"ghcr", image:$image,
77	        tag:$commit, digest:$digest, workflowRunId:$runId, workflowRunUrl:$runUrl,
78	        platform:"linux/amd64"}')
79	    sig="sha256=$(printf '%s' "$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET" -hex | sed 's/^.*= //')"
80	    curl --fail-with-body -sS -X POST \
81	      -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "x-eshobe-signature-256: $sig" \
82	      --data-binary "$body" \
83	      "$ESHOBE_CMS_URL/api/platform/theme-packages/$ESHOBE_THEME_PACKAGE_ID/artifacts"
84	```
85	
86	Sign the exact bytes you send. Re-serialising the JSON between signing and sending (a
87	different key order or whitespace) is a 401.
88	
89	The request and its rules:
90	
91	```http
92	POST /api/platform/theme-packages/<package-uuid>/artifacts
93	X-Eshobe-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of exact raw JSON>
94	Content-Type: application/json
95	
96	{
97	  "repository": "owner/theme",
98	  "ref": "main",
99	  "commit": "<40 hex>",
100	  "registry": "ghcr",
101	  "image": "ghcr.io/owner/theme",
102	  "tag": "<commit>",
103	  "digest": "sha256:<64 hex>",
104	  "workflowRunId": "123",
105	  "workflowRunUrl": "https://github.com/owner/theme/actions/runs/123",
106	  "platform": "linux/amd64",
107	  "provenanceAvailable": true,
108	  "sbomAvailable": true
109	}
110	```
111	
112	The signing secret is `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET`. The endpoint is disabled when it is unset. It verifies the signature before parsing, then verifies package, exact source repository, safe ref, commit, exact configured GHCR repository, digest, and workflow URL. Duplicate `(package, commit, digest)` callbacks return the existing row. Client-provided arbitrary images are never accepted.
113	
114	| Status | Meaning |
115	|---|---|
116	| 201 | Registered; `{ ok, artifact, duplicate: false }`. The artifact is `ready` immediately. |
117	| 200 | Already registered; `{ ok, artifact, duplicate: true }`. Safe to retry a callback. |
118	| 400 | Empty body, malformed JSON, or the package id is not a UUID. |
119	| 401 | Signature missing or wrong. |
120	| 404 | No `theme-packages` row with that id. |
121	| 422 | The repository, image repository, ref, commit, digest or workflow URL does not match the package or the expected syntax. |
122	| 503 | `ESHOBE_THEME_ARTIFACT_SECRET` is not set on the CMS server. |
123	
124	A request that carries an `Authorization` header must also be an operator (platform admin
125	session or `role: "platform"` key); the HMAC is still required either way.
126	
127	## Public and private images
128	
129	Image visibility only changes how Coolify pulls the image. The digest pin, the
130	registration callback and every check above are the same either way.
131	
132	- `registryVisibility: public`: Coolify pulls anonymously. The deploy target must allow it
133	  (`publicRegistryPullEnabled`, on by default).
134	- `registryVisibility: private`: the target needs `ghcrEnabled` and `ghcrCredentialUuid`, the
135	  UUID of a registry credential created in Coolify. Eshobe stores only that UUID.
136	
137	Repository visibility is a separate setting. A private source repository still needs
138	`GITHUB_THEME_TOKEN` on the CMS for manifest sync, even when the image is public.
139	
140	The Coolify server must reach `ghcr.io` itself. The CMS accepts only `ghcr.io/…` image
141	references (`GHCR_IMAGE_PATTERN`), so a pull-through mirror such as srv1's
142	`ghcr-mirror.liara.ir` cannot be substituted for a theme image.
143	
144	## Placements and identity
145	
146	A deploy target has a default server and separate preview/production project, environment, and optional server override. Both lanes may use the same project with different environments, different projects, or different servers. An omitted lane server inherits the default.
147	
148	Bindings copy the resolved server, project, and environment when first created. Later edits to target defaults affect only new bindings. Application identity remains `site × package × lane`; it never includes domain, commit, tag, or digest.
149	
150	## Promotion, redeploy, and rollback
151	
152	A registry preview and production can both be queued with the same `artifact` ID. No build occurs between them. `site-deployments` stores the artifact, commit, repository, display tag, and immutable digest.
153	
154	- The console's production publish sends the live preview's `artifact`, so production runs the reviewed digest.
155	- Redeploy without `upgrade: true` reuses the current artifact.
156	- Upgrade selects the ready artifact for the package's pinned commit, otherwise its synced commit.
157	- Rollback selects the old deployment's artifact and digest; it does not rebuild.
158	- A newly detected GitHub commit is not deployable until a ready artifact for that exact commit exists.
159	- GitHub push only syncs metadata. It never deploys production.
160	
161	All strategies share binding resolution, runtime environment injection, Coolify deployment polling, health checking, stale-site/domain checks, and promotion. Site API keys and tenant secrets are runtime values and are not baked into reusable images.
162	
163	### How the digest reaches Coolify
164	
165	One digest pin, two wire shapes — Coolify's create and update routes validate
166	`docker_registry_image_name` differently:
167	
168	- **Create** (`POST /applications/dockerimage`): the full reference
169	  `ghcr.io/owner/repo@sha256:<64 hex>` in the name field, empty tag. Coolify parses
170	  and normalizes it itself.
171	- **Re-point** (`PATCH /applications/{uuid}`): the stored shape — name
172	  `ghcr.io/owner/repo@sha256` (the bare repository plus Coolify's own `@sha256`
173	  marker), the bare 64-hex hash in `docker_registry_image_tag`. The full reference
174	  here is a 422 (`docker_registry_image_name is invalid`), and the PATCH allowlist
175	  also rejects `project_uuid`, `server_uuid`, `environment_name`,
176	  `docker_registry_uuid`, `github_app_uuid` and `private_key_uuid` with «This field
177	  is not allowed» — placement is chosen once at create and never moved by re-point.
178	
179	Both live in `src/deploy/coolify.ts` (`digestReferenceForCreate`,
180	`digestPinForPatch`, `repointApplication`), which is the only place allowed to know
181	these shapes. The container health check Coolify generates is pinned to
182	`health_check_host: 127.0.0.1` (an IPv4 loopback — its `localhost` default resolves
183	to `::1` on IPv6-first images and the container is declared unhealthy) with the
184	manifest's `build.healthCheckPath` and port.
185	
186	A registry row that reaches the queue without its artifact link is repaired by
187	`runDeployment` before anything plans from it: the ready artifact for its commit is
188	resolved and written back (with `ref` and preview hostname if those are missing
189	too). The refusal «برای این کامیت هنوز تصویر آماده و تأییدشده‌ای وجود ندارد» now
190	means exactly what it says — no ready artifact exists for that commit.
191	
192	## Deploy-target examples
193	
194	Same project, different environments:
195	
196	```text
197	Project Eshobe Themes / preview
198	Project Eshobe Themes / production
199	```
200	
201	Different projects:
202	
203	```text
204	Eshobe Preview / preview
205	Eshobe Production / production
206	```
207	
208	Different servers use `previewServerUuid` or `productionServerUuid`; null inherits `defaultServerUuid`.
209	
210	For private repositories prefer GitHub App, then deploy key. For private GHCR, configure the credential in Coolify and store only its UUID in Eshobe. No GitHub or GHCR token belongs on a theme package, artifact, or deployment row.
