/**
 * Parse and validate a manifest object.
 *
 * `platformContractVersion` is `contractVersion` from `@eshobe/site-runtime` — passed
 * in rather than imported so this file stays dependency-free and the spec can drive
 * both sides of the comparison.
 */
export const parseThemeManifest = (
  input: unknown,
  platformContractVersion: number,
): ManifestParse => {
  const errors: string[] = []

  if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) {
    return { errors: ['فایل eshobe.theme.json باید یک شیء JSON باشد.'], ok: false }
  }

  const row = input as Record<string, unknown>

  const name = str(row.name)
  if (!name) errors.push('«name» الزامی است.')

  const key = manifestKey(row.key ?? name)
  if (!key) errors.push('«key» الزامی است و باید با حروف انگلیسی نوشته شود.')

  const contractRaw = row.contractVersion
  const contractVersion = typeof contractRaw === 'number' ? contractRaw : Number(contractRaw)
  if (!Number.isInteger(contractVersion) || contractVersion < 1) {
    errors.push('«contractVersion» الزامی است و باید عدد صحیح باشد.')
  } else if (contractVersion > platformContractVersion) {
    // The whole point of the version existing. A theme written against a newer
    // contract will read fields this deployment does not emit, and the failure would
    // otherwise surface as a blank storefront on a customer's domain.
    errors.push(
      `این پوسته برای نسخهٔ قرارداد ${contractVersion} نوشته شده و این نصب نسخهٔ ${platformContractVersion} را ارائه می‌کند. ابتدا CMS را به‌روزرسانی کنید.`,
    )
  }

  const siteTypesRaw = row.siteTypes
  let siteTypes: ThemeSiteType[] = [...THEME_SITE_TYPES]
  if (siteTypesRaw !== undefined) {
    if (!Array.isArray(siteTypesRaw)) {
      errors.push('«siteTypes» باید آرایه باشد.')
    } else {
      const unknown = siteTypesRaw.filter(
        (value) => !(THEME_SITE_TYPES as readonly unknown[]).includes(value),
      )
      if (unknown.length) {
        errors.push(`نوع سایت ناشناخته: ${unknown.map(String).join('، ')}.`)
      }
      siteTypes = siteTypesRaw.filter((value): value is ThemeSiteType =>
        (THEME_SITE_TYPES as readonly unknown[]).includes(value),
      )
      if (!siteTypes.length) errors.push('«siteTypes» نباید خالی باشد.')
    }
  }

  const localesRaw = row.locales
  const locales =
    Array.isArray(localesRaw) && localesRaw.length
      ? localesRaw.map((value) => String(value).trim()).filter(Boolean)
      : ['fa']

  const capabilitiesRaw = row.capabilities
  const capabilities: Record<string, boolean> = {}
  if (capabilitiesRaw && typeof capabilitiesRaw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(capabilitiesRaw)) {
    for (const [name_, value] of Object.entries(capabilitiesRaw as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      capabilities[name_] = value === true
    }
  }

  const build = parseBuild(row.build, errors)
  const deployment = parseDeployment(row.deployment, errors)
  const env = parseEnv(row.env, errors)
  const settings = parseSettings(row.settings, errors)
  const contentSlots = parseContentSlots(row.contentSlots, errors)
  const design = parseDesign(row.design, errors)

  const previewUrl = str(row.preview) ?? str(row.previewUrl)
  if (previewUrl && !/^https:\/\//i.test(previewUrl)) {
    errors.push('«preview» باید یک نشانی https باشد.')
  }

  if (errors.length) return { errors, ok: false }

## Section 2 of 4 — Design system translation and `DESIGN.md`

The committed `DESIGN.md` will be the design contract, not decoration: machine-readable frontmatter (the snapshot's YAML shape) plus human sections, and every UI edit starts from it.

**What we take vs. make original**

| Reference trait | Our adaptation |
|---|---|
| Ink `#171717` primary CTA, near-white canvas, 1px hairlines | Kept as the neutral core, tokenised |
| Four-step surface ladder (white / 98% / 95% / polarity-flipped ink band) | Kept; the inverted band becomes a semantic token pair that self-flips in dark mode |
| Multi-stop mesh gradient as the only decoration, hero scale only | **Original** CSS multi-radial composition using our own stops/geometry (blue→cyan / violet→magenta / coral→amber family), never a copy of Vercel's SVG |
| Geist / Geist Mono (proprietary-cut) | **Vazirmatn** for Persian (Eshobe standard) + **Inter Variable** for Latin + **JetBrains Mono** for technical eyebrows/code, all openly licensed and bundled locally, `ss01/ss02` geometric alternates. No Vercel font binaries, marks, copy, or screenshots |
| Aggressive negative display tracking | Applied to Latin only. **Persian is exempt**: no negative letter-spacing on connected script, body line-height 1.8, display line-height ~1.25 |
| 4px spacing, 1400px container, 600px/960px/1200px/1400px breakpoints | Kept; section rhythm 96–128px desktop → 56–64px mobile |
| Stacked shadows L1–L5 + inset hairline | Kept; dark mode swaps the ring to `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |
| Radius scale 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100 pill | Theme owns the scale; CMS `radius` setting maps to control/card radius only. Marketing CTAs stay pill, nav CTAs 6px — deliberately two scales, as the reference itself does |

**Dark mode**: full token parity, not an inversion filter. canvas `#0a0a0a` → soft `#111` → soft-2 `#171717`, ink `#ededed`, body `#a1a1a1`, hairline `#262626`. Featured pricing cards and dark bands flip polarity in both directions. Default follows `prefers-color-scheme` with a manual toggle persisted; no flash (class set pre-hydration).

**Type, numerals, dates**: every number goes through `formatNumber`/`formatPrice`, every date through `formatDate` (Jalali, Asia/Tehran), phone input normalised with `toAsciiDigits`, display with `toLocaleDigits`. No raw `toLocaleDateString()`, no Latin digits leaking into Persian copy.

**Components** (the reusable primitives the blocks compose): sticky 64px nav + mobile overlay menu + locale/theme switches; buttons (primary pill / secondary / ghost / sm-md-lg) with hover-focus-pressed-disabled; badge + mono eyebrow; marketing card + soft card + mockup chrome; section header; feature grid; pricing card + featured; testimonial; FAQ accordion (Radix, keyboard-complete); logo strip; announcement banner; inputs/select/textarea with error + helper text; submit states (idle/loading/success/error); footer; CTA band.

**Motion**: 150–250ms state transitions, scroll reveals with ≤80ms stagger, transform/opacity only, no parallax, no infinite loops, no layout-shift animations. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it, including hover transforms.

**Accessibility floor**: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible 2px focus ring with offset, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls` on nav and accordion, labelled fields with `aria-describedby` errors and `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, RTL via logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).

**Deterministic checks instead of "make it Vercel-like"**: token-parity test (CSS ↔ TS mirror), raw-hex/arbitrary-value lint, logical-property lint, axe + keyboard specs, and visual snapshots at mobile/tablet/desktop × fa/en × light/dark.

## Section 3 of 4 — Page system, block→section resolution, data flow

**Routes & bindings.** Default locale unprefixed (`/`), English prefixed (`/en/...`); a locale not in `availableLocales` is a 404, never a duplicated page. Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`. Each resolves via `themeRuntime.bindings` by slot ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug` etc.), and a missing binding is a 404 — no bundled fallback copy. Nav comes from the `header` global, footer links from `footer` (the contract exposes only `navItems` there, so footer columns are built from those plus brand/contact data already in CMS; I will not invent CMS fields).

| Contract block | Rendered section | Variant rule |
|---|---|---|
| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | first `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop, link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary); last → inverted CTA band; else inline |
| `mediaBlock` | product showcase / editorial figure | directly after a hero → 16:10 mockup chrome with stacked shadow; else sized by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with a viewport cap |
| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` honoured 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky` (scroll reveal, disabled with reduced motion) |
| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan gets polarity-flipped card in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit`, never invented |
| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted, never placeholder quotes |
| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |
| `logos` | logo strip | monochrome via `logosMonochrome` setting, hover restores colour |
| `content`, `gallery`, `team`, `contact` | editorial columns / grid / team / contact card | lexical `direction` respected per field |
| `formBlock` | CMS form | renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim; nothing added except a hidden honeypot |
| `archive` | deferred (blog is a later issue phase) | dev warning, null in production |

Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically, with inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA. Unknown `blockType` logs and renders nothing, per contract.

**Data flow.** Server-only. One cached `GET /api/site` per request validates `contractVersion`, media origin and locales; page + header/footer fetched with the site key and explicit `_status=published`. Drafts only in preview (Next `draftMode()` **and** non-canonical host), which flips reads to `no-store`, `draft=true`, and `noindex`. Production reads are tagged (`tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`) with 30–60s revalidate. `/api/revalidate` verifies the raw-body HMAC + timestamp tolerance, caps at 64KB, purges tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s. `/api/[...segments]` proxies only the allowlisted CMS heads, drops visitor cookies/auth, and keeps the key server-side. Media URLs resolve against `site.media.origin`; SVGs render via `<img>`, never inlined.

**Forms.** The demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions` (tenant derived server-side from the form doc — never client-selectable), with inline validation, Persian-digit normalisation, required consent checkbox, honeypot, preserved values on failure, retry, and `aria-live` status. CRM handoff, attribution and funnel analytics stay Stage 3; no stubbed integration pretending to exist.

**Failure states.** Themed 404; 503 with retry when the CMS is unreachable and nothing is cached; suspended/archived sites render the contract's holding page (200, `noindex`); contract-version mismatch fails loudly; empty CMS blocks omit their section.

**Test/verification loop.** Vitest for resolver/variant/draft/HMAC/token-parity/manifest; Playwright against the fixture CMS for home and all four landing pages at 3 breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark, keyboard nav, mobile menu, theme persistence, form validation/submit, reduced motion, axe, and an RTL overflow assertion (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`). Generated mockups live only under `public/demo/`, served exclusively by the fixture provider and labelled illustrative — production renders CMS media, so no fabricated imagery or claims ship in theme code.

One deliberate deferral to flag: the issue lists an "announcement" primitive, but neither `header` nor `page` exposes a localized announcement field, and manifest settings are single-language. I'd defer it rather than ship a Persian-only banner on the English site. Acceptable?

/**
 * Draft policy, applied in one place.
 *
 * A site API key is allowed to read drafts for its tenant. Public rendering must therefore
 * exclude them explicitly instead of relying on anonymous access rules — otherwise
 * unpublished content would leak onto a production page. In preview the filter is dropped
 * deliberately.
 */
export function applyDraftPolicy(
  ctx: CmsContext,
  options: CmsQuery,
  params: Record<string, QueryValue>,
): Record<string, QueryValue> {
  const wantsDrafts = Boolean(options.drafts) && ctx.allowDrafts
  if (wantsDrafts) {
    params['draft'] = 'true'
    return params
  }
  params['draft'] = 'false'
  // Published-explicitly collections only; see `CmsQuery.publishFilter`.
  if (options.publishFilter !== false) params['where[_status][equals]'] = 'published'
  return params
}

export type CmsJson<T> = {
  data: T
  status: number
}

/** Low-level read. Returns the parsed body with its status so callers can map 404 to null. */
export async function cmsFetchJson<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<CmsJson<T>> {
  const ctx = await getCmsContext()
  const params = { ...(options.query ?? {}) }
  if (options.locale) params['locale'] = options.locale
  applyDraftPolicy(ctx, options, params)
  const queryString = buildQueryString(params)
  const url = `${ctx.baseUrl}${path}${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`
  const tags = cacheTags({
    tenantKey: ctx.tenantKey,
    locale: options.locale,
    resource: options.resource,
  })

  if (ctx.mode === 'fixture') {
    const fixture = fixtureFetch<T>(path, params)
    if (!fixture) throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, `fixture: no handler for ${path}`)
    return fixture
  }

  const init: RequestInit & { next?: { revalidate?: number; tags?: string[] } } = {
    headers: {
      accept: 'application/json',
      // Never forwarded from a visitor; only the platform-injected site key travels here.
      ...(ctx.env.apiKey ? { authorization: `Bearer ${ctx.env.apiKey}` } : {}),
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
  }
  if (ctx.preview) {
    init.cache = 'no-store'
  } else {
    init.cache = 'force-cache'
    init.next = { revalidate: options.revalidate ?? CONTENT_REVALIDATE_SECONDS, tags }
  }

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(url, init)
  } catch (cause) {
    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'network error'
    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 0, `CMS unreachable: ${message}`)
  }

  if (response.status === 404) return { data: undefined as T, status: 404 }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = await safeErrorMessage(response)
    throw new CmsRequestError(path, response.status, detail)
  }
  const data = (await response.json()) as T
  return { data, status: response.status }
}

import { t } from '@/lib/i18n/ui'

type State = 'idle' | 'pending' | 'sent' | 'error'

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
const PHONE = /^0?9\d{9}$/

function fieldName(field: FormField): string {
  return typeof field.name === 'string' ? field.name : ''
}

function labelOf(field: FormField, name: string): string {
  const label = field.label
  return typeof label === 'string' && label.trim() !== '' ? label.trim() : name
}

function validate(fields: FormField[], values: Record<string, string>, locale: string): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const field of fields) {
    const name = fieldName(field)
    if (name === '') continue
    const value = values[name] ?? ''
    if (field.required && value.trim() === '') {
      errors[name] = t('requiredField', locale)
      continue
    }
    if (value.trim() === '') continue
    if (field.blockType === 'email' && !EMAIL.test(value.trim())) errors[name] = t('invalidEmail', locale)
    if (/phone/i.test(name) && !PHONE.test(toAsciiDigits(value).replace(/[\s()-]/g, ''))) {
      errors[name] = t('invalidPhone', locale)
    }
  }
  return errors
}

  2048 characters.

- runtime settings are generated from the manifest's closed schema and take effect immediately without a deployment;
- content selectors are generated from `contentSlots`, and every selected relationship is checked against the same tenant;
- the raw `site-theme-settings` collection's create/update are platform-only.

922	  foreground?: string | null
923	  radius?: "none"|"sm"|"md"|"lg"|null
924	  lineHeight?: number|null    // 1.4..2.4, default 1.8
925	}
926	```
927	
928	### How Tokens Become CSS
929	`src/lib/theme.ts` → `themeCss(theme: Theme|null): string`
930	
931	```ts
932	import { themeCss } from '@eshobe/site-runtime/theme' // or '@/lib/theme'
933	// In <head>:
934	<style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeCss(site.theme) }} />
935	```
936	
937	Output:
938	```css
939	body{--primary:#0f766e;--primary-foreground:oklch(...);--accent:#f59e0b;--accent-foreground:...;--radius:0.625rem;--line-height:1.8;}
940	html:not([data-theme='dark']) body{--background:#ffffff;--foreground:#0a0a0a;}
941	```
942	- Colors validated `isHexColor` — non-hex dropped (no injection: stray `}` would rewrite page CSS).
943	- `readableOn(hex)` computes WCAG luminance threshold (0.179) → picks black/white foreground for brand colors.
944	- Tailwind v4's `@theme inline` maps `var(--primary)` → `bg-primary`, `text-primary`, `border-primary`, `ring-primary`, etc.
945	
946	Tailwind config: all logical utilities only. Never use `ml-*`, `pl-*`, `text-left` — `eslint.config.mjs` bans them. Use `ms-*`, `ps-*`, `text-start/end`. `rtl:`/`ltr:` variants only where direction genuinely differs.
947	
948	**Global CSS tokens** you can rely on (from `globals.css` `@theme`):
949	
950	```
951	--primary, --primary-foreground
952	--accent, --accent-foreground
953	--background / --foreground
954	--card, --card-foreground
955	--muted, --muted-foreground
956	--border, --input, --ring
957	--radius, --radius-sm|md|lg|xl
958	--line-height
959	```
960	
961	Emit `themeCss` on `body` scope — no rebuild when editor saves.
962	
963	### Applying in a Headless Theme
964	
965	```tsx
966	// layout.tsx
967	const site = await fetchSite() // GET /api/site with Host
968	return (
969	  <html lang={locale} dir={dirFor(locale)}>
970	    <head><style>{themeCss(site.theme)}</style></head>
971	    <body className="bg-background text-foreground leading-[var(--line-height)]">
972	      {children}
973	    </body>
974	  </html>
975	)
976	```
977	
978	Or vanilla HTML:

981	  import { themeCss } from 'https://cms.example.com/site-runtime/theme.js'
982	  const site = await fetch('/api/site').then(r=>r.json())

## Section 3 of 4 — Page system, block→section resolution, data flow

**Routes & bindings.** Default locale unprefixed (`/`), English prefixed (`/en/...`); a locale not in `availableLocales` is a 404, never a duplicated page. Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`. Each resolves via `themeRuntime.bindings` by slot ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug` etc.), and a missing binding is a 404 — no bundled fallback copy. Nav comes from the `header` global, footer links from `footer` (the contract exposes only `navItems` there, so footer columns are built from those plus brand/contact data already in CMS; I will not invent CMS fields).

| Contract block | Rendered section | Variant rule |
|---|---|---|
| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | first `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop, link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary); last → inverted CTA band; else inline |
| `mediaBlock` | product showcase / editorial figure | directly after a hero → 16:10 mockup chrome with stacked shadow; else sized by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with a viewport cap |
| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` honoured 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky` (scroll reveal, disabled with reduced motion) |
| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan gets polarity-flipped card in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit`, never invented |
| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted, never placeholder quotes |
| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |
| `logos` | logo strip | monochrome via `logosMonochrome` setting, hover restores colour |
| `content`, `gallery`, `team`, `contact` | editorial columns / grid / team / contact card | lexical `direction` respected per field |
| `formBlock` | CMS form | renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim; nothing added except a hidden honeypot |
| `archive` | deferred (blog is a later issue phase) | dev warning, null in production |

Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically, with inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA. Unknown `blockType` logs and renders nothing, per contract.

**Data flow.** Server-only. One cached `GET /api/site` per request validates `contractVersion`, media origin and locales; page + header/footer fetched with the site key and explicit `_status=published`. Drafts only in preview (Next `draftMode()` **and** non-canonical host), which flips reads to `no-store`, `draft=true`, and `noindex`. Production reads are tagged (`tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`) with 30–60s revalidate. `/api/revalidate` verifies the raw-body HMAC + timestamp tolerance, caps at 64KB, purges tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s. `/api/[...segments]` proxies only the allowlisted CMS heads, drops visitor cookies/auth, and keeps the key server-side. Media URLs resolve against `site.media.origin`; SVGs render via `<img>`, never inlined.

**Forms.** The demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions` (tenant derived server-side from the form doc — never client-selectable), with inline validation, Persian-digit normalisation, required consent checkbox, honeypot, preserved values on failure, retry, and `aria-live` status. CRM handoff, attribution and funnel analytics stay Stage 3; no stubbed integration pretending to exist.

**Failure states.** Themed 404; 503 with retry when the CMS is unreachable and nothing is cached; suspended/archived sites render the contract's holding page (200, `noindex`); contract-version mismatch fails loudly; empty CMS blocks omit their section.

**Test/verification loop.** Vitest for resolver/variant/draft/HMAC/token-parity/manifest; Playwright against the fixture CMS for home and all four landing pages at 3 breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark, keyboard nav, mobile menu, theme persistence, form validation/submit, reduced motion, axe, and an RTL overflow assertion (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`). Generated mockups live only under `public/demo/`, served exclusively by the fixture provider and labelled illustrative — production renders CMS media, so no fabricated imagery or claims ship in theme code.

One deliberate deferral to flag: the issue lists an "announcement" primitive, but neither `header` nor `page` exposes a localized announcement field, and manifest settings are single-language. I'd defer it rather than ship a Persian-only banner on the English site. Acceptable?

/**
 * Draft policy, applied in one place.
 *
 * A site API key is allowed to read drafts for its tenant. Public rendering must therefore
 * exclude them explicitly instead of relying on anonymous access rules — otherwise
 * unpublished content would leak onto a production page. In preview the filter is dropped
 * deliberately.
 */
export function applyDraftPolicy(
  ctx: CmsContext,
  options: CmsQuery,
  params: Record<string, QueryValue>,
): Record<string, QueryValue> {
  const wantsDrafts = Boolean(options.drafts) && ctx.allowDrafts
  if (wantsDrafts) {
    params['draft'] = 'true'
    return params
  }
  params['draft'] = 'false'
  // Published-explicitly collections only; see `CmsQuery.publishFilter`.
  if (options.publishFilter !== false) params['where[_status][equals]'] = 'published'
  return params
}

export type CmsJson<T> = {
  data: T
  status: number
}

/** Low-level read. Returns the parsed body with its status so callers can map 404 to null. */
export async function cmsFetchJson<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<CmsJson<T>> {
  const ctx = await getCmsContext()
  const params = { ...(options.query ?? {}) }
  if (options.locale) params['locale'] = options.locale
  applyDraftPolicy(ctx, options, params)
  const queryString = buildQueryString(params)
  const url = `${ctx.baseUrl}${path}${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`
  const tags = cacheTags({
    tenantKey: ctx.tenantKey,
    locale: options.locale,
    resource: options.resource,
  })

  if (ctx.mode === 'fixture') {
    const fixture = fixtureFetch<T>(path, params)
    if (!fixture) throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, `fixture: no handler for ${path}`)
    return fixture
  }

  const init: RequestInit & { next?: { revalidate?: number; tags?: string[] } } = {
    headers: {
      accept: 'application/json',
      // Never forwarded from a visitor; only the platform-injected site key travels here.
      ...(ctx.env.apiKey ? { authorization: `Bearer ${ctx.env.apiKey}` } : {}),
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
  }
  if (ctx.preview) {
    init.cache = 'no-store'
  } else {
    init.cache = 'force-cache'
    init.next = { revalidate: options.revalidate ?? CONTENT_REVALIDATE_SECONDS, tags }
  }

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(url, init)
  } catch (cause) {
    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'network error'
    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 0, `CMS unreachable: ${message}`)
  }

  if (response.status === 404) return { data: undefined as T, status: 404 }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = await safeErrorMessage(response)
    throw new CmsRequestError(path, response.status, detail)
  }
  const data = (await response.json()) as T
  return { data, status: response.status }
}

const PHONE = /^0?9\d{9}$/

function fieldName(field: FormField): string {
  return typeof field.name === 'string' ? field.name : ''
}

function labelOf(field: FormField, name: string): string {
  const label = field.label
  return typeof label === 'string' && label.trim() !== '' ? label.trim() : name

function validate(fields: FormField[], values: Record<string, string>, locale: string): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const field of fields) {
    const name = fieldName(field)
    if (name === '') continue
    const value = values[name] ?? ''
    if (field.required && value.trim() === '') {
      errors[name] = t('requiredField', locale)
      continue

    if (value.trim() === '') continue

      errors[name] = t('invalidPhone', locale)
    }
  }
  return errors

### `media` — uploads
`access: read = scopedPublicRead(anyone)` (public, Host-scoped). Tenant-isolated via `setMediaPrefix` (object-storage key `sites/<id>/media/<filename>`). Local dev serves from `public/media` or `MEDIA_DIR`.

| Field | Type |

| `alt` | text, localized |
| `caption` | richText lexical, localized |

| `folder` | relation `payload-folders` |

Accepted types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, and **SVG** that passes the allowlist in `src/lib/svg.ts` (anything with script, `<image>`, `<a>`, `<foreignObject>`, animation or an external reference is refused with a Persian reason). SVG has no `sizes`.

Image sizes: `thumbnail 300w`, `square 500×500`, `small 600w`, `medium 900w`, `large 1400w`, `xlarge 1920w`, `og 1200×630 crop:center`.

const src = new URL(media.url!, site.media.origin).toString()
// or a size: media.sizes?.medium?.url → new URL(size.url!, site.media.origin)

| `parent` | relation `categories` self |
| `breadcrumbs` | array {doc, url, label} auto via `nestedDocsPlugin` |

- an admin **session** only; the caller must be a member of that site (or platform staff).

- secrets are write-only: encrypted at rest, masked on every read (an `afterRead` hook the

  means *unchanged*; «حذف مقدار ذخیره‌شده» is the explicit clear.
- runtime settings are generated from the manifest's closed schema and take effect immediately without a deployment;
- content selectors are generated from `contentSlots`, and every selected relationship is checked against the same tenant;
- the raw `site-theme-settings` collection's create/update are platform-only.

Environment values take effect on the next deployment. Runtime settings and bindings trigger

## Section 4 of 4 — i18n/RTL, performance, delivery, risks

**i18n & RTL mechanics.** Locale comes from the path only (`fa` unprefixed, `en` prefixed); `dir` is derived per request, never hardcoded. Chrome strings (nav, form status, 404, footer labels) live in a typed `fa`/`en` dictionary; content strings come from CMS. Enumeration queries use `fallbackLocale=false` so an untranslated page is never advertised under a URL that 404s; field-level fallback stays on. Mixed-direction lexical content gets its own `dir` plus `unicode-bidi: plaintext`. Persian gets Vazirmatn, 1.8 body leading, zero letter-spacing, Persian digits and Jalali dates; Latin gets Inter/Mono with the negative tracking. Layout uses logical utilities only, enforced by an ESLint rule.

**Performance.** Server components by default; client JS limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, FAQ accordion, form, and the reveal observer. No animation library — CSS transitions plus one IntersectionObserver. Self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload for the two primary faces, so Docker builds stay offline and deterministic. `next/image` against the CMS media origin with explicit `sizes`; hero mesh is CSS/SVG, not an image. Budgets: no layout-shift animations, CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, and every section must work with JS disabled except the menu/theme/FAQ/form islands.

**Delivery.** Next 16 + React 19 + Tailwind v4, `output: 'standalone'`, non-root multi-stage `node:22-alpine` image, `PORT=3000`, healthcheck on `127.0.0.1/api/health`. Manifest declares `build` + `healthCheckPath`, `siteTypes: ["business"]`, `locales: ["fa","en"]`, `proxiesApi: true`, `env: []` (all ESHOBE vars are platform-injected), a small closed settings schema (`heroTreatment`, `featureTreatment`, `showcaseTreatment`, `logosMonochrome`, plus route-slug fallbacks), and five `contentSlots`. No `deployment` block → Coolify build strategy, so nothing must be pre-registered in GHCR for this pass.

**Biza Miz content.** Theme code stays tenant-neutral. Biza Miz copy, page structures, forms and nav ship as a **content pack** (`demo-packs/biza-miz/`: page JSON, form schema, header/footer links) plus an idempotent import script that only uses what a site key may write (pages, forms, header/footer) — media must be uploaded by an editor, because a site key cannot create media. The local fixture provider mirrors the pack and serves the generated mockups from `public/demo/`, each labelled illustrative. That's how Stage 2 is demoable without pretending a live integration exists.

**Verification.** `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build. Playwright suite against fixtures covers the five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark, plus keyboard, reduced motion, axe, RTL overflow, form success/failure, and visual snapshots. Manifest validated by a unit test mirroring the CMS parser rules (exact keys, enum values, `contractVersion: 1`, binding IDs).

**Explicitly out of scope this pass** (Stage 3/4): live lead handoff/CRM, attribution and funnel analytics, Biza Miz catalogue price sourcing, wallet/signup links, sitemap/robots, production preview→health→release→rollback, GHCR artifact workflow, and full visual-regression baselines.

**Known risks**: live DesignMD page returned 429 (reconciliation deferred, deviations to be recorded); generated mockups conflict with "authentic visuals" (contained to fixtures + labels); `@eshobe/site-runtime` unpublished (vendored workspace package); no real tenant available (fixtures + import script instead of claiming a deployed result); form spam protection is honeypot-only until Stage 3 adds rate limiting.

If this holds, I'll write the spec to `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-24-eshobe-corporation-theme-design.md`, self-review it, and commit it for your review before we move to the implementation plan.

Stacked offsets only, always with inset ring.\n- **Token parity**: CSS variables and a TS mirror are asserted by a unit test.\n\n### 3.3 Components\n\nNav (sticky 64px, mobile overlay, locale/theme switches), buttons (primary pill, secondary, ghost; sm/md/lg; full state matrix), badge + mono eyebrow, marketing/soft cards, product mockup chrome, section header, feature grid, sticky-stack band, pricing card + featured, testimonial card, FAQ accordion, logo strip, announcement primitive (deferred in pages), inputs/select/textarea with helper and error text, submit states (idle/pending/sent/error), contact card, CTA band, footer.\n\n### 3.4 Motion, accessibility, performance\n\n- Motion: 150–250ms state transitions; scroll reveals ≤80ms stagger; transform/opacity only; no parallax, infinite loops, or layout-shift animation. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it.\n- Accessibility: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible focus ring, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls`, labelled fields with `aria-describedby`, `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).\n- Performance: server components by default; client islands limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, accordion, form, reveal observer; no animation library; self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload; `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; CSS hero mesh. Budgets: CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms; sections usable without JS except the islands.\n\n## 4. Architecture\n\n### 4.1 Repository layout\n\n```text\neshobe-corporation-theme/\n├── eshobe.theme.json\n├── DESIGN.md\n├── AGENTS.md\n├── README.md\n├── Dockerfile\n├── package.json / pnpm-workspace.yaml\n├── demo-packs/biza-miz/           # page JSON, form schema, nav links, import script\n├── packages/site-runtime/         # vendored @eshobe/site-runtime workspace package\n├── public/\n│   ├── demo/                      # fixture-only generated mockups, labelled illustrative\n│   └── fonts/                     # Vazirmatn, Inter, JetBrains Mono + licenses\n├── src/\n│   ├── app/[[...path]]/           # resolve → dispatch → RouteShell\n│   ├── app/api/health/\n│   ├── app/api/revalidate/\n│   ├── app/api/[...segments]/     # allowlisted CMS proxy\n│   ├── app/api/exit-preview/\n│   ├── cms/                       # client, site descriptor, typed queries, draft policy, cache tags\n│   ├── sections/                  # hero, showcase, feature-grid, sticky-stack, pricing, logos, testimonial, faq, cta, form, media, editorial, gallery, team, contact\n│   ├── blocks/                    # blockType → section + variant resolver\n│   ├── components/                # ui primitives, nav, footer, mockup chrome\n│   ├── lib/{i18n,routing,theme,seo,media}\n│   └── styles/                    # globals.css @theme tokens, fonts.css\n└── tests/{unit,browser,fixtures}\n```\n\n### 4.2 Routes and bindings\n\n- `fa` is unprefixed; `en` is prefixed (`/en/...`). A locale absent from `availableLocales` is a 404. `dir` derives per request.\n- Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`.\n- Each route resolves `themeRuntime.bindings[slot]` by page ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`). A missing binding is a 404; no bundled fallback copy.\n- Page content is fetched by ID/slug with `depth=2` (single doc), media resolved via `site.media.origin`, and header/footer globals fetched in parallel.\n- Nav comes from the `header` global. Footer columns use `footer.navItems` plus brand/contact data already in CMS; no invented CMS fields.\n\n### 4.3 Block → section resolution\n\n| Contract block | Section | Variant rule |\n|---|---|---|\n| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | First `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop; link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary). Last → inverted CTA band. Else inline |\n| `mediaBlock` | showcase / editorial figure | Immediately after hero → 16:10 mockup chrome; else framed by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with viewport cap |\n| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky`, disabled under reduced motion |\n| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan polarity-flipped in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit` |\n| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted |\n| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |\n| `logos` | logo strip | Monochrome via `logosMonochrome`, colour on hover |\n| `content` | editorial columns | Lexical `direction` per field, `unicode-bidi: plaintext` |\n| `gallery` | image grid | Columns from block |\n| `team` | team grid | CMS members only |\n| `contact` | contact card | Phones via `toLocaleDigits` |\n| `formBlock` | CMS form | Renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim plus hidden honeypot |\n| `archive` | deferred | Dev warning, null in production |\n\n- Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically; inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA.\n- Unknown `blockType`: log and render nothing. Never invent a block type.\n\n### 4.4 Manifest\n\n- `contractVersion: 1`, `key: \"eshobe-corporation\"`, `name: \"Eshobe Corporation\"`, `nameFa`, `siteTypes: [\"business\"]`, `locales: [\"fa\",\"en\"]`.\n- `capabilities`: `rtlFirst`, `multiLocale`, `pageBuilderBlocks`, `forms`.\n- `design`: Vercel-derived defaults.\n- `build`: `dockerfile`, port 3000, `healthCheckPath: \"/api/health\"`, `isStatic: false`; no `deployment` block (Coolify build strategy).\n- `env: []` (all `ESHOBE_*` variables are platform-injected).\n- `settings`: `heroTreatment` (mesh|plain), `featureTreatment` (cards|sticky), `showcaseTreatment` (mockup|editorial), `logosMonochrome` (boolean), `restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`.\n- `contentSlots`: `home`, `restaurants`, `pricing`, `features`, `demo`.\n\n## 5. Data flow, caching, preview, security\n\n- **Bootstrap**: one cached `GET /api/site` per request (key-authenticated) validates `contractVersion`, media origin, locales, settings, bindings.\n- **Tenancy**: every CMS call uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`; never a rewritten `Host` (loops back into the theme container). No `?site=` anywhere. The key never reaches the browser.\n- **Draft policy**: centralized. A site key can read drafts, so public rendering always sends `draft=false` and `where[_status][equals]=published` (except globals where the contract excludes status). Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then uses `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.\n- **Cache**: `force-cache`, site 30s / content 60s, tags `cms:all` and `tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`.\n- **Revalidation**: `POST /api/revalidate` verifies raw-body HMAC-SHA256 (`x-eshobe-signature`), timestamp tolerance, 64KB cap, purges payload tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s.\n- **Proxy**: `/api/[...segments]` allowlists CMS heads (`site, pages, posts, products, categories, header, footer, forms, form-submissions, search, media, theme, store, checkout, payments, redirects, globals`), drops visitor cookies/auth, refuses recursion, and forwards to the CMS with its own host.\n- **Media**: URLs resolved against `site.media.origin`; SVGs via `<img>`, never inline; remote patterns restricted to the CMS origin.\n\n## 6. Forms\n\nThe demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions`:\n\n```json\n{ \"form\": \"<formId>\", \"submissionData\": [{ \"field\": \"name\", \"value\": \"…\" }] }\n```\n\n- Tenant is derived server-side from the form document; the client cannot choose it.\n- Required consent checkbox; inline validation with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; Persian-digit normalisation via `toAsciiDigits`; values preserved on failure; disabled submit while pending; success/error announced via `aria-live`; retry control.\n- Hidden honeypot; spam rate-limiting is deferred to Stage 3.\n- CRM handoff, attribution and analytics are **not** implemented in this pass.\n\n## 7. Failure states\n\n| Condition | Behaviour |\n|---|---|\n| Unknown route | Themed 404, `noindex` |\n| Missing binding | 404, no bundled copy |\n| CMS unreachable | Cached content when available; else themed 503 with retry; health endpoint stays local |\n| Site suspended/archived | Contract holding page, HTTP 200, `noindex` |\n| Contract version mismatch | Loud developer-facing error page; no silent render |\n| Empty collection block | Section omitted |\n| Premium/featured content | No placeholder testimonials, logos, metrics, or prices |\n\n## 8. Biza Miz content\n\n- Theme code stays tenant-neutral; Biza Miz copy, page structures, nav links and form schema ship in `demo-packs/biza-miz/`.\n- An idempotent import script uses only capabilities a site key has (pages, posts, forms, header/footer). Media must be uploaded by an editor because a site key cannot create media.\n- The fixture provider mirrors the content pack and serves generated mockups from `public/demo/`, visibly labelled illustrative. Production renders CMS media only.\n- Demo form is the only lead path in this pass; Stage 3 owns the sales-process handoff.\n\n## 9. Verification\n\n- `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build.\n- Unit (vitest): route/locale resolution, binding resolution, variant resolver, band rhythm, draft policy, cache tags, HMAC revalidation, form validation, token parity, manifest validation mirroring the CMS parser.\n- Browser (Playwright, fixture CMS): five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark; keyboard navigation; mobile menu; theme persistence; locale switch; form success/failure; reduced motion; axe; RTL overflow (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`); visual snapshots.\n- Manual/recorded: retry of the DesignMD live reference and a written deviation list in `DESIGN.md`.\n- No claim of deployment, live CMS integration, or production performance until those are actually run.\n\n## 10. Risks and open items\n\n1. **Live DesignMD reference** returned HTTP 429 during design. Reconciliation is deferred to implementation; every deviation must be recorded, not assumed.\n2. **AI-generated showcase imagery** conflicts with the issue's \"authentic product demonstration visuals\" and \"no fabricated claims\". Mitigation: fixture-only, labelled, no invented metrics; real screenshots can replace them via CMS media at any time.\n3. **Unpublished runtime package**: vendored workspace package; parity tested against the CMS source.\n4. **No live tenant in this pass**: content pack + fixtures replace a claimed deployment.\n5. **Spam protection** is honeypot-only until Stage 3.\n6. **Font licensing**: only OFL-licensed families; licenses committed with the binaries.\n\n## 11. Acceptance mapping (Stage 1 + 2)\n\n| Issue criterion | Covered by |\n|---|---|\n| `DESIGN.md` committed, attributed, original, agent guidance refers to it | DESIGN.md + AGENTS.md deliverables |\n| Reusable components, responsive homepage, visual review at 3 widths | Component set, Playwright snapshots |\n| RTL Persian first-class; English LTR; dark/light; reduced motion; keyboard | i18n/RTL + a11y sections and tests |\n| CMS edits publish without theme changes; no cross-tenant exposure | Block/variant architecture, key-only server access, cache/tag tests |\n| Demo CTA and form work end-to-end | CMS form + submission route (within fixture and available CMS) |\n| Preview/health/release/rollback tested through Eshobe | **Deferred to Stage 4** |\n| No fabricated testimonials, metrics, prices, claims | Omit-empty policy, fixture labelling, no hardcoded content |\n\n## 12. Implementation outline\n\n1. **Foundation**: scaffold, manifest, vendored runtime, tokens, fonts, layout shell, nav/footer, theme switch, health/proxy/revalidate routes, fixtures, unit harness.\n2. **Design contract**: write `DESIGN.md` + `AGENTS.md`; retry the live reference; record deviations.\n3. **Sections**: primitives and all business-block sections with variant resolution.\n4. **Routes**: home, restaurants, pricing, features, demo, generic CMS pages; metadata and locale switching.\n5. **Forms and states**: CMS form island, error/empty/holding pages.\n6. **Content pack**: Biza Miz page JSON, form schema, import script, generated mockups.\n7. **Verification**: Playwright suite, axe, RTL overflow, snapshots; run `pnpm verify`.\n"
}

Purpose and scope\n\nBuild a production-grade, reusable, Eshobe-native corporate/SaaS theme with a Vercel-inspired visual language, demonstrated first with Biza Miz restaurant/café marketing content.\n\n**In scope (this pass): Stage 1 + Stage 2 of the issue**\n\n- Committed `DESIGN.md` translated from the DesignMD reference, plus `AGENTS.md` that mandates reading it and the Theme API before UI edits.\n- Eshobe theme manifest, design tokens, typography, layout shell, theme switch, responsive RTL navigation.\n- CMS-driven page system: homepage, restaurant/café landing, pricing explainer, features page, demo/contact form, light/dark, fa/en.\n- Fixture-backed local development, content pack for Biza Miz, test and verification harness.\n\n**Out of scope (Stages 3–4)**: live lead handoff/CRM and attribution, funnel analytics, live Biza Miz price sourcing, wallet/signup destinations, sitemap/robots, production preview→health→release→rollback, GHCR artifact workflow, full visual-regression baselines.\n\nNothing in this pass may claim a deployed integration or fabricate testimonials, metrics, prices, or product capabilities.\n\n## 2. Decisions\n\n| # | Decision | Rationale |\n|---|---|---|\n| D1 | Composition model B: contract block vocabulary with theme-owned designed variants | Keeps CMS authoring authority while reaching reference-level art direction; no invented block types |\n| D2 | Theme key `eshobe-corporation` | Owner decision; matches repo identity in the CMS picker |\n| D3 | Product showcase imagery is AI-generated, stored under `public/demo/`, fixture-only, labelled illustrative | Owner decision; contained so no fabricated imagery reaches production theme code |\n| D4 | Stack mirrors `cms-arch2-theme`: Next 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, standalone Docker | Contract-proven sibling implementation |\n| D5 | Vendor `@eshobe/site-runtime` as a workspace package instead of an ad-hoc alias shim | npm package is unpublished and missing documented exports (`resolveSiteRoute`, `siteOrigin`, `localeCodes`) |\n| D6 | Announcement banner deferred | No localized announcement field exists in `header`, page blocks, or manifest settings; shipping a Persian-only banner would break fa/en parity |\n| D7 | Blog/archive deferred | Issue schedules learning/blog for a later phase; `archive` block warns and renders nothing |\n\n## 3. Design system\n\n`DESIGN.md` is a first-class deliverable with machine-readable frontmatter (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and human sections (overview, layout, elevation, do/don't, Persian adaptations, accessibility, motion). It records attribution to the DesignMD reference and every deliberate deviation.\n\n### 3.1 Reference translation\n\n| Reference trait | Adaptation |\n|---|---|\n| Ink `#171717` primary CTA, near-white canvas, 1px hairlines | Kept as neutral core, tokenised |\n| Four-step surface ladder (white / 98% / 95% / polarity-flipped ink) | Kept; inverted pair is semantic and self-flips in dark mode |\n| Multi-stop mesh gradient, hero scale only | Original CSS multi-radial composition with our stops and geometry; never a copy of Vercel's SVG |\n| Geist / Geist Mono | Vazirmatn (Persian, Eshobe standard) + Inter Variable (Latin) + JetBrains Mono (technical labels), all openly licensed, self-hosted. No Vercel font binaries, marks, copy, or screenshots |\n| Aggressive negative display tracking | Latin only; Persian exempt (no negative tracking on connected script), 1.8 body leading, ~1.25 display leading |\n| 4px spacing, 1400px container, 600/960/1200/1400 breakpoints | Kept; section rhythm 96–128px desktop, 56–64px mobile |\n| Stacked shadows L1–L5 + inset hairline | Kept; dark mode ring becomes `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |\n| Radius 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100 pills | Theme owns scale; CMS `radius` maps to control/card radius only. Marketing CTAs stay pill; nav CTAs 6px |\n\n### 3.2 Tokens\n\n- **Colors (light)**: `ink #171717`, `body #4d4d4d`, `mute #888888`, `hairline #ebebeb`, `hairline-strong #a1a1a1`, `canvas #ffffff`, `canvas-soft #fafafa`, `canvas-soft-2 #f5f5f5`, `link #0070f3`, semantic success/warning/error with soft/deep variants.\n- **Colors (dark)**: `canvas #0a0a0a`, `canvas-soft #111111`, `canvas-soft-2 #171717`, `ink #ededed`, `body #a1a1a1`, `mute #737373`, `hairline #262626`, `hairline-strong #525252`.\n- **CMS-editable only**: `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground`, `radius (none|sm|md|lg)`, `lineHeight (1.4–2.4)`, emitted on `body` scope via `themeCss(site.theme)` in a `#site-theme` style element. Every other token lives in theme CSS.\n- **Type scale**: display-xl 48/48/−2.4, display-lg 32/40/−1.28, display-md 24/32/−0.96, display-sm 20/28/−0.6, body-lg 18/28, body-md 16/24, body-sm 14/20/−0.28, caption 12/16, mono 12–13. Persian overrides tracking to 0 and leading to 1.8 body / ~1.25 display.\n- **Radii**: 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100/full. **Spacing**: 4px base; 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192.\n- **Elevation**: L1 inset hairline; L2 soft drop; L3 soft stack; L4 float stack; L5 modal. Stacked offsets only, always with inset ring.\n- **Token parity**: CSS variables and a TS mirror are asserted by a unit test.\n\n### 3.3 Components\n\nNav (sticky 64px, mobile overlay, locale/theme switches), buttons (primary pill, secondary, ghost; sm/md/lg; full state matrix), badge + mono eyebrow, marketing/soft cards, product mockup chrome, section header, feature grid, sticky-stack band, pricing card + featured, testimonial card, FAQ accordion, logo strip, announcement primitive (deferred in pages), inputs/select/textarea with helper and error text, submit states (idle/pending/sent/error), contact card, CTA band, footer.\n\n### 3.4 Motion, accessibility, performance\n\n- Motion: 150–250ms state transitions; scroll reveals ≤80ms stagger; transform/opacity only; no parallax, infinite loops, or layout-shift animation. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it.\n- Accessibility: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible focus ring, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls`, labelled fields with `aria-describedby`, `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).\n- Performance: server components by default; client islands limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, accordion, form, reveal observer; no animation library; self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload; `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; CSS hero mesh. Budgets: CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms; sections usable without JS except the islands.\n\n## 4. Architecture\n\n### 4.1 Repository layout\n\n```text\neshobe-corporation-theme/\n├── eshobe.theme.json\n├── DESIGN.md\n├── AGENTS.md\n├── README.md\n├── Dockerfile\n├── package.json / pnpm-workspace.yaml\n├── demo-packs/biza-miz/           # page JSON, form schema, nav links, import script\n├── packages/site-runtime/         # vendored @eshobe/site-runtime workspace package\n├── public/\n│   ├── demo/                      # fixture-only generated mockups, labelled illustrative\n│   └── fonts/                     # Vazirmatn, Inter, JetBrains Mono + licenses\n├── src/\n│   ├── app/[[...path]]/           # resolve → dispatch → RouteShell\n│   ├── app/api/health/\n│   ├── app/api/revalidate/\n│   ├── app/api/[...segments]/     # allowlisted CMS proxy\n│   ├── app/api/exit-preview/\n│   ├── cms/                       # client, site descriptor, typed queries, draft policy, cache tags\n│   ├── sections/                  # hero, showcase, feature-grid, sticky-stack, pricing, logos, testimonial, faq, cta, form, media, editorial, gallery, team, contact\n│   ├── blocks/                    # blockType → section + variant resolver\n│   ├── components/                # ui primitives, nav, footer, mockup chrome\n│   ├── lib/{i18n,routing,theme,seo,media}\n│   └── styles/                    # globals.css @theme tokens, fonts.css\n└── tests/{unit,browser,fixtures}\n```\n\n### 4.2 Routes and bindings\n\n- `fa` is unprefixed; `en` is prefixed (`/en/...`). A locale absent from `availableLocales` is a 404. `dir` derives per request.\n- Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`.\n- Each route resolves `themeRuntime.bindings[slot]` by page ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`). A missing binding is a 404; no bundled fallback copy.\n- Page content is fetched by ID/slug with `depth=2` (single doc), media resolved via `site.media.origin`, and header/footer globals fetched in parallel.\n- Nav comes from the `header` global. Footer columns use `footer.navItems` plus brand/contact data already in CMS; no invented CMS fields.\n\n### 4.3 Block → section resolution\n\n| Contract block | Section | Variant rule |\n|---|---|---|\n| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | First `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop; link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary). Last → inverted CTA band. Else inline |\n| `mediaBlock` | showcase / editorial figure | Immediately after hero → 16:10 mockup chrome; else framed by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with viewport cap |\n| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky`, disabled under reduced motion |\n| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan polarity-flipped in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit` |\n| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted |\n| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |\n| `logos` | logo strip | Monochrome via `logosMonochrome`, colour on hover |\n| `content` | editorial columns | Lexical `direction` per field, `unicode-bidi: plaintext` |\n| `gallery` | image grid | Columns from block |\n| `team` | team grid | CMS members only |\n| `contact` | contact card | Phones via `toLocaleDigits` |\n| `formBlock` | CMS form | Renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim plus hidden honeypot |\n| `archive` | deferred | Dev warning, null in production |\n\n- Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically; inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA.\n- Unknown `blockType`: log and render nothing. Never invent a block type.\n\n### 4.4 Manifest\n\n- `contractVersion: 1`, `key: \"eshobe-corporation\"`, `name: \"Eshobe Corporation\"`, `nameFa`, `siteTypes: [\"business\"]`, `locales: [\"fa\",\"en\"]`.\n- `capabilities`: `rtlFirst`, `multiLocale`, `pageBuilderBlocks`, `forms`.\n- `design`: Vercel-derived defaults.\n- `build`: `dockerfile`, port 3000, `healthCheckPath: \"/api/health\"`, `isStatic: false`; no `deployment` block (Coolify build strategy).\n- `env: []` (all `ESHOBE_*` variables are platform-injected).\n- `settings`: `heroTreatment` (mesh|plain), `featureTreatment` (cards|sticky), `showcaseTreatment` (mockup|editorial), `logosMonochrome` (boolean), `restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`.\n- `contentSlots`: `home`, `restaurants`, `pricing`, `features`, `demo`.\n\n## 5. Data flow, caching, preview, security\n\n- **Bootstrap**: one cached `GET /api/site` per request (key-authenticated) validates `contractVersion`, media origin, locales, settings, bindings.\n- **Tenancy**: every CMS call uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`; never a rewritten `Host` (loops back into the theme container). No `?site=` anywhere. The key never reaches the browser.\n- **Draft policy**: centralized. A site key can read drafts, so public rendering always sends `draft=false` and `where[_status][equals]=published` (except globals where the contract excludes status). Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then uses `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.\n- **Cache**: `force-cache`, site 30s / content 60s, tags `cms:all` and `tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`.\n- **Revalidation**: `POST /api/revalidate` verifies raw-body HMAC-SHA256 (`x-eshobe-signature`), timestamp tolerance, 64KB cap, purges payload tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s.\n- **Proxy**: `/api/[...segments]` allowlists CMS heads (`site, pages, posts, products, categories, header, footer, forms, form-submissions, search, media, theme, store, checkout, payments, redirects, globals`), drops visitor cookies/auth, refuses recursion, and forwards to the CMS with its own host.\n- **Media**: URLs resolved against `site.media.origin`; SVGs via `<img>`, never inline; remote patterns restricted to the CMS origin.\n\n## 6. Forms\n\nThe demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions`:\n\n```json\n{ \"form\": \"<formId>\", \"submissionData\": [{ \"field\": \"name\", \"value\": \"…\" }] }\n```\n\n- Tenant is derived server-side from the form document; the client cannot choose it.\n- Required consent checkbox; inline validation with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; Persian-digit normalisation via `toAsciiDigits`; values preserved on failure; disabled submit while pending; success/error announced via `aria-live`; retry control.\n- Hidden honeypot; spam rate-limiting is deferred to Stage 3.\n- CRM handoff, attribution and analytics are **not** implemented in this pass.\n\n## 7. Failure states\n\n| Condition | Behaviour |\n|---|---|\n| Unknown route | Themed 404, `noindex` |\n| Missing binding | 404, no bundled copy |\n| CMS unreachable | Cached content when available; else themed 503 with retry; health endpoint stays local |\n| Site suspended/archived | Contract holding page, HTTP 200, `noindex` |\n| Contract version mismatch | Loud developer-facing error page; no silent render |\n| Empty collection block | Section omitted |\n| Premium/featured content | No placeholder testimonials, logos, metrics, or prices |\n\n## 8. Biza Miz content\n\n- Theme code stays tenant-neutral; Biza Miz copy, page structures, nav links and form schema ship in `demo-packs/biza-miz/`.\n- An idempotent import script uses only capabilities a site key has (pages, posts, forms, header/footer). Media must be uploaded by an editor because a site key cannot create media.\n- The fixture provider mirrors the content pack and serves generated mockups from `public/demo/`, visibly labelled illustrative. Production renders CMS media only.\n- Demo form is the only lead path in this pass; Stage 3 owns the sales-process handoff.\n\n## 9. Verification\n\n- `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build.\n- Unit (vitest): route/locale resolution, binding resolution, variant resolver, band rhythm, draft policy, cache tags, HMAC revalidation, form validation, token parity, manifest validation mirroring the CMS parser.\n- Browser (Playwright, fixture CMS): five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark; keyboard navigation; mobile menu; theme persistence; locale switch; form success/failure; reduced motion; axe; RTL overflow (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`); visual snapshots.\n- Manual/recorded: retry of the DesignMD live reference and a written deviation list in `DESIGN.md`.\n- No claim of deployment, live CMS integration, or production performance until those are actually run.\n\n## 10. Risks and open items\n\n1. **Live DesignMD reference** returned HTTP 429 during design. Reconciliation is deferred to implementation; every deviation must be recorded, not assumed.\n2. **AI-generated showcase imagery** conflicts with the issue's \"authentic product demonstration visuals\" and \"no fabricated claims\". Mitigation: fixture-only, labelled, no invented metrics; real screenshots can replace them via CMS media at any time.\n3. **Unpublished runtime package**: vendored workspace package; parity tested against the CMS source.\n4. **No live tenant in this pass**: content pack + fixtures replace a claimed deployment.\n5. **Spam protection** is honeypot-only until Stage 3.\n6. **Font licensing**: only OFL-licensed families; licenses committed with the binaries.\n\n## 11. Acceptance mapping (Stage 1 + 2)\n\n| Issue criterion | Covered by |\n|---|---|\n| `DESIGN.md` committed, attributed, original, agent guidance refers to it | DESIGN.md + AGENTS.md deliverables |\n| Reusable components, responsive homepage, visual review at 3 widths | Component set, Playwright snapshots |\n| RTL Persian first-class; English LTR; dark/light; reduced motion; keyboard | i18n/RTL + a11y sections and tests |\n| CMS edits publish without theme changes; no cross-tenant exposure | Block/variant architecture, key-only server access, cache/tag tests |\n| Demo CTA and form work end-to-end | CMS form + submission route (within fixture and available CMS) |\n| Preview/health/release/rollback tested through Eshobe | **Deferred to Stage 4** |\n| No fabricated testimonials, metrics, prices, claims | Omit-empty policy, fixture labelling, no hardcoded content |\n\n## 12. Implementation outline\n\n1. **Foundation**: scaffold, manifest, vendored runtime, tokens, fonts, layout shell, nav/footer, theme switch, health/proxy/revalidate routes, fixtures, unit harness.\n2. **Design contract**: write `DESIGN.md` + `AGENTS.md`; retry the live reference; record deviations.\n3. **Sections**: primitives and all business-block sections with variant resolution.\n4. **Routes**: home, restaurants, pricing, features, demo, generic CMS pages; metadata and locale switching.\n5. **Forms and states**: CMS form island, error/empty/holding pages.\n6. **Content pack**: Biza Miz page JSON, form schema, import script, generated mockups.\n7. **Verification**: Playwright suite, axe, RTL overflow, snapshots; run `pnpm verify`.\n"
}

30	  const next = value.trim()
31	  return next === '' ? null : next

34	export function readCmsEnv(source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): CmsEnv {

37	    apiKey: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_API_KEY),
38	    siteId: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_SITE_ID),

44	      .filter(Boolean),
45	    siteType: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_SITE_TYPE),
46	    currency: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_CURRENCY),
47	    publicOrigin: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN),
48	    revalidateSecret: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET),
49	    contractVersion: trimmed(source.ESHOBE_CONTRACT_VERSION),
50	  }
51	}

53	/** Whether any server-side CMS access is configured at all. */
54	export function isCmsConfigured(env: CmsEnv = readCmsEnv()): boolean {
55	  return env.apiKey !== null || env.cmsUrl !== '' || env.siteDomain !== null
56	}
57	
58	/**
59	 * Development fixture mode.
60	 *
61	 * Only ever active outside a production build, only for loopback hosts, and only when no CMS
62	 * credential is configured. It exists so the theme can be developed and QA'd without a live
63	 * tenant; it can never serve fixture content on a production deployment.
64	 */
65	export function isFixtureMode(host: string | null, env: CmsEnv = readCmsEnv()): boolean {
66	  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') return false
67	  if (process.env.ESHOBE_FIXTURE === '0') return false
68	  if (env.apiKey !== null || env.siteDomain !== null) return false
69	  const bare = (host ?? '').split(':')[0] ?? ''
70	  return bare === 'localhost' || bare === '127.0.0.1' || bare === '[::1]' || bare.endsWith('.localhost')
71	}
72	
73	/**
74	 * Loopback by name. `localhost`, the v4/v6 literals, and — per RFC 6761 §6.3 — any name ending
75	 * in `.localhost`, which every browser resolves to the loopback interface. The CMS's dev sites
76	 * are exactly `studio.localhost`, `acme.localhost`, and that is the media origin their
77	 * descriptors advertise, so rejecting the suffix would reject the documented dev shape.
78	 */
79	export function isLoopbackHost(host: string): boolean {
80	  return host === 'localhost' || host === '127.0.0.1' || host === '[::1]' || host.endsWith('.localhost')
81	}
82	
83	/** Reject an origin that is not https or loopback http, so credentials cannot travel in clear. */
84	export function assertUsableOrigin(rawUrl: string): URL {
85	  let parsed: URL
86	  try {
87	    parsed = new URL(rawUrl)
88	  } catch {
89	    throw new CmsConfigError(`"${rawUrl}" is not a valid absolute URL`)
90	  }
91	  if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:' && !(parsed.protocol === 'http:' && isLoopbackHost(parsed.hostname))) {
92	    throw new CmsConfigError(`"${rawUrl}" must use https (http is allowed only on a loopback host)`)
93	  }
94	  return parsed
95	}

45	export class CmsRequestError extends Error {

47	  readonly path: string
48	  constructor(path: string, status: number, message: string) {
49	    super(message)
50	    this.name = 'CmsRequestError'
51	    this.status = status
52	    this.path = path

55	
56	export class UnknownHostError extends Error {

64	/** Public content is cached briefly; the webhook accelerates, TTL guarantees freshness. */
65	export const PUBLIC_REVALIDATE_SECONDS = 30
66	export const CONTENT_REVALIDATE_SECONDS = 60
67	
68	function firstHeaderValue(value: string | null): string | null {
69	  if (!value) return null
70	  const first = value.split(',')[0]?.trim()
71	  return first ? first : null
72	}
73	
74	export function normalizeHost(raw: string | null): string | null {
75	  if (!raw) return null
76	  return raw.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\.$/, '') || null
77	}
78	
79	function protocolFor(host: string, forwardedProto: string | null): string {
80	  if (forwardedProto === 'https' || forwardedProto === 'http') return forwardedProto
81	  const bare = host.split(':')[0] ?? ''
82	  return bare === 'localhost' || bare === '127.0.0.1' || bare.endsWith('.localhost') ? 'http' : 'https'
83	}

85	export const getCmsContext = cache(async (): Promise<CmsContext> => {
86	  const env = readCmsEnv()
87	  const incoming = await headers()
88	  const host = normalizeHost(firstHeaderValue(incoming.get('x-forwarded-host')) ?? incoming.get('host'))
89	  const draft = await draftMode()
90	  const forwardedProto = firstHeaderValue(incoming.get('x-forwarded-proto'))
91	
92	  if (isFixtureMode(host, env)) {
93	    return {
94	      mode: 'fixture',
95	      baseUrl: '',
96	      host,
97	      // Fixtures never model drafts: preview previews real CMS content only.
98	      preview: false,
99	      tenantKey: 'fixture',
100	      allowDrafts: false,
101	      env,
102	    }
103	  }
104	
105	  if (env.apiKey) {
106	    if (!env.cmsUrl) {
107	      throw new CmsConfigError('ESHOBE_API_KEY is set but ESHOBE_CMS_URL is missing, so the CMS cannot be reached')
108	    }
109	    assertUsableOrigin(env.cmsUrl)
110	    return {
111	      mode: 'key',
112	      baseUrl: env.cmsUrl,
113	      host,
114	      preview: draft.isEnabled || originIsNotCanonical(host, env),
115	      tenantKey: env.siteId ?? 'api-key',
116	      allowDrafts: draft.isEnabled || originIsNotCanonical(host, env),
117	      env,
118	    }
119	  }
120	
121	  // Same-domain mode: the CMS owns /api/* on this origin and the proxy route forwards it.
122	  const base = env.cmsUrl
123	    ? env.cmsUrl
124	    : host
125	      ? `${protocolFor(host, forwardedProto)}://${host}`
126	      : null
127	  if (!base) {
128	    throw new CmsConfigError(
129	      'No CMS tenant available: set ESHOBE_API_KEY (managed deployment) or serve the theme on the customer Host',
130	    )
131	  }
132	  if (env.cmsUrl) assertUsableOrigin(env.cmsUrl)
133	  return {
134	    mode: 'forwarded-host',
135	    baseUrl: base,
136	    host,
137	    preview: draft.isEnabled || originIsNotCanonical(host, env),
138	    tenantKey: host ?? 'unknown-host',
139	    allowDrafts: draft.isEnabled || originIsNotCanonical(host, env),
140	    env,
141	  }
142	})

144	/**
145	 * A preview deployment serves on a wildcard host that is not the canonical site domain.
146	 * That is a *presentation* signal only: it never changes production routing or tokens.
147	 */
148	function originIsNotCanonical(host: string | null, env: CmsEnv): boolean {
149	  if (!env.siteDomain || !host) return false
150	  return host.split(':')[0] !== env.siteDomain
151	}

153	export type { QueryValue } from './query'
154	
155	export type CmsQuery = {
156	  /** Payload `where` etc. as raw query params (already validatable strings). */
157	  query?: Record<string, QueryValue>
158	  locale?: string
159	  resource?: CacheResource
160	  /** Draft reads require an authenticated preview. */
161	  drafts?: boolean
162	  revalidate?: number
163	  /**
164	   * Whether this endpoint's collection has draft/publish state, so the publish filter
165	   * (`where[_status][equals]=published`) may be sent. **Defaults to true** — the safe default
166	   * for a collection that is published explicitly — and is turned off per read for the
167	   * endpoints that have no `_status` at all.
168	   *
169	   * Verified against the live CMS (Payload 3.88): `/api/pages` and `/api/posts` filter fine;
170	   * `/api/categories`, `/api/forms`, `/api/search`, and the `header`/`footer` per-site
171	   * singletons (collections with `isGlobal: true`) answer
172	   * `400 QueryError: the following path cannot be queried: _status`. Every one of them
173	   * still accepts `draft`, so the draft half of the policy always applies — only the
174	   * `where[_status]` half is skipped.
175	   */
176	  publishFilter?: boolean
177	}
178	
179	export { buildQueryString } from './query'
180	
181	/**
182	 * Draft policy, applied in one place.
183	 *
184	 * A site API key is allowed to read drafts for its tenant. Public rendering must therefore
185	 * exclude them explicitly instead of relying on anonymous access rules — otherwise
186	 * unpublished content would leak onto a production page. In preview the filter is dropped
187	 * deliberately.
188	 */
189	export function applyDraftPolicy(
190	  ctx: CmsContext,
191	  options: CmsQuery,
192	  params: Record<string, QueryValue>,
193	): Record<string, QueryValue> {
194	  const wantsDrafts = Boolean(options.drafts) && ctx.allowDrafts
195	  if (wantsDrafts) {
196	    params['draft'] = 'true'
197	    return params
198	  }
199	  params['draft'] = 'false'
200	  // Published-explicitly collections only; see `CmsQuery.publishFilter`.
201	  if (options.publishFilter !== false) params['where[_status][equals]'] = 'published'
202	  return params
203	}
204	
205	export type CmsJson<T> = {
206	  data: T
207	  status: number
208	}
209	
210	/** Low-level read. Returns the parsed body with its status so callers can map 404 to null. */
211	export async function cmsFetchJson<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<CmsJson<T>> {
212	  const ctx = await getCmsContext()
213	  const params = { ...(options.query ?? {}) }
214	  if (options.locale) params['locale'] = options.locale
215	  applyDraftPolicy(ctx, options, params)
216	  const queryString = buildQueryString(params)
217	  const url = `${ctx.baseUrl}${path}${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`
218	  const tags = cacheTags({
219	    tenantKey: ctx.tenantKey,
220	    locale: options.locale,
221	    resource: options.resource,
222	  })
223	
224	  if (ctx.mode === 'fixture') {
225	    const fixture = fixtureFetch<T>(path, params)
226	    if (!fixture) throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, `fixture: no handler for ${path}`)
227	    return fixture
228	  }
229	
230	  const init: RequestInit & { next?: { revalidate?: number; tags?: string[] } } = {
231	    headers: {
232	      accept: 'application/json',
233	      // Never forwarded from a visitor; only the platform-injected site key travels here.
234	      ...(ctx.env.apiKey ? { authorization: `Bearer ${ctx.env.apiKey}` } : {}),
235	    },
236	    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
237	  }
238	  if (ctx.preview) {
239	    init.cache = 'no-store'
240	  } else {
241	    init.cache = 'force-cache'
242	    init.next = { revalidate: options.revalidate ?? CONTENT_REVALIDATE_SECONDS, tags }
243	  }
244	
245	  let response: Response
246	  try {
247	    response = await fetch(url, init)
248	  } catch (cause) {
249	    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'network error'
250	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 0, `CMS unreachable: ${message}`)
251	  }
252	
253	  if (response.status === 404) return { data: undefined as T, status: 404 }
254	  if (!response.ok) {
255	    const detail = await safeErrorMessage(response)
256	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, response.status, detail)
257	  }
258	  const data = (await response.json()) as T
259	  return { data, status: response.status }
260	}
261	
262	async function safeErrorMessage(response: Response): Promise<string> {
263	  try {
264	    const text = await response.text()
265	    if (text.length > 400) return `${text.slice(0, 400)}…`
266	    return text
267	  } catch {
268	    return response.statusText || 'request failed'
269	  }
270	}
271	
272	/** Read that throws on 404 — for documents a route genuinely requires. */
273	export async function cmsFetchOr404<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<T> {
274	  const result = await cmsFetchJson<T>(path, options)
275	  if (result.status === 404 || result.data === undefined) {
276	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, 'not found')
277	  }
278	  return result.data
279	}
280	
281	/** Read that returns null on 404 — for optional documents and bound content. */
282	export async function cmsFetchOptional<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<T | null> {
283	  const result = await cmsFetchJson<T>(path, options)
284	  if (result.status === 404 || result.data === undefined) return null
285	  return result.data
286	}

12	export type CacheResource =

30	export function cacheTags(scope: CacheScope): string[] {
31	  const tags = [CMS_ALL_TAG, `tnt:${scope.tenantKey}`]
32	  if (scope.locale) tags.push(`tnt:${scope.tenantKey}:${scope.locale}`)
33	  if (scope.resource) tags.push(`tnt:${scope.tenantKey}:${scope.resource}`)

1	/**
2	 * Route planning and URL building.
3	 *
4	 * This is the single place that decides *what* a CMS path renders (a composition, a generic
5	 * page, an archive) and how every internal URL is spelled. Views never hand-build `/${slug}`.
6	 *
7	 * Composition detection has two supported sources, in this order:
8	 *
9	 *   1. a content-slot binding (`themeRuntime.bindings`) — the bound document wins, which makes
10	 *      it correct for localized slugs, since binding identity is locale-independent;
11	 *   2. a comma-separated page-slug setting (`projectsSlug`, `aboutSlug`, …) for sites that do
12	 *      not use bindings.
13	 *

21	
22	export type CompositionKind = 'projects' | 'education' | 'about' | 'contact'
23	
24	export const COMPOSITION_KEYS: Record<CompositionKind, 'projectsSlug' | 'educationSlug' | 'aboutSlug' | 'contactSlug'> = {
25	  projects: 'projectsSlug',
26	  education: 'educationSlug',
27	  about: 'aboutSlug',
28	  contact: 'contactSlug',
29	}
30	
31	export type RoutePlan =
32	  | { kind: 'home' }
33	  | { kind: 'composition'; composition: CompositionKind; slug: string }
34	  | { kind: 'page'; slug: string }
35	  | { kind: 'posts'; page: number; category: string | null }
36	  | { kind: 'post'; slug: string; viaAlias: CompositionKind | null }
37	  | { kind: 'search'; query: string }
38	  /** The contract's store route. This theme does not claim store support, so it 404s. */
39	  | { kind: 'store-unavailable'; order: string | null }
40	  | { kind: 'unresolved'; segments: string[] }
41	
42	function matchesSlugList(settings: ThemeSettings, key: keyof ThemeSettings, slug: string): boolean {
43	  const value = settings[key]
44	  return typeof value === 'string' && settingIncludesSlug(value, slug)
45	}
46	
47	/** Provisional plan from the URL alone (bindings are applied later, once the page is loaded). */
48	export function planRoute(route: SiteRoute, settings: ThemeSettings, params: { page?: number; category?: string | null; query?: string }): RoutePlan {
49	  switch (route.kind) {
50	    case 'page': {
51	      if (route.slug === HOME_SLUG) return { kind: 'home' }
52	      for (const composition of Object.keys(COMPOSITION_KEYS) as CompositionKind[]) {
53	        if (matchesSlugList(settings, COMPOSITION_KEYS[composition], route.slug)) {
54	          return { kind: 'composition', composition, slug: route.slug }
55	        }
56	      }
57	      return { kind: 'page', slug: route.slug }
58	    }
59	    case 'posts':
60	      return { kind: 'posts', page: params.page && params.page > 1 ? params.page : 1, category: params.category ?? null }
61	    case 'post':
62	      return { kind: 'post', slug: route.slug, viaAlias: null }
63	    case 'search':
64	      return { kind: 'search', query: params.query ?? '' }
65	    case 'checkout':
66	      return { kind: 'store-unavailable', order: route.order }
67	    case 'product':
68	      return { kind: 'unresolved', segments: ['products', route.slug] }
69	    case 'unresolved': {
70	      const [head, slug, ...rest] = route.segments
71	      if (head && slug && rest.length === 0) {
72	        for (const composition of ['projects', 'education'] as const) {
73	          if (matchesSlugList(settings, COMPOSITION_KEYS[composition], head)) {
74	            return { kind: 'post', slug, viaAlias: composition }
75	          }
76	        }
77	      }
78	      return { kind: 'unresolved', segments: route.segments }
79	    }
80	  }
81	}

83	/** True when a resolved document id *is* the bound document for one of the compositions. */
84	export function bindingComposition(
85	  pageId: string | null,
86	  bindings: Record<string, BoundContent | null>,
87	): CompositionKind | null {
88	  if (!pageId) return null
89	  for (const composition of Object.keys(COMPOSITION_KEYS) as CompositionKind[]) {
90	    const bound = bindings[composition]
91	    if (bound && bound.id !== null && bound.id !== undefined && String(bound.id) === pageId) return composition
92	  }
93	  return null
94	}

96	/** Bindings override slug-list detection — the operator's explicit choice wins. */
97	export function reviseWithBinding(
98	  plan: RoutePlan,
99	  pageId: string | null,
100	  bindings: Record<string, BoundContent | null>,
101	): RoutePlan {
102	  if (plan.kind !== 'page' && plan.kind !== 'composition') return plan
103	  const fromBinding = bindingComposition(pageId, bindings)
104	  if (fromBinding) return { kind: 'composition', composition: fromBinding, slug: plan.slug }
105	  return plan
106	}
