Kept pure so the\n * two-URLs-for-one-page class of bug is unit-testable.\n */\nexport function resolveRoute(input: {\n  path: string[]\n  site: SiteRouteInput\n  settings: ThemeSettings\n}): RoutePlan {\n  const available = input.site.availableLocales.filter(isLocale)\n  const declared = input.site.defaultLocale\n  const siteDefault: Locale =\n    isLocale(declared) && available.includes(declared)\n      ? declared\n      : (available[0] ?? 'fa')\n\n  const first = input.path[0]\n  let locale: Locale = siteDefault\n  let rest = input.path\n\n  if (isLocale(first)) {\n    if (!available.includes(first)) return { kind: 'not-found' }\n    if (first === siteDefault) {\n      const remaining = input.path.slice(1)\n      return { kind: 'redirect', to: remaining.length === 0 ? '/' : `/${remaining.join('/')}` }\n    }\n    locale = first\n    rest = input.path.slice(1)\n  }\n\n  if (rest.length === 0) {\n    const binding = input.site.themeRuntime?.bindings?.home ?? null\n    const pageRef = binding?.id\n      ? { id: binding.id }\n      : { slug: typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== '' ? binding.slug : HOME_SLUG }\n    return { kind: 'page', locale, slot: 'home', pageRef, publicPath: '/', landing: true }\n  }\n\n  if (rest.length === 1) {\n    const segment = rest[0] as string\n    const slot = SLOT_ORDER.find((candidate) => slugFor(candidate, input.settings) === segment)\n    if (slot) {\n      const binding = input.site.themeRuntime?.bindings?.[slot] ?? null\n      const pageRef = binding?.id\n        ? { id: binding.id }\n        : {\n            slug:\n              typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== ''\n                ? binding.slug\n                : slugFor(slot, input.settings),\n          }\n      return {\n        kind: 'page',\n        locale,\n        slot,\n        pageRef,\n        publicPath: `/${segment}`,\n        landing: true,\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const siteRoute = resolveSiteRoute(rest)\n  if (siteRoute.kind !== 'page') return { kind: 'not-found' }\n\n  return {\n    kind: 'page',\n    locale,\n    slot: null,\n    pageRef: { slug: siteRoute.slug },\n    publicPath: `/${siteRoute.slug}`,\n    landing: false,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function routeLocalePath(plan: RoutePlan, locale: Locale, siteDefault: string): string | null {\n  if (plan.kind !== 'page') return null\n  return localeHref(plan.publicPath, locale, siteDefault)\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/lib/nav.ts`**\n\n```ts\nimport { HOME_SLUG, localeHref } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'\n\nimport type { CmsLink, FooterGlobal, HeaderGlobal } from '@/cms/types'\n\nexport type NavLink = { href: string; label: string; newTab: boolean }\n\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\n  Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)\n\nconst safeUrl = (value: string): string | null => {\n  const trimmed = value.trim()\n  if (trimmed === '') return null\n  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed\n  try {\n    const url = new URL(trimmed)\n    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null\n  } catch {\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\n/** CMS link → href. Reference links use the populated page slug; ids alone cannot route. */\nexport function linkHref(raw: unknown, locale: string, siteDefault: string): string | null {\n  if (!isRecord(raw)) return null\n  const link = raw as CmsLink\n  let href: string | null = null\n\n  if (link.type === 'custom') {\n    href = typeof link.url === 'string' ? safeUrl(link.url) : null\n  } else if (link.type === 'reference') {\n    const value = link.reference?.value\n    if (isRecord(value) && typeof value.slug === 'string') {\n      const slug = value.slug === HOME_SLUG || value.slug === '' ? '/' : `/${value.slug}`\n      href = localeHref(slug, locale, siteDefault)\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (!href) return null\n  // Internal hrefs were localized above; external hrefs must never be prefixed.\n  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href) || href.startsWith('//')) return href\n  return localeHref(href, locale, siteDefault)\n}\n\nexport function normalizeNav(\n  global: HeaderGlobal | FooterGlobal | null | undefined,\n  locale: string,\n  siteDefault: string,\n): NavLink[] {\n  const items = Array.isArray(global?.navItems) ? global.navItems : []\n  const links: NavLink[] = []\n  for (const item of items) {\n    const raw = isRecord(item) ? item.link : null\n    const href = linkHref(raw, locale, siteDefault)\n    const label = isRecord(raw) && typeof raw.label === 'string' ? raw.label.trim() : ''\n    if (!href || label === '') continue\n    links.push({\n      href,\n      label,\n      newTab: isRecord(raw) && raw.newTab === true,\n    })\n  }\n  return links\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 6: Run tests and typecheck**\n\nRun: `pnpm vitest run tests/unit/routing.test.ts tests/unit/nav.test.ts && pnpm typecheck`\nExpected: PASS. 2437	
2438	const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
2439	  Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
2440	
2441	const readSlug = (value: unknown, fallback: string): string => {
2442	  if (typeof value !== 'string') return fallback
2443	  const trimmed = value.trim()
2444	  if (trimmed === '' || !SLUG_PATTERN.test(trimmed) || trimmed.normalize('NFC') !== trimmed) {
2445	    return fallback
2446	  }
2447	  return trimmed
2448	}
2449	
2450	/**
2451	 * The manifest settings are a closed schema; the descriptor is untrusted input.
2452	 * Invalid values fall back per key rather than failing the render.
2453	 */
2454	export function readThemeSettings(raw: unknown): {
2455	  settings: ThemeSettings
2456	  diagnostics: SettingDiagnostic[]
2457	} {
2458	  const source = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {}
2459	  const diagnostics: SettingDiagnostic[] = []
2460	  const settings: ThemeSettings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS }
2461	
2462	  const pick = <T extends string>(key: string, allowed: readonly T[], fallback: T): T => {
2463	    const value = source[key]
2464	    if (value === undefined) return fallback
2465	    if (typeof value === 'string' && (allowed as readonly string[]).includes(value)) return value as T
2466	    diagnostics.push({ key, reason: 'invalid', fallback })
2467	    return fallback
2468	  }
2469	
2470	  settings.heroTreatment = pick('heroTreatment', ['mesh', 'plain'] as const, DEFAULT_SETTINGS.heroTreatment)
2471	  settings.featureTreatment = pick('featureTreatment', ['cards', 'sticky'] as const, DEFAULT_SETTINGS.featureTreatment)
2472	  settings.showcaseTreatment = pick('showcaseTreatment', ['mockup', 'editorial'] as const, DEFAULT_SETTINGS.showcaseTreatment)
2473	
2474	  if (source.logosMonochrome !== undefined) {
2475	    if (typeof source.logosMonochrome === 'boolean') settings.logosMonochrome = source.logosMonochrome
2476	    else diagnostics.push({ key: 'logosMonochrome', reason: 'invalid', fallback: String(DEFAULT_SETTINGS.logosMonochrome) })
2477	  }
2478	
2479	  for (const key of SLUG_SETTING_KEYS) {
2480	    const fallback = DEFAULT_SETTINGS[key]
2481	    const value = readSlug(source[key], fallback)
2482	    if (source[key] !== undefined && value === fallback && source[key] !== fallback) {
2483	      diagnostics.push({ key, reason: 'invalid', fallback })
2484	    }
2485	    settings[key] = value
2486	  }
2487	
2488	  // A duplicate slug would make one theme route unreachable; first configured slot wins.
2489	  const seen = new Set<string>()
2490	  for (const key of SLUG_SETTING_KEYS) {
2491	    const slug = settings[key]
2492	    if (seen.has(slug)) {
2493	      diagnostics.push({ key, reason: 'conflict', fallback: DEFAULT_SETTINGS[key] })
2494	      settings[key] = DEFAULT_SETTINGS[key]
2495	    }
2496	    seen.add(settings[key])
2497	  }
2498	
2499	  return { settings, diagnostics }
2500	}

2530	    console.warn('[eshobe-corporation] draft mode is on for a canonical host — drafts disabled')

4258	```ts
4259	import type { Media } from '@/cms/types'
4260	
4261	type MediaInput = Media | string | number | null | undefined
4262	
4263	const asMedia = (value: MediaInput): Media | null =>
4264	  value && typeof value === 'object' ? (value as Media) : null
4265	
4266	/**
4267	 * Same-origin media only. A CMS-provided absolute URL is reduced to its path so the
4268	 * browser streams through this deployment's proxy; an off-origin host is refused.
4269	 */
4270	export function mediaSrc(value: MediaInput, mediaOrigin: string): string | null {
4271	  const media = asMedia(value)
4272	  const raw = typeof media?.url === 'string' ? media.url.trim() : ''
4273	  if (raw === '') return null
4274	  if (raw.startsWith('/') && !raw.startsWith('//')) return raw
4275	
4276	  let url: URL
4277	  try {
4278	    url = new URL(raw)
4279	  } catch {
4280	    return null
4281	  }
4282	  if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return null
4283	
4284	  let origin: string
4285	  try {
4286	    origin = mediaOrigin ? new URL(mediaOrigin).origin : ''
4287	  } catch {
4288	    return null
4289	  }
4290	  return origin !== '' && url.origin === origin ? `${url.pathname}${url.search}` : null
4291	}
4292	
4293	export function mediaDimensions(value: MediaInput): { width: number; height: number } | null {
4294	  const media = asMedia(value)
4295	  const width = typeof media?.width === 'number' ? media.width : 0
4296	  const height = typeof media?.height === 'number' ? media.height : 0
4297	  return width > 0 && height > 0 ? { width, height } : null
4298	}
4299	
4300	export const mediaAlt = (value: MediaInput): string => {
4301	  const media = asMedia(value)
4302	  return typeof media?.alt === 'string' ? media.alt : ''
4303	}
4304	
4305	export const isSvg = (value: MediaInput): boolean => {
4306	  const media = asMedia(value)
4307	  return typeof media?.mimeType === 'string' && media.mimeType.includes('svg')
4308	}

4472	
4473	const safeHref = (value: unknown): string | null => {
4474	  if (typeof value !== 'string') return null
4475	  const trimmed = value.trim()
4476	  if (trimmed === '') return null
4477	  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed
4478	  try {
4479	    const url = new URL(trimmed)
4480	    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null
4481	  } catch {
4482	    return null
4483	  }
4484	}
4485	
4486	const formatBits: readonly { bit: number; open: string; close: string }[] = [
4487	  { bit: 1, open: '<strong>', close: '</strong>' },
4488	]
4489	
4490	function renderText(node: LexicalTextNode, key: string): ReactNode {
4491	  let content: ReactNode = node.text ?? ''
4492	  const format = typeof node.format === 'number' ? node.format : 0
4493	  if (format & 16) content = <code key={`${key}-code`}>{content}</code>
4494	  if (format & 8) content = <u key={`${key}-u`}>{content}</u>
4495	  if (format & 4) content = <s key={`${key}-s`}>{content}</s>
4496	  if (format & 2) content = <em key={`${key}-em`}>{content}</em>
4497	  if (format & 1) content = <strong key={`${key}-strong`}>{content}</strong>
4498	  if (format & 32) content = <sub key={`${key}-sub`}>{content}</sub>
4499	  if (format & 64) content = <sup key={`${key}-sup`}>{content}</sup>
4500	  return <span key={key}>{content}</span>
4501	}
4502	
4503	function renderChildren(nodes: LexicalNode[] | undefined): ReactNode[] {
4504	  if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) return []
4505	  return nodes.map((node, index) => renderNode(node, `${index}`))
4506	}
4507	
4508	function renderNode(node: LexicalNode, key: string): ReactNode {
4509	  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return null
4510	  if (node.type === 'text') return renderText(node, key)
4511	  const element = node as LexicalElementNode
4512	
4513	  switch (element.type) {
4514	    case 'paragraph':
4515	      return <p key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</p>
4516	    case 'heading': {
4517	      const tag = ['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'h6'].includes(element.tag ?? '') ? element.tag! : 'h2'
4518	      const Heading = tag as 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6'
4519	      return <Heading key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</Heading>
4520	    }
4521	    case 'list': {
4522	      const ordered = element.listType === 'number'
4523	      return ordered
4524	        ? <ol key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</ol>
4525	        : <ul key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</ul>
4526	    }
4527	    case 'listitem':
4528	      return <li key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</li>
4529	    case 'quote':
4530	      return <blockquote key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</blockquote>
4531	    case 'link': {
4532	      const href = safeHref(element.fields?.url)
4533	      const children = renderChildren(element.children)
4534	      if (!href) return <span key={key}>{children}</span>
4535	      return (
4536	        <a key={key} href={href} className="text-link underline decoration-hairline-strong underline-offset-4 hover:decoration-current" target={element.fields?.newTab === true ? '_blank' : undefined} rel={element.fields?.newTab === true ? 'noreferrer noopener' : undefined}>
4537	          {children}
4538	        </a>
4539	      )
4540	    }
4541	    case 'linebreak':
4542	      return <br key={key} />
4543	    case 'horizontalrule':
4544	      return <hr key={key} className="my-8 border-hairline" />
4545	    case 'upload': {
4546	      const value = element.value as Media | undefined
4547	      return value ? (
4548	        <span key={key} className="my-6 block">
4549	          <MediaImage media={value} mediaOrigin="" sizes="(min-width: 960px) 720px, 100vw" className="rounded-[var(--radius-control)]" />
4550	        </span>
4551	      ) : null
4552	    }
4553	    default:
4554	      return <span key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</span>
4555	  }
4556	}
4557

4563	      {children.map((node, index) => renderNode(node, `${index}`))}

4580	'use client'

4582	import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
4583	
4584	import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'
4585	
4586	export function Reveal({
4587	  children,
4588	  delay = 0,
4589	  className,
4590	}: {
4591	  children: ReactNode
4592	  delay?: number
4593	  className?: string
4594	}) {
4595	  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
4596	  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
4597	
4598	  useEffect(() => {
4599	    const node = ref.current
4600	    if (!node) return
4601	    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
4602	      setVisible(true)
4603	      return
4604	    }
4605	    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
4606	      (entries) => {
4607	        for (const entry of entries) {
4608	          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
4609	            setVisible(true)
4610	            observer.disconnect()
4611	          }
4612	        }
4613	      },
4614	      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px', threshold: 0.1 },
4615	    )
4616	    observer.observe(node)
4617	    return () => observer.disconnect()
4618	  }, [])
4619	
4620	  return (
4621	    <div
4622	      ref={ref}
4623	      data-visible={visible ? 'true' : 'false'}
4624	      style={{ transitionDelay: `${Math.min(delay, 80)}ms` }}
4625	      className={cn(
4626	        'motion-safe:transition-[opacity,transform] motion-safe:duration-200 motion-safe:ease-theme',
4627	        visible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-2',
4628	        'motion-reduce:translate-y-0 motion-reduce:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none',

# Eshobe Corporation Theme — Design Specification

- **Date**: 2026-10-24
- **Status**: Approved for planning
- **Issue**: [hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme#1](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme/issues/1)
- **Theme key / name**: `eshobe-corporation` / "Eshobe Corporation" / «پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه»
- **References**: [Eshobe Theme API](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/THEME_API.md), [theme deployments](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/theme-deployments.md), [DesignMD Vercel reference](https://www.designmd.co/d/vercel)

## 1. Purpose and scope

Build a production-grade, reusable, Eshobe-native corporate/SaaS theme with a Vercel-inspired visual language, demonstrated first with Biza Miz restaurant/café marketing content.

**In scope (this pass): Stage 1 + Stage 2 of the issue**

- Committed `DESIGN.md` translated from the DesignMD reference, plus `AGENTS.md` that mandates reading it and the Theme API before UI edits.
- Eshobe theme manifest, design tokens, typography, layout shell, theme switch, responsive RTL navigation.
- CMS-driven page system: homepage, restaurant/café landing, pricing explainer, features page, demo/contact form, light/dark, fa/en.
- Fixture-backed local development, content pack for Biza Miz, test and verification harness.

**Out of scope (Stages 3–4)**: live lead handoff/CRM and attribution, funnel analytics, live Biza Miz price sourcing, wallet/signup destinations, sitemap/robots, production preview→health→release→rollback, GHCR artifact workflow, full visual-regression baselines.

Nothing in this pass may claim a deployed integration or fabricate testimonials, metrics, prices, or product capabilities.

## 2. Decisions

| # | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Composition model B: contract block vocabulary with theme-owned designed variants | Keeps CMS authoring authority while reaching reference-level art direction; no invented block types |
| D2 | Theme key `eshobe-corporation` | Owner decision; matches repo identity in the CMS picker |
| D3 | Product showcase imagery is AI-generated, stored under `public/demo/`, fixture-only, labelled illustrative | Owner decision; contained so no fabricated imagery reaches production theme code |
| D4 | Stack mirrors `cms-arch2-theme`: Next 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, standalone Docker | Contract-proven sibling implementation |
| D5 | Vendor `@eshobe/site-runtime` as a workspace package instead of an ad-hoc alias shim | npm package is unpublished and missing documented exports (`resolveSiteRoute`, `siteOrigin`, `localeCodes`) |
| D6 | Announcement banner deferred | No localized announcement field exists in `header`, page blocks, or manifest settings; shipping a Persian-only banner would break fa/en parity |
| D7 | Blog/archive deferred | Issue schedules learning/blog for a later phase; `archive` block warns and renders nothing |

## 3. Design system

`DESIGN.md` is a first-class deliverable with machine-readable frontmatter (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and human sections (overview, layout, elevation, do/don't, Persian adaptations, accessibility, motion). It records attribution to the DesignMD reference and every deliberate deviation.

### 3.1 Reference translation

| Reference trait | Adaptation |
|---|---|
| Ink `#171717` primary CTA, near-white canvas, 1px hairlines | Kept as neutral core, tokenised |
| Four-step surface ladder (white / 98% / 95% / polarity-flipped ink) | Kept; inverted pair is semantic and self-flips in dark mode |
| Multi-stop mesh gradient, hero scale only | Original CSS multi-radial composition with our stops and geometry; never a copy of Vercel's SVG |
| Geist / Geist Mono | Vazirmatn (Persian, Eshobe standard) + Inter Variable (Latin) + JetBrains Mono (technical labels), all openly licensed, self-hosted. No Vercel font binaries, marks, copy, or screenshots |
| Aggressive negative display tracking | Latin only; Persian exempt (no negative tracking on connected script), 1.8 body leading, ~1.25 display leading |
| 4px spacing, 1400px container, 600/960/1200/1400 breakpoints | Kept; section rhythm 96–128px desktop, 56–64px mobile |
| Stacked shadows L1–L5 + inset hairline | Kept; dark mode ring becomes `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |
| Radius 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100 pills | Theme owns scale; CMS `radius` maps to control/card radius only. Marketing CTAs stay pill; nav CTAs 6px |

### 3.2 Tokens

- **Colors (light)**: `ink #171717`, `body #4d4d4d`, `mute #888888`, `hairline #ebebeb`, `hairline-strong #a1a1a1`, `canvas #ffffff`, `canvas-soft #fafafa`, `canvas-soft-2 #f5f5f5`, `link #0070f3`, semantic success/warning/error with soft/deep variants.
- **Colors (dark)**: `canvas #0a0a0a`, `canvas-soft #111111`, `canvas-soft-2 #171717`, `ink #ededed`, `body #a1a1a1`, `mute #737373`, `hairline #262626`, `hairline-strong #525252`.
- **CMS-editable only**: `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground`, `radius (none|sm|md|lg)`, `lineHeight (1.4–2.4)`, emitted on `body` scope via `themeCss(site.theme)` in a `#site-theme` style element. Every other token lives in theme CSS. The platform maps radius to `0 / 4 / 10 / 16px`; the default `md` is the nearest step to the reference's 8px card radius and is recorded as a deliberate deviation. When a tenant overrides it, cards and controls follow the tenant value; pill CTAs keep their brand shape.
- **Type scale**: display-xl 48/48/−2.4, display-lg 32/40/−1.28, display-md 24/32/−0.96, display-sm 20/28/−0.6, body-lg 18/28, body-md 16/24, body-sm 14/20/−0.28, caption 12/16, mono 12–13. Persian overrides tracking to 0 and leading to 1.8 body / ~1.25 display.
- **Radii**: 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100/full. **Spacing**: 4px base; 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192.
- **Elevation**: L1 inset hairline; L2 soft drop; L3 soft stack; L4 float stack; L5 modal. Stacked offsets only, always with inset ring.
- **Token parity**: CSS variables and a TS mirror are asserted by a unit test.

### 3.3 Components

Nav (sticky 64px, mobile overlay, locale/theme switches), buttons (primary pill, secondary, ghost; sm/md/lg; full state matrix), badge + mono eyebrow, marketing/soft cards, product mockup chrome, section header, feature grid, sticky-stack band, pricing card + featured, testimonial card, FAQ accordion, logo strip, announcement primitive (deferred in pages), inputs/select/textarea with helper and error text, submit states (idle/pending/sent/error), contact card, CTA band, footer.

### 3.4 Motion, accessibility, performance

- Motion: 150–250ms state transitions; scroll reveals ≤80ms stagger; transform/opacity only; no parallax, infinite loops, or layout-shift animation. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it.
- Accessibility: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible focus ring, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls`, labelled fields with `aria-describedby`, `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).
- Performance: server components by default; client islands limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, accordion, form, reveal observer; no animation library; self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload; `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; CSS hero mesh. Budgets: CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms; sections usable without JS except the islands.

## 4. Architecture

### 4.1 Repository layout

```text
eshobe-corporation-theme/
├── eshobe.theme.json
├── DESIGN.md
├── AGENTS.md
├── README.md
├── Dockerfile
├── package.json / pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── demo-packs/biza-miz/           # page JSON, form schema, nav links, import script
├── packages/site-runtime/         # vendored @eshobe/site-runtime workspace package
├── public/
│   ├── demo/                      # fixture-only generated mockups, labelled illustrative
│   └── fonts/                     # Vazirmatn, Inter, JetBrains Mono + licenses
├── src/
│   ├── app/[[...path]]/           # resolve → dispatch → RouteShell
│   ├── app/api/health/
│   ├── app/api/revalidate/
│   ├── app/api/[...segments]/     # allowlisted CMS proxy
│   ├── app/api/exit-preview/
│   ├── cms/                       # client, site descriptor, typed queries, draft policy, cache tags
│   ├── sections/                  # hero, showcase, feature-grid, sticky-stack, pricing, logos, testimonial, faq, cta, form, media, editorial, gallery, team, contact
│   ├── blocks/                    # blockType → section + variant resolver
│   ├── components/                # ui primitives, nav, footer, mockup chrome
│   ├── lib/{i18n,routing,theme,seo,media}
│   └── styles/                    # globals.css @theme tokens, fonts.css
└── tests/{unit,browser,fixtures}
```

### 4.2 Routes and bindings

- `fa` is unprefixed; `en` is prefixed (`/en/...`). A locale absent from `availableLocales` is a 404. `dir` derives per request.
- Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`.
- Each route resolves `themeRuntime.bindings[slot]` by page ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`). A missing binding is a 404; no bundled fallback copy.
- Page content is fetched by ID/slug with `depth=2` (single doc), media resolved via `site.media.origin`, and header/footer globals fetched in parallel.
- Nav comes from the `header` global. Footer columns use `footer.navItems`, followed by brand and legal line; no contact or social fields are invented, and no CMS fields beyond `navItems` are assumed.

### 4.3 Block → section resolution

| Contract block | Section | Variant rule |
|---|---|---|
| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | First `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop unless `heroTreatment=plain`; link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary). Last → inverted CTA band. Else inline |
| `mediaBlock` | showcase / editorial figure | Immediately after hero → 16:10 mockup chrome unless `showcaseTreatment=editorial`; else framed by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with viewport cap |
| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky`, disabled under reduced motion |
| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan polarity-flipped in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit` |
| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted |
| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |
| `logos` | logo strip | Monochrome via `logosMonochrome`, colour on hover |
| `content` | editorial columns | Lexical `direction` per field, `unicode-bidi: plaintext` |
| `gallery` | image grid | Columns from block |
| `team` | team grid | CMS members only |
| `contact` | contact card | Phones via `toLocaleDigits` |
| `formBlock` | CMS form | Renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim plus hidden honeypot |
| `archive` | deferred | Dev warning, null in production |

- Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically; inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA.
- Unknown `blockType`: log and render nothing. Never invent a block type.

### 4.4 Manifest

- `contractVersion: 1`, `key: "eshobe-corporation"`, `name: "Eshobe Corporation"`, `nameFa: "پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه"`, `siteTypes: ["business"]`, `locales: ["fa","en"]`.
- `capabilities`: `rtlFirst`, `multiLocale`, `pageBuilderBlocks`, `forms`.
- `design` defaults: `primary "#171717"`, `accent "#0070f3"`, `background "#fafafa"`, `foreground "#171717"`, `radius "md"`, `lineHeight 1.8`.
- `build`: `dockerfile`, port 3000, `healthCheckPath: "/api/health"`, `isStatic: false`; no `deployment` block (Coolify build strategy).
- `env: []` (all `ESHOBE_*` variables are platform-injected).
- `settings`: `heroTreatment` (select mesh|plain, default mesh), `featureTreatment` (select cards|sticky, default cards), `showcaseTreatment` (select mockup|editorial, default mockup), `logosMonochrome` (boolean, default true), `restaurantsSlug` (text, default "restaurants"), `pricingSlug` (text, default "pricing"), `featuresSlug` (text, default "features"), `demoSlug` (text, default "demo").
- `contentSlots`: `home` (type `page`, required), `restaurants` (type `page`), `pricing` (type `page`), `features` (type `page`), `demo` (type `page`).

## 5. Data flow, caching, preview, security

- **Bootstrap**: one cached `GET /api/site` per request (key-authenticated) validates `contractVersion`, media origin, locales, settings, bindings.
- **Tenancy**: every CMS call uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`; never a rewritten `Host` (loops back into the theme container). No `?site=` anywhere. The key never reaches the browser.
- **Draft policy**: centralized. A site key can read drafts, so public rendering always sends `draft=false` and `where[_status][equals]=published` for pages, posts, products and form submissions. Globals (`header`, `footer`, theme, store), `categories` and `search` do not carry a publish status, so they are read with the publish filter disabled but still tenant-scoped. Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then uses `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.
- **Cache**: `force-cache`, site 30s / content 60s, tags `cms:all` and `tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`.
- **Revalidation**: `POST /api/revalidate` verifies raw-body HMAC-SHA256 (`x-eshobe-signature`), a timestamp tolerance of ±5 minutes, a 64KB cap, purges payload tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s.
- **Proxy**: `/api/[...segments]` allowlists CMS heads (`site, pages, posts, products, categories, header, footer, forms, form-submissions, search, media, theme, store, checkout, payments, redirects, globals`), drops visitor cookies/auth, refuses recursion, and forwards to the CMS with its own host.
- **Media**: URLs resolved against `site.media.origin`; SVGs via `<img>`, never inline; remote patterns restricted to the CMS origin.

## 6. Forms

The demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions`:

```json
{ "form": "<formId>", "submissionData": [{ "field": "name", "value": "…" }] }
```

- Tenant is derived server-side from the form document; the client cannot choose it.
- Required consent is a **checkbox field in the CMS form schema** shipped with the content pack; the renderer never injects fields beyond the hidden honeypot.
- Inline validation with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; Persian-digit normalisation via `toAsciiDigits`; values preserved on failure; disabled submit while pending; success/error announced via `aria-live`; retry control.
- Hidden honeypot; spam rate-limiting is deferred to Stage 3.
- CRM handoff, attribution and analytics are **not** implemented in this pass.

## 7. Failure states

| Condition | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Unknown route | Themed 404, `noindex` |
| Missing binding | 404, no bundled copy |
| CMS unreachable | Cached content when available; else themed 503 with retry; health endpoint stays local |
| Site suspended/archived | Contract holding page, HTTP 200, `noindex` |
| Contract version mismatch | Loud developer-facing error page; no silent render |
| Empty collection block | Section omitted |
| Premium/featured content | No placeholder testimonials, logos, metrics, or prices |

## 8. Biza Miz content

- Theme code stays tenant-neutral; Biza Miz copy, page structures, nav links and form schema ship in `demo-packs/biza-miz/`.
- The content pack mirrors the issue's homepage rhythm: hero → dashboard showcase → benefits → feature/industry grid → pricing explanation → proof/FAQ → final CTA. Priority pages: restaurants/cafés, demo request, pricing, features.
- Product messaging follows the proven POS workflow **menu → table/order → payment/receipt → shift/sales report**; Accounting, CRM, Growth and Website capabilities are only described at their actual release readiness.
- The pack carries **no invented prices**. Pricing renders CMS `pricing` plans; when a plan is not sourced from the Biza Miz catalogue it must be marked illustrative in the content, never presented as a live licence fee.
- Account signup, activation, wallet and payment stay Biza Miz's; the theme links out to tenant-supplied destinations and implements no checkout, wallet or identity.
- An idempotent import script uses only capabilities a site key has (pages, posts, forms, header/footer). Media must be uploaded by an editor because a site key cannot create media.
- The fixture provider mirrors the content pack and serves generated mockups from `public/demo/`, visibly labelled illustrative. Production renders CMS media only.
- Demo form is the only lead path in this pass; Stage 3 owns the sales-process handoff.

## 9. Verification

- `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build.
- Unit (vitest): route/locale resolution, binding resolution, variant resolver, band rhythm, draft policy, cache tags, HMAC revalidation, form validation, token parity, manifest validation mirroring the CMS parser.
- Browser (Playwright, fixture CMS): five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark; keyboard navigation; mobile menu; theme persistence; locale switch; form success/failure; reduced motion; axe; RTL overflow (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`); visual snapshots.
- Manual/recorded: retry of the DesignMD live reference and a written deviation list in `DESIGN.md`.
- No claim of deployment, live CMS integration, or production performance until those are actually run.

## 10. Risks and open items

1. **Live DesignMD reference** returned HTTP 429 during design. Reconciliation is deferred to implementation; every deviation must be recorded, not assumed.
2. **AI-generated showcase imagery** conflicts with the issue's "authentic product demonstration visuals" and "no fabricated claims". Mitigation: fixture-only, labelled, no invented metrics; real screenshots can replace them via CMS media at any time.
3. **Unpublished runtime package**: vendored workspace package; parity tested against the CMS source.
4. **No live tenant in this pass**: content pack + fixtures replace a claimed deployment.
5. **Spam protection** is honeypot-only until Stage 3.
6. **Font licensing**: only OFL-licensed families; licenses committed with the binaries.

## 11. Acceptance mapping (Stage 1 + 2)

| Issue criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| `DESIGN.md` committed, attributed, original, agent guidance refers to it | DESIGN.md + AGENTS.md deliverables |
| Reusable components, responsive homepage, visual review at 3 widths | Component set, Playwright snapshots |
| RTL Persian first-class; English LTR; dark/light; reduced motion; keyboard | i18n/RTL + a11y sections and tests |
| CMS edits publish without theme changes; no cross-tenant exposure | Block/variant architecture, key-only server access, cache/tag tests |
| Demo CTA and form work end-to-end | CMS form + submission route, verified against fixtures and a tenant where credentials exist |
| Preview/health/release/rollback tested through Eshobe | `/api/health` implemented; preview→release→rollback **deferred to Stage 4** |
| No fabricated testimonials, metrics, prices, claims | Omit-empty policy, fixture labelling, no hardcoded content |

## 12. Implementation outline

1. **Foundation**: scaffold, manifest, vendored runtime, tokens, fonts, layout shell, nav/footer, theme switch, health/proxy/revalidate routes, fixtures, unit harness.
2. **Design contract**: write `DESIGN.md` + `AGENTS.md`; retry the live reference; record deviations.
3. **Sections**: primitives and all business-block sections with variant resolution.
4. **Routes**: home, restaurants, pricing, features, demo, generic CMS pages; metadata and locale switching.
5. **Forms and states**: CMS form island, error/empty/holding pages.
6. **Content pack**: Biza Miz page JSON, form schema, import script, generated mockups.
7. **Verification**: Playwright suite, axe, RTL overflow, snapshots; run `pnpm verify`.

3398	      return { kind: 'redirect', to: remaining.length === 0 ? '/' : `/${remaining.join('/')}` }

3457	```ts
3458	import { HOME_SLUG, localeHref } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'
3459	
3460	import type { CmsLink, FooterGlobal, HeaderGlobal } from '@/cms/types'
3461	
3462	export type NavLink = { href: string; label: string; newTab: boolean }
3463	
3464	const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
3465	  Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
3466	
3467	const safeUrl = (value: string): string | null => {
3468	  const trimmed = value.trim()
3469	  if (trimmed === '') return null
3470	  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed
3471	  try {
3472	    const url = new URL(trimmed)
3473	    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null
3474	  } catch {
3475	    return null
3476	  }
3477	}
3478	
3479	/** CMS link → href. Reference links use the populated page slug; ids alone cannot route. */
3480	export function linkHref(raw: unknown, locale: string, siteDefault: string): string | null {
3481	  if (!isRecord(raw)) return null
3482	  const link = raw as CmsLink
3483	  let href: string | null = null
3484	
3485	  if (link.type === 'custom') {
3486	    href = typeof link.url === 'string' ? safeUrl(link.url) : null
3487	  } else if (link.type === 'reference') {
3488	    const value = link.reference?.value
3489	    if (isRecord(value) && typeof value.slug === 'string') {
3490	      const slug = value.slug === HOME_SLUG || value.slug === '' ? '/' : `/${value.slug}`
3491	      href = localeHref(slug, locale, siteDefault)
3492	    }
3493	  }
3494	
3495	  if (!href) return null
3496	  // Internal hrefs were localized above; external hrefs must never be prefixed.
3497	  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href) || href.startsWith('//')) return href
3498	  return localeHref(href, locale, siteDefault)
3499	}
3500	
3501	export function normalizeNav(
3502	  global: HeaderGlobal | FooterGlobal | null | undefined,
3503	  locale: string,
3504	  siteDefault: string,
3505	): NavLink[] {
3506	  const items = Array.isArray(global?.navItems) ? global.navItems : []
3507	  const links: NavLink[] = []
3508	  for (const item of items) {
3509	    const raw = isRecord(item) ? item.link : null
3510	    const href = linkHref(raw, locale, siteDefault)
3511	    const label = isRecord(raw) && typeof raw.label === 'string' ? raw.label.trim() : ''
3512	    if (!href || label === '') continue
3513	    links.push({
3514	      href,
3515	      label,
3516	      newTab: isRecord(raw) && raw.newTab === true,
3517	    })
3518	  }
3519	  return links
3520	}

import type { Block, Field } from 'payload'

import { TENANT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FIELD } from '@/admin/fields/mediaUploadComponentPath'

/**
 * How a photograph sits on the page. Themes read these to apply their own sizing rule
 * (a ratio from a short set plus a viewport-height cap), so an editor composes with
 * intent instead of every image rendering at its exact pixel size and full width.
 * All three are optional: a row saved before they existed renders as `content` / `auto`.
 */
export const mediaSizeField: Field = {
  name: 'size',
  type: 'select',
  label: 'پهنا',
  defaultValue: 'content',
  admin: { width: '33%' },
  options: [
    { label: 'باریک', value: 'narrow' },
    { label: 'هم‌پهنای متن', value: 'content' },
    { label: 'پهن', value: 'wide' },
    { label: 'تمام‌صفحه', value: 'full' },
  ],
}

export const mediaAspectOptions = [
  { label: 'خودکار (بر اساس جهت تصویر)', value: 'auto' },
  { label: 'افقی عریض ۱۶:۹', value: '16/9' },
  { label: 'افقی ۳:۲', value: '3/2' },
  { label: 'افقی ۴:۳', value: '4/3' },
  { label: 'مربع ۱:۱', value: '1/1' },
  { label: 'عمودی ۴:۵', value: '4/5' },
  { label: 'عمودی ۳:۴', value: '3/4' },
  { label: 'نسبت اصلی تصویر', value: 'original' },
]

export const mediaAspectField: Field = {
  name: 'aspect',
  type: 'select',
  label: 'نسبت قاب',
  defaultValue: 'auto',
  admin: {
    description: 'تصویر قاب را پر می‌کند و نقطهٔ کانونی رسانه حفظ می‌شود.',
    width: '33%',
  },
  options: mediaAspectOptions,
}

const mediaField: Field = {
  name: 'media',
  type: 'upload',
  label: 'تصویر',
  relationTo: 'media',
  required: true,
  // Also registered as a Lexical feature, which the generic schema traversal cannot
  // reach — so the tenant media picker is named here explicitly.
  admin: { components: { Field: TENANT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FIELD } },
}

const presentation = (localizedCaption: boolean): Field => ({
  type: 'row',
  fields: [
    mediaSizeField,
    mediaAspectField,
    {
      name: 'caption',
      type: 'text',
      label: 'زیرنویس',
      // Page layout rows localize their text; inside a rich-text field the whole
      // field is already localized, so the caption must not be localized again.
      localized: localizedCaption,
      admin: { width: '34%' },
    },
  ],
})

const labels = { plural: 'تصاویر', singular: 'تصویر' }

/** Page-layout block (`pages.layout`). */
export const MediaBlock: Block = {
  slug: 'mediaBlock',
  interfaceName: 'MediaBlock',
  labels,
  fields: [mediaField, presentation(true)],
}

/** The same block inside rich text (posts, columns): stored as JSON, caption unlocalized. */
export const MediaBlockInline: Block = {
  slug: 'mediaBlock',
  interfaceName: 'MediaBlockInline',
  labels,
  fields: [mediaField, presentation(false)],
}

import type { Field, GroupField } from 'payload'

import deepMerge from '@/utilities/deepMerge'

export type LinkAppearances = 'default' | 'outline'

export const appearanceOptions: Record<LinkAppearances, { label: string; value: string }> = {
  default: {
    label: 'Default',
    value: 'default',
  },
  outline: {
    label: 'Outline',
    value: 'outline',
  },
}

type LinkType = (options?: {
  appearances?: LinkAppearances[] | false
  disableLabel?: boolean
  overrides?: Partial<GroupField>
}) => Field

export const link: LinkType = ({ appearances, disableLabel = false, overrides = {} } = {}) => {
  const linkResult: GroupField = {
    name: 'link',
    type: 'group',
    admin: {
      hideGutter: true,
    },
    fields: [
      {
        type: 'row',
        fields: [
          {
            name: 'type',
            type: 'radio',
            admin: {
              layout: 'horizontal',
              width: '50%',
            },
            defaultValue: 'reference',
            options: [
              {
                label: 'Internal link',
                value: 'reference',
              },
              {
                label: 'Custom URL',
                value: 'custom',
              },
            ],
          },
          {
            name: 'newTab',
            type: 'checkbox',
            admin: {
              style: {
                alignSelf: 'flex-end',
              },
              width: '50%',
            },
            label: 'Open in new tab',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  }

  const linkTypes: Field[] = [
    {
      name: 'reference',
      type: 'relationship',
      admin: {
        condition: (_, siblingData) => siblingData?.type === 'reference',
      },
      label: 'Document to link to',
      relationTo: ['pages', 'posts'],
      required: true,
    },
    {
      name: 'url',
      type: 'text',
      admin: {
        condition: (_, siblingData) => siblingData?.type === 'custom',
      },
      label: 'Custom URL',
      // An external link often points at a different page per language.
      localized: true,
      required: true,
    },
  ]

  if (!disableLabel) {
    linkTypes.map((linkType) => ({
      ...linkType,
      admin: {
        ...linkType.admin,
        width: '50%',
      },
    }))

    linkResult.fields.push({
      type: 'row',
      fields: [
        ...linkTypes,
        {
          name: 'label',
          type: 'text',
          admin: {
            width: '50%',
          },
          label: 'Label',
          localized: true,
          required: true,
        },
      ],
    })
  } else {
    linkResult.fields = [...linkResult.fields, ...linkTypes]
  }

  if (appearances !== false) {
    let appearanceOptionsToUse = [appearanceOptions.default, appearanceOptions.outline]

    if (appearances) {
      appearanceOptionsToUse = appearances.map((appearance) => appearanceOptions[appearance])
    }

    linkResult.fields.push({
      name: 'appearance',
      type: 'select',
      admin: {
        description: 'Choose how the link should be rendered.',
      },
      defaultValue: 'default',
      options: appearanceOptionsToUse,
    })
  }

  return deepMerge(linkResult, overrides)
}

Implementation details:
```ts
export function planSections({ layout, allowed, landing, settings }): PlanResult {
  const blocks = Array.isArray(layout) ? layout : []
  const allowedSet = new Set(allowed)
  const valid: { block: Block; index: number }[] = []
  const diagnostics = []
  blocks.forEach((raw, index) => {
    if (!isRecord(raw) || typeof raw.blockType !== 'string' || raw.blockType.trim()==='') {
      diagnostics.push({index, blockType:'', reason:'invalid'}); return
    }
    const blockType = raw.blockType as string
    if (!isBusinessBlock(blockType)) { diag unknown; return }
    if (!allowedSet.has(blockType)) { diag disallowed; return }
    if (blockType === 'archive') { diag deferred; return }
    valid.push({ block: raw as Block, index })
  })

  // Surface + variant assignment
  const ctaIndexes = valid.filter(v=>v.block.blockType==='cta').map(v=>v.index)
  const firstCta = landing ? ctaIndexes[0] : undefined
  const lastCta = ctaIndexes[ctaIndexes.length-1]
  let alternating = 0
  const sections = valid.map(({block, index}) => {
    const type = block.blockType
    let kind, variant, surface
    if (type==='cta' && index===firstCta) { kind='hero'; variant=settings.heroTreatment; surface='canvas' }
    else if (type==='cta' && index===lastCta) { kind='cta-band'; variant='band'; surface='ink' }
    else if (type==='cta') { kind='inline-cta'; variant='inline'; surface= next() }
    else if (type==='mediaBlock' && isAfterHero) { kind='showcase'; variant=settings.showcaseTreatment; surface='ink' }
    ...
  })
}
```
"Immediately after hero": previous valid item is the hero cta. So track hero index; showcase if index === hero index + 1 and blockType mediaBlock.

Surface alternation for normal sections: `const surface = alternating++ % 2 === 0 ? 'canvas' : 'canvas-soft'`.

Ordering keys: `block.id` if string non-empty else `${block.blockType}-${index}`.

One subtlety: single cta on landing is both first and last; hero takes precedence. On non-landing, single cta is last → band. Good.

`archive` disallowed order: contract-known then archive deferred. If site doesn't list archive either way, diagnostic deferred vs disallowed? Spec says archive warns/deferred regardless. Check archive before allowed? If archive not in site.blocks, deferred still fine. Do known check → if archive → deferred → then allowed check for rest. But descriptor.blocks excludes archive in fixture (site() list excludes archive), so this matters for tests. I'll check archive before allowed.

`allowed` empty means descriptor missing? If `blocks` is absent/empty, should theme render none (strict) or all? Spec: descriptor has blocks; unknown block logs. Use strict: empty allowed → all disallowed except? That would render nothing if CMS omits blocks. Descriptor contract likely always includes. Strict is safer. But fixture site() includes list.

**Response:**

/**
 * The only place dates and numbers are formatted.
 *
 * Persian pages get Shamsi (Jalali) dates and Persian-Indic digits; every other
 * locale gets its own calendar and digits from the same call site. Nothing else
 * may call `Intl` directly, use `toLocaleDateString()`, or interpolate a raw
 * `Date` — see CLAUDE.md.
 */

import type { CurrencyCode } from './money'

import { currencies, minorToMajor } from './money'

// Payload locale codes are short forms; Intl wants a BCP 47 tag.
const intlLocale = (locale: string) => (locale === 'fa' ? 'fa-IR' : locale)

// ponytail: one platform timezone, so a UTC timestamp near midnight doesn't
// render as the previous day. Becomes a `timezone` field on `sites` if we ever
// host a customer outside Iran.
const PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Tehran'

// Cache Intl formatters to avoid the high overhead of instantiating them on every function call.
const dateTimeFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>()
const numberFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>()


export const formatDate = (
  date: Date | string | number | null | undefined,
  locale: string,
  options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'long' },
): string => {
  if (date === null || date === undefined || date === '') return ''

  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options)}`
  let formatter = dateTimeFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale(locale), {
      // 'persian' *is* the Jalali calendar — Intl ships it, so no date library.
      calendar: locale === 'fa' ? 'persian' : undefined,
      timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE,
      ...options,
    })
    dateTimeFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }

  return formatter.format(new Date(date))
}

export const formatNumber = (
  value: number,
  locale: string,
  options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
): string => {
  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options || {})}`
  let formatter = numberFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(intlLocale(locale), options)
    numberFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }
  return formatter.format(value)
}

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 *
 * Re-exported from `src/lib/digits.ts` so money parsing can share the mapping without
 * importing this module; the rule that every rendered number goes through here stands.
 */
export { toLocaleDigits } from './digits'

/**
 * A price, in the site's currency, in the active locale's digits.
 *
 * `minor` is the stored integer — see `src/lib/money.ts` for why prices are minor
 * units of the *site's* currency and not of the product. The unit word is appended
 * from the currency registry, because a bare number on an Iranian storefront is
 * ambiguous by a factor of ten.
 *
 * Renders `۱٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان` on `fa` and `1,200,000 Toman` on `en` for the same
 * stored value.
 */
export const formatPrice = (
  minor: null | number | undefined,
  code: CurrencyCode,
  locale: string,
  options: { hideUnit?: boolean } = {},
): string => {
  if (typeof minor !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(minor)) return ''

  const currency = currencies[code]
  const amount = formatNumber(minorToMajor(minor, code), locale, {
    maximumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
    minimumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
  })

  if (options.hideUnit) return amount

  const unit = currency.unit[locale as 'en' | 'fa'] ?? currency.unit.en

  return `${amount} ${unit}`
}

import type { ThemeSettings } from '@/lib/theme/settings'

export const BUSINESS_BLOCK_TYPES = [...] as const
export type BusinessBlockType = ...

export type SectionKind = ...
export type SectionSurface = ...
export type SectionPlan = { key: string; kind: SectionKind; variant: string; surface: SectionSurface; block: Block }
export type PlanDiagnostic = ...
export type SectionPlanResult = { sections: SectionPlan[]; diagnostics: PlanDiagnostic[] }

type PlanInput = {
  layout: unknown
  allowed: readonly string[]
  landing: boolean
  settings: Pick<ThemeSettings, 'heroTreatment' | 'featureTreatment' | 'showcaseTreatment'>
}

export function planSections({...}): SectionPlanResult {
  const raw = Array.isArray(layout) ? layout : []
  const allowedSet = new Set(allowed)
  const accepted: { block: Block; index: number }[] = []
  const diagnostics: PlanDiagnostic[] = []

  raw.forEach((entry, index) => {
    if (!isRecord(entry) || typeof entry.blockType !== 'string' || entry.blockType.trim() === '') {
      diagnostics.push({ index, blockType: '', reason: 'invalid' }); return
    }
    const blockType = entry.blockType.trim()
    if (!isBusinessBlockType(blockType)) { diagnostics.push({index, blockType, reason:'unknown'}); return }
    if (blockType === 'archive') { diagnostics.push({index, blockType, reason:'deferred'}); return }
    if (!allowedSet.has(blockType)) { diagnostics.push({index, blockType, reason:'disallowed'}); return }
    accepted.push({ block: entry as Block, index })
  })

  const ctaPositions = accepted.filter(e=>e.block.blockType==='cta').map(e=>e.index)
  const heroIndex = landing && ctaPositions.length > 0 ? ctaPositions[0] : null
  const bandIndex = ctaPositions.length > 0 && ctaPositions[ctaPositions.length-1] !== heroIndex ? ctaPositions[ctaPositions.length-1] : null

  let alternator = 0
  const nextSurface = (): SectionSurface => {
    const surface = alternator % 2 === 0 ? 'canvas' : 'canvas-soft'
    alternator += 1
    return surface
  }

  const sections: SectionPlan[] = []
  accepted.forEach((entry, position) => {
    const { block, index } = entry
    const type = block.blockType as BusinessBlockType
    const key = typeof block.id === 'string' && block.id !== '' ? block.id : `${type}-${index}`
    const previous = accepted[position - 1]?.block.blockType
    const afterHero = heroIndex !== null && previous === 'cta' && entry.index === heroIndex + 1 // Hmm index equality fails if blocks had omitted blocks between; media immediately after hero in raw layout is index+1. Using previous accepted cta and index === heroIndex+1. Good.

    switch (type) {
      case 'cta':
        if (index === heroIndex) sections.push({key, kind:'hero', variant: settings.heroTreatment, surface:'canvas', block})
        else if (index === bandIndex) sections.push({key, kind:'cta-band', variant:'band', surface:'ink', block})
        else sections.push({key, kind:'inline-cta', variant:'inline', surface: nextSurface(), block})
        return
      case 'mediaBlock':
        if (afterHero) sections.push({key, kind:'showcase', variant: settings.showcaseTreatment, surface:'ink', block})
        else sections.push({key, kind:'editorial-figure', variant:'framed', surface: nextSurface(), block})
        return
      case 'features':
        sections.push({key, kind:'features', variant: settings.featureTreatment === 'sticky' ? 'sticky' : 'grid', surface: nextSurface(), block})
        return

        </Accordion.Header>
        <Accordion.Content className="pb-5 text-body">{item.answer}</Accordion.Content>
      </Accordion.Item>
    ))}
  </Accordion.Root>
}

/**
 * Digit mapping between scripts — the primitive under `formatNumber` (render) and
 * `parsePrice` (input).
 */

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 */
export const toLocaleDigits = (value: string, locale: string): string =>
  locale === 'fa' ? toAsciiDigits(value).replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => PERSIAN_DIGITS[Number(d)]!) : value

/**
 * Persian-Indic and Arabic-Indic digits → ASCII, for anything typed *into* the
 * platform.
 */
export const toAsciiDigits = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))

170	   * `/api/categories`, `/api/forms`, `/api/search`, and the `header`/`footer` per-site
171	   * singletons (collections with `isGlobal: true`) answer
172	   * `400 QueryError: the following path cannot be queried: _status`. Every one of them
173	   * still accepts `draft`, so the draft half of the policy always applies — only the
174	   * `where[_status]` half is skipped.
175	   */
176	  publishFilter?: boolean
177	}

179	export { buildQueryString } from './query'

181	/**
182	 * Draft policy, applied in one place.
183	 *
184	 * A site API key is allowed to read drafts for its tenant. Public rendering must therefore
185	 * exclude them explicitly instead of relying on anonymous access rules — otherwise
186	 * unpublished content would leak onto a production page. In preview the filter is dropped
187	 * deliberately.
188	 */
189	export function applyDraftPolicy(
190	  ctx: CmsContext,
191	  options: CmsQuery,
192	  params: Record<string, QueryValue>,
193	): Record<string, QueryValue> {
194	  const wantsDrafts = Boolean(options.drafts) && ctx.allowDrafts
195	  if (wantsDrafts) {
196	    params['draft'] = 'true'
197	    return params
198	  }
199	  params['draft'] = 'false'
200	  // Published-explicitly collections only; see `CmsQuery.publishFilter`.
201	  if (options.publishFilter !== false) params['where[_status][equals]'] = 'published'
202	  return params
203	}

205	export type CmsJson<T> = {
206	  data: T
207	  status: number
208	}
209	
210	/** Low-level read. Returns the parsed body with its status so callers can map 404 to null. */
211	export async function cmsFetchJson<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<CmsJson<T>> {
212	  const ctx = await getCmsContext()
213	  const params = { ...(options.query ?? {}) }
214	  if (options.locale) params['locale'] = options.locale
215	  applyDraftPolicy(ctx, options, params)
216	  const queryString = buildQueryString(params)
217	  const url = `${ctx.baseUrl}${path}${queryString ? `?${queryString}` : ''}`
218	  const tags = cacheTags({
219	    tenantKey: ctx.tenantKey,
220	    locale: options.locale,
221	    resource: options.resource,
222	  })
223	
224	  if (ctx.mode === 'fixture') {
225	    const fixture = fixtureFetch<T>(path, params)
226	    if (!fixture) throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, `fixture: no handler for ${path}`)
227	    return fixture
228	  }
229	
230	  const init: RequestInit & { next?: { revalidate?: number; tags?: string[] } } = {
231	    headers: {
232	      accept: 'application/json',
233	      // Never forwarded from a visitor; only the platform-injected site key travels here.
234	      ...(ctx.env.apiKey ? { authorization: `Bearer ${ctx.env.apiKey}` } : {}),
235	    },
236	    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10_000),
237	  }
238	  if (ctx.preview) {
239	    init.cache = 'no-store'
240	  } else {
241	    init.cache = 'force-cache'
242	    init.next = { revalidate: options.revalidate ?? CONTENT_REVALIDATE_SECONDS, tags }
243	  }
244	
245	  let response: Response
246	  try {
247	    response = await fetch(url, init)
248	  } catch (cause) {
249	    const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'network error'
250	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 0, `CMS unreachable: ${message}`)
251	  }
252	
253	  if (response.status === 404) return { data: undefined as T, status: 404 }
254	  if (!response.ok) {
255	    const detail = await safeErrorMessage(response)
256	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, response.status, detail)
257	  }
258	  const data = (await response.json()) as T
259	  return { data, status: response.status }
260	}
261	
262	async function safeErrorMessage(response: Response): Promise<string> {
263	  try {
264	    const text = await response.text()
265	    if (text.length > 400) return `${text.slice(0, 400)}…`
266	    return text
267	  } catch {
268	    return response.statusText || 'request failed'
269	  }
270	}
271	
272	/** Read that throws on 404 — for documents a route genuinely requires. */
273	export async function cmsFetchOr404<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<T> {
274	  const result = await cmsFetchJson<T>(path, options)
275	  if (result.status === 404 || result.data === undefined) {
276	    throw new CmsRequestError(path, 404, 'not found')
277	  }
278	  return result.data
279	}
280	
281	/** Read that returns null on 404 — for optional documents and bound content. */
282	export async function cmsFetchOptional<T>(path: string, options: CmsQuery = {}): Promise<T | null> {
283	  const result = await cmsFetchJson<T>(path, options)
284	  if (result.status === 404 || result.data === undefined) return null
285	  return result.data
286	}

2	 * Route planning and URL building.
3	 *
4	 * This is the single place that decides *what* a CMS path renders (a composition, a generic
5	 * page, an archive) and how every internal URL is spelled. Views never hand-build `/${slug}`.
6	 *
7	 * Composition detection has two supported sources, in this order:

9	 *   1. a content-slot binding (`themeRuntime.bindings`) — the bound document wins, which makes
10	 *      it correct for localized slugs, since binding identity is locale-independent;
11	 *   2. a comma-separated page-slug setting (`projectsSlug`, `aboutSlug`, …) for sites that do
12	 *      not use bindings.
13	 *

17	import { HOME_SLUG, localeHref, pagePath, postPath, type SiteRoute } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'

19	import type { BoundContent, Post } from '@/lib/cms/types'
20	import { settingIncludesSlug, type ThemeSettings } from '@/lib/theme/settings'
21	
22	export type CompositionKind = 'projects' | 'education' | 'about' | 'contact'
23	
24	export const COMPOSITION_KEYS: Record<CompositionKind, 'projectsSlug' | 'educationSlug' | 'aboutSlug' | 'contactSlug'> = {
25	  projects: 'projectsSlug',
26	  education: 'educationSlug',
27	  about: 'aboutSlug',
28	  contact: 'contactSlug',
29	}
30	
31	export type RoutePlan =
32	  | { kind: 'home' }
33	  | { kind: 'composition'; composition: CompositionKind; slug: string }
34	  | { kind: 'page'; slug: string }
35	  | { kind: 'posts'; page: number; category: string | null }
36	  | { kind: 'post'; slug: string; viaAlias: CompositionKind | null }
37	  | { kind: 'search'; query: string }
38	  /** The contract's store route. This theme does not claim store support, so it 404s. */
39	  | { kind: 'store-unavailable'; order: string | null }
40	  | { kind: 'unresolved'; segments: string[] }
41	
42	function matchesSlugList(settings: ThemeSettings, key: keyof ThemeSettings, slug: string): boolean {
43	  const value = settings[key]
44	  return typeof value === 'string' && settingIncludesSlug(value, slug)
45	}
46	
47	/** Provisional plan from the URL alone (bindings are applied later, once the page is loaded). */
48	export function planRoute(route: SiteRoute, settings: ThemeSettings, params: { page?: number; category?: string | null; query?: string }): RoutePlan {
49	  switch (route.kind) {
50	    case 'page': {
51	      if (route.slug === HOME_SLUG) return { kind: 'home' }
52	      for (const composition of Object.keys(COMPOSITION_KEYS) as CompositionKind[]) {
53	        if (matchesSlugList(settings, COMPOSITION_KEYS[composition], route.slug)) {
54	          return { kind: 'composition', composition, slug: route.slug }
55	        }
56	      }
57	      return { kind: 'page', slug: route.slug }
58	    }
59	    case 'posts':
60	      return { kind: 'posts', page: params.page && params.page > 1 ? params.page : 1, category: params.category ?? null }
61	    case 'post':
62	      return { kind: 'post', slug: route.slug, viaAlias: null }
63	    case 'search':
64	      return { kind: 'search', query: params.query ?? '' }
65	    case 'checkout':
66	      return { kind: 'store-unavailable', order: route.order }
67	    case 'product':
68	      return { kind: 'unresolved', segments: ['products', route.slug] }
69	    case 'unresolved': {
70	      const [head, slug, ...rest] = route.segments
71	      if (head && slug && rest.length === 0) {
72	        for (const composition of ['projects', 'education'] as const) {
73	          if (matchesSlugList(settings, COMPOSITION_KEYS[composition], head)) {
74	            return { kind: 'post', slug, viaAlias: composition }
75	          }
76	        }
77	      }
78	      return { kind: 'unresolved', segments: route.segments }
79	    }
80	  }
81	}
82	
83	/** True when a resolved document id *is* the bound document for one of the compositions. */
84	export function bindingComposition(
85	  pageId: string | null,
86	  bindings: Record<string, BoundContent | null>,
87	): CompositionKind | null {
88	  if (!pageId) return null
89	  for (const composition of Object.keys(COMPOSITION_KEYS) as CompositionKind[]) {
90	    const bound = bindings[composition]
91	    if (bound && bound.id !== null && bound.id !== undefined && String(bound.id) === pageId) return composition
92	  }
93	  return null
94	}
95	
96	/** Bindings override slug-list detection — the operator's explicit choice wins. */
97	export function reviseWithBinding(
98	  plan: RoutePlan,
99	  pageId: string | null,
100	  bindings: Record<string, BoundContent | null>,
101	): RoutePlan {
102	  if (plan.kind !== 'page' && plan.kind !== 'composition') return plan
103	  const fromBinding = bindingComposition(pageId, bindings)
104	  if (fromBinding) return { kind: 'composition', composition: fromBinding, slug: plan.slug }
105	  return plan
106	}

109	
110	export function homeHref(locale: string, defaultLocale: string): string {
111	  return localeHref('/', locale, defaultLocale)
112	}
113	
114	export function pageHref(slug: string, locale: string, defaultLocale: string): string {
115	  if (slug === HOME_SLUG) return homeHref(locale, defaultLocale)
116	  return localeHref(pagePath(slug), locale, defaultLocale)
117	}
118	
119	export function postHref(slug: string, locale: string, defaultLocale: string): string {
120	  return localeHref(postPath(slug), locale, defaultLocale)
121	}
122	
123	export function postsHref(
124	  locale: string,
125	  defaultLocale: string,
126	  options: { page?: number; category?: string | null } = {},
127	): string {
128	  const base = localeHref('/posts', locale, defaultLocale)
129	  const params = new URLSearchParams()
130	  if (options.category) params.set('category', options.category)
131	  if (options.page && options.page > 1) params.set('page', String(options.page))
132	  const query = params.toString()
133	  return query ? `${base}?${query}` : base
134	}
135	
136	export function archiveHref(
137	  slug: string,
138	  locale: string,
139	  defaultLocale: string,
140	  options: { page?: number; category?: string | null } = {},
141	): string {
142	  const base = pageHref(slug, locale, defaultLocale)
143	  const params = new URLSearchParams()
144	  if (options.category) params.set('category', options.category)
145	  if (options.page && options.page > 1) params.set('page', String(options.page))
146	  const query = params.toString()
147	  return query ? `${base}?${query}` : base
148	}
149	
150	export function searchHref(locale: string, defaultLocale: string, query?: string): string {
151	  const base = localeHref('/search', locale, defaultLocale)
152	  if (!query || query.trim() === '') return base
153	  return `${base}?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}`
154	}
155	
156	/* ------------------------------------------------------------- post context */
157	
158	/** Which archive a post belongs to, derived from its populated categories only. */
159	export function postArchive(categories: Post['categories'], settings: ThemeSettings): CompositionKind | 'blog' {
160	  const names = new Set<string>()
161	  for (const entry of categories ?? []) {
162	    if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object') continue
163	    const slug = typeof entry.slug === 'string' ? entry.slug : null
164	    if (slug) names.add(slug)
165	    const parent = entry.parent
166	    if (parent && typeof parent === 'object' && typeof parent.slug === 'string') names.add(parent.slug)
167	  }
168	  if (names.has(settings.projectsCategorySlug)) return 'projects'
169	  if (names.has(settings.educationCategorySlug)) return 'education'
170	  return 'blog'
171	}

35	export function isKnownBlockType(value: string): value is KnownBlockType {
36	  return KNOWN.has(value)

39	export type BlockSkipReason = 'unknown-block' | 'block-not-allowed' | 'malformed-block'

41	export type BlockDiagnostic = {
42	  blockType: string
43	  blockId: string | null
44	  index: number
45	  reason: BlockSkipReason
46	}

49	  const id = block.id
50	  return typeof id === 'string' && id !== '' ? id : `block-${index}`

54	 * Partition a layout into renderable blocks and diagnostics, preserving CMS order and IDs.
55	 * `allowed` is `site.blocks` from the descriptor; when it is empty the CMS advertised no
56	 * allowlist, so only knownness is enforced.
57	 */
58	export function partitionBlocks(
59	  blocks: Block[] | null | undefined,
60	  allowed: readonly string[],
61	): { renderable: Block[]; diagnostics: BlockDiagnostic[] } {
62	  const renderable: Block[] = []
63	  const diagnostics: BlockDiagnostic[] = []
64	  if (!Array.isArray(blocks)) return { renderable, diagnostics }
65	  const allow = new Set(allowed)
66	
67	  blocks.forEach((block, index) => {
68	    if (!block || typeof block !== 'object' || typeof block.blockType !== 'string') {
69	      diagnostics.push({ blockType: 'unknown', blockId: null, index, reason: 'malformed-block' })
70	      return
71	    }
72	    const id = typeof block.id === 'string' ? block.id : null
73	    if (!isKnownBlockType(block.blockType)) {
74	      diagnostics.push({ blockType: block.blockType, blockId: id, index, reason: 'unknown-block' })
75	      return
76	    }
77	    if (allow.size > 0 && !allow.has(block.blockType)) {
78	      diagnostics.push({ blockType: block.blockType, blockId: id, index, reason: 'block-not-allowed' })
79	      return
80	    }
81	    renderable.push(block)
82	  })
83	
84	  return { renderable, diagnostics }
85	}

89	  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' || diagnostics.length === 0) return
90	  for (const diagnostic of diagnostics) {
91	    console.warn(
92	      `[linework] skipped block "${diagnostic.blockType}" at index ${diagnostic.index} (${diagnostic.reason})`,
93	    )

export const dirFor = (locale: string): 'ltr' | 'rtl' => (locale === 'fa' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr')

/** Prefix an internal path when the active locale is not the site's default locale. */
export const localeHref = (path: string, locale: string, siteDefault: string): string =>
  path.startsWith('/') && locale !== siteDefault ? `/${locale}${path === '/' ? '' : path}` : path

export type Theme = {
  primary?: string | null
  accent?: string | null
  background?: string | null
  foreground?: string | null
  radius?: 'lg' | 'md' | 'sm' | 'none' | null
  lineHeight?: number | null
}

/**
 * Per-site design tokens as a `<style>` body.
 *
 * Tailwind v4's `@theme inline` block in `globals.css` maps every utility token to a
 * raw variable (`--color-primary: var(--primary)`), so per-site theming is just
 * re-declaring those raw variables lower down the cascade. No per-tenant CSS build,
 * no rebuild when an editor saves.
 */

/**
 * `#rgb` or `#rrggbb`, and nothing else. These values are interpolated into a
 * `<style>` tag, so a stray `}` would let a site's editor rewrite the whole page's
 * CSS — an unvalidated value is dropped rather than emitted.
 */
export const isHexColor = (value: unknown): value is string =>
  typeof value === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{3}([0-9a-f]{3})?$/i.test(value)

/** The `--radius` scale `globals.css` derives `--radius-sm|md|lg|xl` from. */
const RADIUS = { lg: '1rem', md: '0.625rem', none: '0', sm: '0.25rem' } as const

/** The near-black and near-white the rest of the palette already uses. */
const INK = 'oklch(14.5% 0 0deg)'
const PAPER = 'oklch(98.5% 0 0deg)'

/**
 * Black or white text, whichever reads on `hex`. A brand colour picked for a logo is
 * often far too light for the white the default palette pairs with `--primary`, and
 * that lands as unreadable buttons on every page of the site.
 *
 * WCAG relative luminance, thresholded where its contrast against black and white
 * crosses over.
 */
const readableOn = (hex: string): string => {
  const full =
    hex.length === 4
      ? hex
          .slice(1)
          .split('')
          .map((c) => c + c)
          .join('')
      : hex.slice(1)

  const channel = (offset: number): number => {
    const srgb = parseInt(full.slice(offset, offset + 2), 16) / 255

    return srgb <= 0.03928 ? srgb / 12.92 : ((srgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
  }

  const luminance = 0.2126 * channel(0) + 0.7152 * channel(2) + 0.0722 * channel(4)

  return luminance > 0.179 ? INK : PAPER
}

/** A colour and the text that reads on it, or nothing if the value is not a hex. */
const pair = (name: string, value: unknown): string =>
  isHexColor(value) ? `--${name}:${value};--${name}-foreground:${readableOn(value)};` : ''

/** A colour on its own — for the two tokens that already name their own contrast. */
const decl = (name: string, value: unknown): string =>
  isHexColor(value) ? `--${name}:${value};` : ''

export const themeCss = (theme: null | Theme): string => {
  if (!theme) return ''

  const radius = RADIUS[theme.radius ?? 'md'] ?? RADIUS.md
  const leading =
    typeof theme.lineHeight === 'number' &&
    Number.isFinite(theme.lineHeight) &&
    theme.lineHeight >= 1.4 &&
    theme.lineHeight <= 2.4
      ? theme.lineHeight
      : 1.8

  const brand = `${pair('primary', theme.primary)}${pair('accent', theme.accent)}--radius:${radius};--line-height:${leading};`

  // ponytail: `--card`, `--muted` and `--border` keep the template's neutral ramp, so
  // a site on a dark background gets light cards. Derive the ramp from `background`
  // in oklch when a customer actually picks one.
  const paper = `${decl('background', theme.background)}${decl('foreground', theme.foreground)}`

  /**
   * `background` and `foreground` are the site's *light* palette, so they are scoped
   * away from dark mode — declared on `body` unconditionally they would override
   * `[data-theme='dark']` on `html` and a site with a white background would have no
   * dark theme at all. Brand colour and radius are direction- and mode-agnostic.
   */
  return `body{${brand}}${paper ? `html:not([data-theme='dark']) body{${paper}}` : ''}`
}
=== slug ===
/**
 * Payload's own `slugify` is `replace(/[^\w-]+/g, '')` — `\w` is ASCII, so every
 * Persian character is stripped and "درباره ما" becomes "-". On a Persian-first
 * platform that is not cosmetic: every page an editor creates would collide on the
 * same one-character slug.
 *
 * Persian slugs are fine in a URL — the browser percent-encodes them and shows the
 * readable form back to the user.
 */
export const slugify = (value?: string | null): string =>
  (value ?? '')
    .normalize('NFC')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    // Arabic yeh/kaf look identical to the Persian letters but are a different
    // codepoint; two keyboards would otherwise produce two different slugs.
    .replace(/[يى]/g, 'ی')
    .replace(/ك/g, 'ک')
    // Persian-Indic and Arabic-Indic digits → ASCII, so a slug can be typed.
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))
    // ZWNJ carries meaning inside a Persian word but cannot survive a URL.
    .replace(/[\s_‌]+/g, '-')
    // Any script's letters, digits and combining marks stay; punctuation goes.
    // `\p{M}` matters here: the hamza in "صفحهٔ" is a mark, not a letter.
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}-]+/gu, '')
    .replace(/-{2,}/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')

/** Shape `slugField({ slugify })` expects. */
export const slugifyField = ({ valueToSlugify }: { valueToSlugify?: unknown }): string =>
  slugify(typeof valueToSlugify === 'string' ? valueToSlugify : '')

/**
 * The reserved slug of every site's home page, in every locale. Looking this up is
 * what makes bare `/` and bare `/en` resolve without a `homePage` field on `sites`.
 */
export const HOME_SLUG = 'home'

/**
 * A page slug as a site-relative path. The home page is `/`, never `/home` — two
 * URLs for one page splits its cache entry and its search ranking.
 */
export const pagePath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
  !slug || slug === HOME_SLUG ? '/' : `/${slug}`

/**
 * The blog's two routes are Next segments under `[domain]`, not CMS pages, so they
 * exist whether an editor likes it or not — and a static segment outranks the
 * `[domain]/[[...path]]` catch-all. A page saved as `posts` would therefore be
 * unreachable with no error anywhere: the URL would render the blog.
 *
 * Reserving them is `src/hooks/reservedPageSlug.ts`, and these three constants are
 * the single source for both halves — the routes and the validation cannot drift.
 */
export const POSTS_SEGMENT = 'posts'
export const SEARCH_SEGMENT = 'search'
export const CHECKOUT_SEGMENT = 'checkout'
export const PRODUCTS_SEGMENT = 'products'

export const POSTS_BASE = `/${POSTS_SEGMENT}`
export const SEARCH_PATH = `/${SEARCH_SEGMENT}`
export const CHECKOUT_BASE = `/${CHECKOUT_SEGMENT}`
export const PRODUCTS_BASE = `/${PRODUCTS_SEGMENT}`

/**
 * Everything `[domain]/[[...path]]` intercepts before the CMS is asked for a page.
 * Derived from the segments above, so reserving a route cannot be forgotten when one
 * is added.
 */
export const RESERVED_PAGE_SLUGS = [
  POSTS_SEGMENT,
  SEARCH_SEGMENT,
  CHECKOUT_SEGMENT,
] as const

/** A post's site-relative path. No locale segment here — `localeHref` adds that. */
export const postPath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
  slug ? `${POSTS_BASE}/${slug}` : POSTS_BASE

/** A product's site-relative path. No locale segment here — `localeHref` adds that. */
export const productPath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
  slug ? `${PRODUCTS_BASE}/${slug}` : PRODUCTS_BASE
