/**
 * The only place dates and numbers are formatted.
 *
 * Persian pages get Shamsi (Jalali) dates and Persian-Indic digits; every other
 * locale gets its own calendar and digits from the same call site. Nothing else
 * may call `Intl` directly, use `toLocaleDateString()`, or interpolate a raw
 * `Date` — see CLAUDE.md.
 */

import type { CurrencyCode } from './money'

import { currencies, minorToMajor } from './money'

// Payload locale codes are short forms; Intl wants a BCP 47 tag.
const intlLocale = (locale: string) => (locale === 'fa' ? 'fa-IR' : locale)

// ponytail: one platform timezone, so a UTC timestamp near midnight doesn't
// render as the previous day. Becomes a `timezone` field on `sites` if we ever
// host a customer outside Iran.
const PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Tehran'

// Cache Intl formatters to avoid the high overhead of instantiating them on every function call.
const dateTimeFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>()
const numberFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>()


export const formatDate = (
  date: Date | string | number | null | undefined,
  locale: string,
  options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'long' },
): string => {
  if (date === null || date === undefined || date === '') return ''

  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options)}`
  let formatter = dateTimeFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale(locale), {
      // 'persian' *is* the Jalali calendar — Intl ships it, so no date library.
      calendar: locale === 'fa' ? 'persian' : undefined,
      timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE,
      ...options,
    })
    dateTimeFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }

  return formatter.format(new Date(date))
}

export const formatNumber = (
  value: number,
  locale: string,
  options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
): string => {
  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options || {})}`
  let formatter = numberFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(intlLocale(locale), options)
    numberFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }
  return formatter.format(value)
}

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 *
 * Re-exported from `src/lib/digits.ts` so money parsing can share the mapping without
 * importing this module; the rule that every rendered number goes through here stands.
 */
export { toLocaleDigits } from './digits'

/**
 * A price, in the site's currency, in the active locale's digits.
 *
 * `minor` is the stored integer — see `src/lib/money.ts` for why prices are minor
 * units of the *site's* currency and not of the product. The unit word is appended
 * from the currency registry, because a bare number on an Iranian storefront is
 * ambiguous by a factor of ten.
 *
 * Renders `۱٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان` on `fa` and `1,200,000 Toman` on `en` for the same
 * stored value.
 */
export const formatPrice = (
  minor: null | number | undefined,
  code: CurrencyCode,
  locale: string,
  options: { hideUnit?: boolean } = {},
): string => {
  if (typeof minor !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(minor)) return ''

  const currency = currencies[code]
  const amount = formatNumber(minorToMajor(minor, code), locale, {
    maximumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
    minimumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
  })

  if (options.hideUnit) return amount

  const unit = currency.unit[locale as 'en' | 'fa'] ?? currency.unit.en

  return `${amount} ${unit}`
}

 * Block library metadata for the headless runtime.
 *
 * This is the runtime's view of `src/blocks/index.ts` — the slugs and the
 * per-site-type allowlist, without the Payload `Block` objects or `filterOptions`
 * (those require the database). A builder that imports this can decide whether
 * `productGrid` is allowed on a `business` site, or whether a saved page's layout
 * contains a block it does not know how to render, using the same table the

const ALL: SiteType[] = ['business', 'portfolio', 'store']

  { slug: 'team', siteTypes: ['business', 'portfolio'] },
  { slug: 'pricing', siteTypes: ['business', 'store'] },
  { slug: 'logos', siteTypes: ['business', 'store'] },
  { slug: 'archive', siteTypes: ['business', 'portfolio'] },
]

export const siteBlocks: string[] = library.map(({ slug }) => slug)

export const blockSlugsForSiteType = (type: null | string | undefined): string[] =>

/**
 * Digit mapping between scripts — the primitive under `formatNumber` (render) and
 * `parsePrice` (input).

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 */
export const toLocaleDigits = (value: string, locale: string): string =>
  locale === 'fa' ? toAsciiDigits(value).replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => PERSIAN_DIGITS[Number(d)]!) : value

/**
 * Persian-Indic and Arabic-Indic digits → ASCII, for anything typed *into* the

export const toAsciiDigits = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

import { isCmsConfigured, readCmsEnv } from '@/lib/cms/env'
import { CONTRACT_VERSION } from '@/lib/cms/types'
import { themeIdentity } from '@/lib/theme/identity'

/**
 * Deployment health check (`build.healthCheckPath` in the manifest).
 *
 * It reports the process, not the CMS: a healthy container answers even while the CMS is
 * unreachable, so the platform does not roll back a deployment because of a transient CMS
 * outage. It exposes no secrets — only whether server-side CMS credentials are configured.
 */
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export function GET(): Response {
  const env = readCmsEnv()
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      ok: true,
      theme: themeIdentity.key,
      contractVersion: CONTRACT_VERSION,
      cms: isCmsConfigured(env) ? 'configured' : 'host-scoped',
      uptime: Math.round(process.uptime()),
    },
    { headers: { 'cache-control': 'no-store' } },
  )
}
=== revalidate ===
import { revalidatePath, revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

import { readCmsEnv } from '@/lib/cms/env'
import { mapRevalidationPath, readRevalidateNotice, revalidationTags, verifyRawBodySignature } from '@/lib/cms/verify'

/**
 * `POST /api/revalidate` — CMS cache invalidation.
 *
 * Contract (v1): the CMS signs the **exact raw body bytes** with `ESHOBE_REVALIDATE_SECRET` and
 * sends `x-eshobe-signature: sha256=<hex>`. The `x-eshobe-timestamp` header is sent but *not*
 * signed; signing `<timestamp>.<body>` would be a v2 contract and is deliberately not accepted
 * here. Nothing is purged before the signature verifies.
 *
 * Purging only ever touches this deployment's own tenant tags plus the coarse `cms:all` tag;
 * CMS-supplied tag strings are never used directly as cache tags. TTLs (30–60s on content
 * reads) remain the fallback if a notice is ever missed, and multiple replicas each verify and
 * purge independently.
 */
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const runtime = 'nodejs'

const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 64 * 1024

export async function POST(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
  const env = readCmsEnv()
  if (!env.revalidateSecret) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'not-configured' }, { status: 503 })
  }

  const declaredLength = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') ?? '0')
  if (Number.isFinite(declaredLength) && declaredLength > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'body-too-large' }, { status: 413 })
  }

  const rawBody = await request.text()
  if (rawBody.length > MAX_BODY_BYTES) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'body-too-large' }, { status: 413 })
  }
  if (!verifyRawBodySignature(rawBody, request.headers.get('x-eshobe-signature'), env.revalidateSecret)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'invalid-signature' }, { status: 401 })
  }

  let payload: unknown
  try {
    payload = JSON.parse(rawBody)
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'invalid-json' }, { status: 400 })
  }

  const notice = readRevalidateNotice(payload)
  const tags = revalidationTags(notice.resources, env.siteId)

  // Next 16 requires the two-argument form; `{ expire: 0 }` is the documented profile for
  // webhook/route-handler invalidation where `updateTag` (Server Actions only) is unavailable.
  for (const tag of tags) revalidateTag(tag, { expire: 0 })

  const paths = notice.paths
    .map((path) => mapRevalidationPath(path, env.siteDomain))
    .filter((path): path is string => path !== null)
    .slice(0, 50)
  for (const path of paths) revalidatePath(path)

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, tags, paths }, { headers: { 'cache-control': 'no-store' } })
}
=== proxy route ===
import { request as httpRequest } from 'node:http'
import { request as httpsRequest } from 'node:https'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

import { readCmsEnv } from '@/lib/cms/env'

/**
 * CMS-owned `/api/*` proxy (declared as `proxiesApi: true` in the manifest).
 *
 * In direct production mode the customer's DNS points at this container, so browser requests for
 * `/api/media/file/*`, `/api/form-submissions`, etc. arrive here and must be forwarded to
 * `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` with the tenant preserved. Two rules matter:
 *
 *   1. **Host is preserved by hand.** Node's `fetch` silently drops an explicit `Host` header
 *      (verified on Node 24), so the request is issued through `node:http`/`node:https` with the
 *      incoming Host set explicitly. When a site credential exists the tenant instead travels as
 *      `Authorization: Bearer`, and the CMS host is left untouched.
 *   2. **Visitor credentials are dropped.** `cookie`/`authorization` from the browser are never
 *      forwarded, so a privileged CMS session cookie cannot be replayed through the proxy; only
 *      the platform-injected site key is attached, and only to allowlisted CMS-owned paths.
 *
 * Theme-owned routes (`/api/health`, `/api/revalidate`) are answered locally, never proxied.
 */
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const runtime = 'nodejs'

const ALLOWED_HEADS = new Set([
  'site',
  'pages',
  'posts',
  'products',
  'categories',
  'header',
  'footer',
  'forms',
  'form-submissions',
  'search',
  'media',
  'theme',
  'store',
  'checkout',
  'payments',
  'redirects',
  'globals',
])

const THEME_OWNED_HEADS = new Set(['health', 'revalidate'])
const ALLOWED_METHODS = new Set(['GET', 'HEAD', 'POST'])
const RESPONSE_HEADERS = [
  'content-type',
  'content-length',
  'cache-control',
  'etag',
  'last-modified',
  'expires',
  'vary',
  'content-disposition',
  'accept-ranges',
  'content-range',
]

function filterResponseHeaders(headers: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>): Record<string, string> {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const name of RESPONSE_HEADERS) {
    const value = headers[name]
    if (typeof value === 'string') out[name] = value
    else if (Array.isArray(value) && value.length > 0 && typeof value[0] === 'string') out[name] = value[0]
  }
  return out
}

type ProxyResult = { status: number; headers: Record<string, string>; body: Buffer }

function forward(options: {
  target: URL
  method: string
  search: string
  headers: Record<string, string>
  body: Buffer | null
}): Promise<ProxyResult> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const secure = options.target.protocol === 'https:'
    const issue = secure ? httpsRequest : httpRequest
    const headers: Record<string, string | number> = { ...options.headers }
    if (options.body && options.body.length > 0) headers['content-length'] = options.body.length

    const request = issue(
      {
        protocol: options.target.protocol,
        hostname: options.target.hostname,
        port: options.target.port !== '' ? options.target.port : secure ? 443 : 80,
        method: options.method,
        path: `${options.target.pathname}${options.search}`,
        headers,
      },
      (response) => {
        const chunks: Buffer[] = []
        response.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => chunks.push(chunk))
        response.on('end', () =>
          resolve({
            status: response.statusCode ?? 502,
            headers: filterResponseHeaders(response.headers),
            body: Buffer.concat(chunks),
          }),
        )
      },
    )

    request.setTimeout(10_000, () => request.destroy(new Error('proxy timeout')))
    request.on('error', reject)
    if (options.body && options.body.length > 0) request.write(options.body)
    request.end()
  })
}

async function handle(request: Request, segments: string[]): Promise<Response> {
  const head = segments[0] ?? ''
  if (head === '' || THEME_OWNED_HEADS.has(head) || !ALLOWED_HEADS.has(head)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: 'not-found' }, { status: 404 })
  }

28	  | { kind: 'page'; slug: string }

45	  }
46	
47	  if (first === SEARCH_SEGMENT && segments.length === 1) return { kind: 'search' }
48	
49	  if (first === PRODUCTS_SEGMENT) {
50	    return second ? { kind: 'product', slug: second } : { kind: 'page', slug: 'products' }
51	  }
52	
53	  if (first === CHECKOUT_SEGMENT && segments.length <= 2) {
54	    return { kind: 'checkout', order: second ?? null }
55	  }

Root layout reads `headers().get('host')` → site → `getSiteContext().locale/dir/site/serving`.

### Locale Prefix
- Site's `defaultLocale` has **no prefix**: `https://acme.ir/` not `/fa/`
- Other locales do: `https://acme.ir/en/about`
- Unknown/ unserved locale → `404` (don't fall back to default silently — that duplicates home page under `/de`).

### `resolveSiteRoute(path[])` — pure, testable
```ts
import { resolveSiteRoute } from '@eshobe/site-runtime/slug'
resolveSiteRoute([])                    // {kind:"page", slug:"home"}
resolveSiteRoute(["درباره-ما"])         // {kind:"page", slug:"درباره-ما"}
resolveSiteRoute(["en","about"])        // {kind:"page", slug:"about"} (locale stripped)
resolveSiteRoute(["posts"])             // {kind:"posts"}
resolveSiteRoute(["en","posts"])        // {kind:"posts"}
resolveSiteRoute(["posts","first"])     // {kind:"post", slug:"first"}
resolveSiteRoute(["products","chair"])  // {kind:"product", slug:"chair"}
resolveSiteRoute(["search"])            // {kind:"search"}
resolveSiteRoute(["checkout","<uuid>"]) // {kind:"checkout", order:"<uuid>"|null}
```

Site's `generateMetadata` and body both call this — keep them in sync.

1	# Eshobe Corporation Theme — Design Specification
2	
3	- **Date**: 2026-10-24
4	- **Status**: Approved for planning
5	- **Issue**: [hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme#1](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme/issues/1)
6	- **Theme key / name**: `eshobe-corporation` / "Eshobe Corporation" / «پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه»
7	- **References**: [Eshobe Theme API](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/THEME_API.md), [theme deployments](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/theme-deployments.md), [DesignMD Vercel reference](https://www.designmd.co/d/vercel)
8	
9	## 1. Purpose and scope
10	
11	Build a production-grade, reusable, Eshobe-native corporate/SaaS theme with a Vercel-inspired visual language, demonstrated first with Biza Miz restaurant/café marketing content.
12	
13	**In scope (this pass): Stage 1 + Stage 2 of the issue**
14	
15	- Committed `DESIGN.md` translated from the DesignMD reference, plus `AGENTS.md` that mandates reading it and the Theme API before UI edits.
16	- Eshobe theme manifest, design tokens, typography, layout shell, theme switch, responsive RTL navigation.
17	- CMS-driven page system: homepage, restaurant/café landing, pricing explainer, features page, demo/contact form, light/dark, fa/en.
18	- Fixture-backed local development, content pack for Biza Miz, test and verification harness.
19	
20	**Out of scope (Stages 3–4)**: live lead handoff/CRM and attribution, funnel analytics, live Biza Miz price sourcing, wallet/signup destinations, sitemap/robots, production preview→health→release→rollback, GHCR artifact workflow, full visual-regression baselines.
21	
22	Nothing in this pass may claim a deployed integration or fabricate testimonials, metrics, prices, or product capabilities.
23	
24	## 2. Decisions
25	
26	| # | Decision | Rationale |
27	|---|---|---|
28	| D1 | Composition model B: contract block vocabulary with theme-owned designed variants | Keeps CMS authoring authority while reaching reference-level art direction; no invented block types |
29	| D2 | Theme key `eshobe-corporation` | Owner decision; matches repo identity in the CMS picker |
30	| D3 | Product showcase imagery is AI-generated, stored under `public/demo/`, fixture-only, labelled illustrative | Owner decision; contained so no fabricated imagery reaches production theme code |
31	| D4 | Stack mirrors `cms-arch2-theme`: Next 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, standalone Docker | Contract-proven sibling implementation |
32	| D5 | Vendor `@eshobe/site-runtime` as a workspace package instead of an ad-hoc alias shim | npm package is unpublished and missing documented exports (`resolveSiteRoute`, `siteOrigin`, `localeCodes`) |
33	| D6 | Announcement banner deferred | No localized announcement field exists in `header`, page blocks, or manifest settings; shipping a Persian-only banner would break fa/en parity |
34	| D7 | Blog/archive deferred | Issue schedules learning/blog for a later phase; `archive` block warns and renders nothing |
35	
36	## 3. Design system
37	
38	`DESIGN.md` is a first-class deliverable with machine-readable frontmatter (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and human sections (overview, layout, elevation, do/don't, Persian adaptations, accessibility, motion). It records attribution to the DesignMD reference and every deliberate deviation.
39	
40	### 3.1 Reference translation
41	
42	| Reference trait | Adaptation |
43	|---|---|
44	| Ink `#171717` primary CTA, near-white canvas, 1px hairlines | Kept as neutral core, tokenised |
45	| Four-step surface ladder (white / 98% / 95% / polarity-flipped ink) | Kept; inverted pair is semantic and self-flips in dark mode |
46	| Multi-stop mesh gradient, hero scale only | Original CSS multi-radial composition with our stops and geometry; never a copy of Vercel's SVG |
47	| Geist / Geist Mono | Vazirmatn (Persian, Eshobe standard) + Inter Variable (Latin) + JetBrains Mono (technical labels), all openly licensed, self-hosted. No Vercel font binaries, marks, copy, or screenshots |
48	| Aggressive negative display tracking | Latin only; Persian exempt (no negative tracking on connected script), 1.8 body leading, ~1.25 display leading |
49	| 4px spacing, 1400px container, 600/960/1200/1400 breakpoints | Kept; section rhythm 96–128px desktop, 56–64px mobile |
50	| Stacked shadows L1–L5 + inset hairline | Kept; dark mode ring becomes `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |
51	| Radius 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100 pills | Theme owns scale; CMS `radius` maps to control/card radius only. Marketing CTAs stay pill; nav CTAs 6px |
52	
53	### 3.2 Tokens
54	
55	- **Colors (light)**: `ink #171717`, `body #4d4d4d`, `mute #888888`, `hairline #ebebeb`, `hairline-strong #a1a1a1`, `canvas #ffffff`, `canvas-soft #fafafa`, `canvas-soft-2 #f5f5f5`, `link #0070f3`, semantic success/warning/error with soft/deep variants.
56	- **Colors (dark)**: `canvas #0a0a0a`, `canvas-soft #111111`, `canvas-soft-2 #171717`, `ink #ededed`, `body #a1a1a1`, `mute #737373`, `hairline #262626`, `hairline-strong #525252`.
57	- **CMS-editable only**: `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground`, `radius (none|sm|md|lg)`, `lineHeight (1.4–2.4)`, emitted on `body` scope via `themeCss(site.theme)` in a `#site-theme` style element. Every other token lives in theme CSS. The platform maps radius to `0 / 4 / 10 / 16px`; the default `md` is the nearest step to the reference's 8px card radius and is recorded as a deliberate deviation. When a tenant overrides it, cards and controls follow the tenant value; pill CTAs keep their brand shape.
58	- **Type scale**: display-xl 48/48/−2.4, display-lg 32/40/−1.28, display-md 24/32/−0.96, display-sm 20/28/−0.6, body-lg 18/28, body-md 16/24, body-sm 14/20/−0.28, caption 12/16, mono 12–13. Persian overrides tracking to 0 and leading to 1.8 body / ~1.25 display.
59	- **Radii**: 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100/full. **Spacing**: 4px base; 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192.
60	- **Elevation**: L1 inset hairline; L2 soft drop; L3 soft stack; L4 float stack; L5 modal. Stacked offsets only, always with inset ring.
61	- **Token parity**: CSS variables and a TS mirror are asserted by a unit test.
62	
63	### 3.3 Components
64	
65	Nav (sticky 64px, mobile overlay, locale/theme switches), buttons (primary pill, secondary, ghost; sm/md/lg; full state matrix), badge + mono eyebrow, marketing/soft cards, product mockup chrome, section header, feature grid, sticky-stack band, pricing card + featured, testimonial card, FAQ accordion, logo strip, announcement primitive (deferred in pages), inputs/select/textarea with helper and error text, submit states (idle/pending/sent/error), contact card, CTA band, footer.
66	
67	### 3.4 Motion, accessibility, performance
68	
69	- Motion: 150–250ms state transitions; scroll reveals ≤80ms stagger; transform/opacity only; no parallax, infinite loops, or layout-shift animation. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it.
70	- Accessibility: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible focus ring, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls`, labelled fields with `aria-describedby`, `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).
71	- Performance: server components by default; client islands limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, accordion, form, reveal observer; no animation library; self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload; `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; CSS hero mesh. Budgets: CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms; sections usable without JS except the islands.
72	
73	## 4. Architecture
74	
75	### 4.1 Repository layout
76	
77	```text
78	eshobe-corporation-theme/
79	├── eshobe.theme.json
80	├── DESIGN.md
81	├── AGENTS.md
82	├── README.md
83	├── Dockerfile
84	├── package.json / pnpm-workspace.yaml
85	├── demo-packs/biza-miz/           # page JSON, form schema, nav links, import script
86	├── packages/site-runtime/         # vendored @eshobe/site-runtime workspace package
87	├── public/
88	│   ├── demo/                      # fixture-only generated mockups, labelled illustrative
89	│   └── fonts/                     # Vazirmatn, Inter, JetBrains Mono + licenses
90	├── src/
91	│   ├── app/[[...path]]/           # resolve → dispatch → RouteShell
92	│   ├── app/api/health/
93	│   ├── app/api/revalidate/
94	│   ├── app/api/[...segments]/     # allowlisted CMS proxy
95	│   ├── app/api/exit-preview/
96	│   ├── cms/                       # client, site descriptor, typed queries, draft policy, cache tags
97	│   ├── sections/                  # hero, showcase, feature-grid, sticky-stack, pricing, logos, testimonial, faq, cta, form, media, editorial, gallery, team, contact
98	│   ├── blocks/                    # blockType → section + variant resolver
99	│   ├── components/                # ui primitives, nav, footer, mockup chrome
100	│   ├── lib/{i18n,routing,theme,seo,media}
101	│   └── styles/                    # globals.css @theme tokens, fonts.css
102	└── tests/{unit,browser,fixtures}
103	```
104	
105	### 4.2 Routes and bindings
106	
107	- `fa` is unprefixed; `en` is prefixed (`/en/...`). A locale absent from `availableLocales` is a 404. `dir` derives per request.
108	- Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`.
109	- Each route resolves `themeRuntime.bindings[slot]` by page ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`). A missing binding is a 404; no bundled fallback copy.
110	- Page content is fetched by ID/slug with `depth=2` (single doc), media resolved via `site.media.origin`, and header/footer globals fetched in parallel.
111	- Nav comes from the `header` global. Footer columns use `footer.navItems`, followed by brand and legal line; no contact or social fields are invented, and no CMS fields beyond `navItems` are assumed.
112	
113	### 4.3 Block → section resolution
114	
115	| Contract block | Section | Variant rule |
116	|---|---|---|
117	| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | First `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop unless `heroTreatment=plain`; link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary). Last → inverted CTA band. Else inline |
118	| `mediaBlock` | showcase / editorial figure | Immediately after hero → 16:10 mockup chrome unless `showcaseTreatment=editorial`; else framed by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with viewport cap |
119	| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky`, disabled under reduced motion |
120	| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan polarity-flipped in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit` |
121	| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted |
122	| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |
123	| `logos` | logo strip | Monochrome via `logosMonochrome`, colour on hover |
124	| `content` | editorial columns | Lexical `direction` per field, `unicode-bidi: plaintext` |
125	| `gallery` | image grid | Columns from block |
126	| `team` | team grid | CMS members only |
127	| `contact` | contact card | Phones via `toLocaleDigits` |
128	| `formBlock` | CMS form | Renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim plus hidden honeypot |
129	| `archive` | deferred | Dev warning, null in production |
130	
131	- Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically; inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA.
132	- Unknown `blockType`: log and render nothing. Never invent a block type.
133	
134	### 4.4 Manifest
135	
136	- `contractVersion: 1`, `key: "eshobe-corporation"`, `name: "Eshobe Corporation"`, `nameFa: "پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه"`, `siteTypes: ["business"]`, `locales: ["fa","en"]`.
137	- `capabilities`: `rtlFirst`, `multiLocale`, `pageBuilderBlocks`, `forms`.
138	- `design` defaults: `primary "#171717"`, `accent "#0070f3"`, `background "#fafafa"`, `foreground "#171717"`, `radius "md"`, `lineHeight 1.8`.
139	- `build`: `dockerfile`, port 3000, `healthCheckPath: "/api/health"`, `isStatic: false`; no `deployment` block (Coolify build strategy).
140	- `env: []` (all `ESHOBE_*` variables are platform-injected).
141	- `settings`: `heroTreatment` (select mesh|plain, default mesh), `featureTreatment` (select cards|sticky, default cards), `showcaseTreatment` (select mockup|editorial, default mockup), `logosMonochrome` (boolean, default true), `restaurantsSlug` (text, default "restaurants"), `pricingSlug` (text, default "pricing"), `featuresSlug` (text, default "features"), `demoSlug` (text, default "demo").
142	- `contentSlots`: `home` (type `page`, required), `restaurants` (type `page`), `pricing` (type `page`), `features` (type `page`), `demo` (type `page`).
143	
144	## 5. Data flow, caching, preview, security
145	
146	- **Bootstrap**: one cached `GET /api/site` per request (key-authenticated) validates `contractVersion`, media origin, locales, settings, bindings.
147	- **Tenancy**: every CMS call uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`; never a rewritten `Host` (loops back into the theme container). No `?site=` anywhere. The key never reaches the browser.
148	- **Draft policy**: centralized. A site key can read drafts, so public rendering always sends `draft=false` and `where[_status][equals]=published` for pages, posts, products and form submissions. Globals (`header`, `footer`, theme, store), `categories` and `search` do not carry a publish status, so they are read with the publish filter disabled but still tenant-scoped. Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then uses `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.
149	- **Cache**: `force-cache`, site 30s / content 60s, tags `cms:all` and `tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`.
150	- **Revalidation**: `POST /api/revalidate` verifies raw-body HMAC-SHA256 (`x-eshobe-signature`), a timestamp tolerance of ±5 minutes, a 64KB cap, purges payload tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s.
151	- **Proxy**: `/api/[...segments]` allowlists CMS heads (`site, pages, posts, products, categories, header, footer, forms, form-submissions, search, media, theme, store, checkout, payments, redirects, globals`), drops visitor cookies/auth, refuses recursion, and forwards to the CMS with its own host.
152	- **Media**: URLs resolved against `site.media.origin`; SVGs via `<img>`, never inline; remote patterns restricted to the CMS origin.
153	
154	## 6. Forms
155	
156	The demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions`:
157	
158	```json
159	{ "form": "<formId>", "submissionData": [{ "field": "name", "value": "…" }] }
160	```
161	
162	- Tenant is derived server-side from the form document; the client cannot choose it.
163	- Required consent is a **checkbox field in the CMS form schema** shipped with the content pack; the renderer never injects fields beyond the hidden honeypot.
164	- Inline validation with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; Persian-digit normalisation via `toAsciiDigits`; values preserved on failure; disabled submit while pending; success/error announced via `aria-live`; retry control.
165	- Hidden honeypot; spam rate-limiting is deferred to Stage 3.
166	- CRM handoff, attribution and analytics are **not** implemented in this pass.
167	
168	## 7. Failure states
169	
170	| Condition | Behaviour |
171	|---|---|
172	| Unknown route | Themed 404, `noindex` |
173	| Missing binding | 404, no bundled copy |
174	| CMS unreachable | Cached content when available; else themed 503 with retry; health endpoint stays local |
175	| Site suspended/archived | Contract holding page, HTTP 200, `noindex` |
176	| Contract version mismatch | Loud developer-facing error page; no silent render |
177	| Empty collection block | Section omitted |
178	| Premium/featured content | No placeholder testimonials, logos, metrics, or prices |
179	
180	## 8. Biza Miz content
181	
182	- Theme code stays tenant-neutral; Biza Miz copy, page structures, nav links and form schema ship in `demo-packs/biza-miz/`.
183	- The content pack mirrors the issue's homepage rhythm: hero → dashboard showcase → benefits → feature/industry grid → pricing explanation → proof/FAQ → final CTA. Priority pages: restaurants/cafés, demo request, pricing, features.
184	- Product messaging follows the proven POS workflow **menu → table/order → payment/receipt → shift/sales report**; Accounting, CRM, Growth and Website capabilities are only described at their actual release readiness.
185	- The pack carries **no invented prices**. Pricing renders CMS `pricing` plans; when a plan is not sourced from the Biza Miz catalogue it must be marked illustrative in the content, never presented as a live licence fee.
186	- Account signup, activation, wallet and payment stay Biza Miz's; the theme links out to tenant-supplied destinations and implements no checkout, wallet or identity.
187	- An idempotent import script uses only capabilities a site key has (pages, posts, forms, header/footer). Media must be uploaded by an editor because a site key cannot create media.
188	- The fixture provider mirrors the content pack and serves generated mockups from `public/demo/`, visibly labelled illustrative. Production renders CMS media only.
189	- Demo form is the only lead path in this pass; Stage 3 owns the sales-process handoff.
190	
191	## 9. Verification
192	
193	- `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build.
194	- Unit (vitest): route/locale resolution, binding resolution, variant resolver, band rhythm, draft policy, cache tags, HMAC revalidation, form validation, token parity, manifest validation mirroring the CMS parser.
195	- Browser (Playwright, fixture CMS): five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark; keyboard navigation; mobile menu; theme persistence; locale switch; form success/failure; reduced motion; axe; RTL overflow (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`); visual snapshots.
196	- Manual/recorded: retry of the DesignMD live reference and a written deviation list in `DESIGN.md`.
197	- No claim of deployment, live CMS integration, or production performance until those are actually run.
198	
199	## 10. Risks and open items
200	
201	1. **Live DesignMD reference** returned HTTP 429 during design. Reconciliation is deferred to implementation; every deviation must be recorded, not assumed.
202	2. **AI-generated showcase imagery** conflicts with the issue's "authentic product demonstration visuals" and "no fabricated claims". Mitigation: fixture-only, labelled, no invented metrics; real screenshots can replace them via CMS media at any time.
203	3. **Unpublished runtime package**: vendored workspace package; parity tested against the CMS source.
204	4. **No live tenant in this pass**: content pack + fixtures replace a claimed deployment.
205	5. **Spam protection** is honeypot-only until Stage 3.
206	6. **Font licensing**: only OFL-licensed families; licenses committed with the binaries.
207	
208	## 11. Acceptance mapping (Stage 1 + 2)
209	
210	| Issue criterion | Covered by |
211	|---|---|
212	| `DESIGN.md` committed, attributed, original, agent guidance refers to it | DESIGN.md + AGENTS.md deliverables |
213	| Reusable components, responsive homepage, visual review at 3 widths | Component set, Playwright snapshots |
214	| RTL Persian first-class; English LTR; dark/light; reduced motion; keyboard | i18n/RTL + a11y sections and tests |
215	| CMS edits publish without theme changes; no cross-tenant exposure | Block/variant architecture, key-only server access, cache/tag tests |
216	| Demo CTA and form work end-to-end | CMS form + submission route, verified against fixtures and a tenant where credentials exist |
217	| Preview/health/release/rollback tested through Eshobe | `/api/health` implemented; preview→release→rollback **deferred to Stage 4** |
218	| No fabricated testimonials, metrics, prices, claims | Omit-empty policy, fixture labelling, no hardcoded content |
219	
220	## 12. Implementation outline
221	
222	1. **Foundation**: scaffold, manifest, vendored runtime, tokens, fonts, layout shell, nav/footer, theme switch, health/proxy/revalidate routes, fixtures, unit harness.
223	2. **Design contract**: write `DESIGN.md` + `AGENTS.md`; retry the live reference; record deviations.
224	3. **Sections**: primitives and all business-block sections with variant resolution.
225	4. **Routes**: home, restaurants, pricing, features, demo, generic CMS pages; metadata and locale switching.
226	5. **Forms and states**: CMS form island, error/empty/holding pages.
227	6. **Content pack**: Biza Miz page JSON, form schema, import script, generated mockups.
228	7. **Verification**: Playwright suite, axe, RTL overflow, snapshots; run `pnpm verify`.

3	 * Persian character is stripped and "درباره ما" becomes "-". On a Persian-first
4	 * platform that is not cosmetic: every page an editor creates would collide on the
5	 * same one-character slug.
6	 *
7	 * Persian slugs are fine in a URL — the browser percent-encodes them and shows the
8	 * readable form back to the user.
9	 */
10	export const slugify = (value?: string | null): string =>
11	  (value ?? '')
12	    .normalize('NFC')
13	    .trim()
14	    .toLowerCase()
15	    // Arabic yeh/kaf look identical to the Persian letters but are a different
16	    // codepoint; two keyboards would otherwise produce two different slugs.
17	    .replace(/[يى]/g, 'ی')
18	    .replace(/ك/g, 'ک')
19	    // Persian-Indic and Arabic-Indic digits → ASCII, so a slug can be typed.
20	    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
21	    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))
22	    // ZWNJ carries meaning inside a Persian word but cannot survive a URL.
23	    .replace(/[\s_‌]+/g, '-')
24	    // Any script's letters, digits and combining marks stay; punctuation goes.
25	    // `\p{M}` matters here: the hamza in "صفحهٔ" is a mark, not a letter.
26	    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}-]+/gu, '')
27	    .replace(/-{2,}/g, '-')
28	    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
29	
30	/** Shape `slugField({ slugify })` expects. */
31	export const slugifyField = ({ valueToSlugify }: { valueToSlugify?: unknown }): string =>
32	  slugify(typeof valueToSlugify === 'string' ? valueToSlugify : '')
33	
34	/**
35	 * The reserved slug of every site's home page, in every locale. Looking this up is
36	 * what makes bare `/` and bare `/en` resolve without a `homePage` field on `sites`.
37	 */
38	export const HOME_SLUG = 'home'
39	
40	/**
41	 * A page slug as a site-relative path. The home page is `/`, never `/home` — two
42	 * URLs for one page splits its cache entry and its search ranking.
43	 */
44	export const pagePath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
45	  !slug || slug === HOME_SLUG ? '/' : `/${slug}`
46	
47	/**
48	 * The blog's two routes are Next segments under `[domain]`, not CMS pages, so they
49	 * exist whether an editor likes it or not — and a static segment outranks the
50	 * `[domain]/[[...path]]` catch-all. A page saved as `posts` would therefore be
51	 * unreachable with no error anywhere: the URL would render the blog.
52	 *
53	 * Reserving them is `src/hooks/reservedPageSlug.ts`, and these three constants are
54	 * the single source for both halves — the routes and the validation cannot drift.
55	 */
56	export const POSTS_SEGMENT = 'posts'
57	export const SEARCH_SEGMENT = 'search'
58	export const CHECKOUT_SEGMENT = 'checkout'
59	export const PRODUCTS_SEGMENT = 'products'
60	
61	export const POSTS_BASE = `/${POSTS_SEGMENT}`
62	export const SEARCH_PATH = `/${SEARCH_SEGMENT}`
63	export const CHECKOUT_BASE = `/${CHECKOUT_SEGMENT}`
64	export const PRODUCTS_BASE = `/${PRODUCTS_SEGMENT}`
65	
66	/**
67	 * Everything `[domain]/[[...path]]` intercepts before the CMS is asked for a page.
68	 * Derived from the segments above, so reserving a route cannot be forgotten when one
69	 * is added.
70	 */
71	export const RESERVED_PAGE_SLUGS = [
72	  POSTS_SEGMENT,
73	  SEARCH_SEGMENT,
74	  CHECKOUT_SEGMENT,
75	] as const
76	
77	/** A post's site-relative path. No locale segment here — `localeHref` adds that. */
78	export const postPath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
79	  slug ? `${POSTS_BASE}/${slug}` : POSTS_BASE
80	
81	/** A product's site-relative path. No locale segment here — `localeHref` adds that. */
82	export const productPath = (slug?: string | null): string =>
83	  slug ? `${PRODUCTS_BASE}/${slug}` : PRODUCTS_BASE

25	  typeof value === 'string' && /^#[0-9a-f]{3}([0-9a-f]{3})?$/i.test(value)
26	
27	/** The `--radius` scale `globals.css` derives `--radius-sm|md|lg|xl` from. */
28	const RADIUS = { lg: '1rem', md: '0.625rem', none: '0', sm: '0.25rem' } as const

32	const PAPER = 'oklch(98.5% 0 0deg)'
33	
34	/**

36	 * often far too light for the white the default palette pairs with `--primary`, and
37	 * that lands as unreadable buttons on every page of the site.
38	 *
39	 * WCAG relative luminance, thresholded where its contrast against black and white
40	 * crosses over.
41	 */
42	const readableOn = (hex: string): string => {
43	  const full =
44	    hex.length === 4
45	      ? hex
46	          .slice(1)
47	          .split('')
48	          .map((c) => c + c)
49	          .join('')
50	      : hex.slice(1)
51	
52	  const channel = (offset: number): number => {
53	    const srgb = parseInt(full.slice(offset, offset + 2), 16) / 255
54	
55	    return srgb <= 0.03928 ? srgb / 12.92 : ((srgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
56	  }
57	
58	  const luminance = 0.2126 * channel(0) + 0.7152 * channel(2) + 0.0722 * channel(4)
59	
60	  return luminance > 0.179 ? INK : PAPER

64	const pair = (name: string, value: unknown): string =>
65	  isHexColor(value) ? `--${name}:${value};--${name}-foreground:${readableOn(value)};` : ''

72	  if (!theme) return ''

75	  const leading =

77	    Number.isFinite(theme.lineHeight) &&
78	    theme.lineHeight >= 1.4 &&
79	    theme.lineHeight <= 2.4
80	      ? theme.lineHeight
81	      : 1.8
82	
83	  const brand = `${pair('primary', theme.primary)}${pair('accent', theme.accent)}--radius:${radius};--line-height:${leading};`

85	  // ponytail: `--card`, `--muted` and `--border` keep the template's neutral ramp, so
86	  // a site on a dark background gets light cards. Derive the ramp from `background`
87	  // in oklch when a customer actually picks one.
88	  const paper = `${decl('background', theme.background)}${decl('foreground', theme.foreground)}`

92	   * away from dark mode — declared on `body` unconditionally they would override
93	   * `[data-theme='dark']` on `html` and a site with a white background would have no
94	   * dark theme at all. Brand colour and radius are direction- and mode-agnostic.
95	   */
96	  return `body{${brand}}${paper ? `html:not([data-theme='dark']) body{${paper}}` : ''}`

16

18	// render as the previous day. Becomes a `timezone` field on `sites` if we ever
19	// host a customer outside Iran.
20	const PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Tehran'
21	
22	// Cache Intl formatters to avoid the high overhead of instantiating them on every function call.
23	const dateTimeFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>()
24	const numberFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>()
25	
26	
27	export const formatDate = (
28	  date: Date | string | number | null | undefined,
29	  locale: string,
30	  options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'long' },
31	): string => {
32	  if (date === null || date === undefined || date === '') return ''
33	
34	  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options)}`
35	  let formatter = dateTimeFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
36	  if (!formatter) {
37	    formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale(locale), {
38	      // 'persian' *is* the Jalali calendar — Intl ships it, so no date library.
39	      calendar: locale === 'fa' ? 'persian' : undefined,
40	      timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE,
41	      ...options,
42	    })
43	    dateTimeFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
44	  }
45	
46	  return formatter.format(new Date(date))
47	}
48	
49	export const formatNumber = (

51	  locale: string,
52	  options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
53	): string => {

55	  let formatter = numberFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
56	  if (!formatter) {
57	    formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(intlLocale(locale), options)
58	    numberFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
59	  }

90

1	# Linework — standalone production image for the Eshobe CMS theme contract.
2	#
3	# Multi-stage build on `output: 'standalone'`: the runner contains only the server bundle, the
4	# static assets and the public files. Secrets are never copied into a layer — every ESHOBE_*
5	# variable is injected by the platform at deploy time (see docs/CMS-SETUP.md).
6	
7	FROM node:22-alpine AS base
8	ENV PNPM_HOME=/pnpm
9	ENV PATH=$PNPM_HOME:$PATH
10	RUN corepack enable
11	
12	FROM base AS deps
13	WORKDIR /app
14	COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
15	RUN --mount=type=cache,id=pnpm,target=/pnpm/store pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
16	
17	FROM base AS builder
18	WORKDIR /app
19	COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
20	COPY . .
21	ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
22	# Build fonts first (scripts/build-fonts.mjs runs inside `pnpm build`); no credential is needed.
23	RUN pnpm build
24	
25	FROM node:22-alpine AS runner
26	WORKDIR /app
27	ENV NODE_ENV=production
28	ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
29	ENV PORT=3000
30	ENV HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
31	RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs
32	COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
33	COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/standalone ./
34	COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs /app/.next/static ./.next/static
35	USER nextjs
36	EXPOSE 3000
37	# Platform health check target: build.healthCheckPath = /api/health (manifest).
38	HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
39	  CMD node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health').then((r)=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"
40	CMD ["node", "server.js"]

import type { Block } from 'payload'

import {
  FixedToolbarFeature,
  HeadingFeature,
  InlineToolbarFeature,
  lexicalEditor,
} from '@payloadcms/richtext-lexical'

import { linkGroup } from '../../fields/linkGroup'

export const CallToAction: Block = {
  slug: 'cta',
  interfaceName: 'CallToActionBlock',
  fields: [
    {
      name: 'richText',
      type: 'richText',
      editor: lexicalEditor({
        features: ({ rootFeatures }) => {
          return [
            ...rootFeatures,
            HeadingFeature({ enabledHeadingSizes: ['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4'] }),
            FixedToolbarFeature(),
            InlineToolbarFeature(),
          ]
        },
      }),
      label: false,
      localized: true,
    },
    linkGroup({
      appearances: ['default', 'outline'],
      overrides: {
        maxRows: 2,
      },
    }),
  ],
  labels: {
    plural: 'Calls to Action',
    singular: 'Call to Action',
  },
}

/**
 * How a photograph sits on the page. Themes read these to apply their own sizing rule
 * (a ratio from a short set plus a viewport-height cap), so an editor composes with
 * intent instead of every image rendering at its exact pixel size and full width.
 * All three are optional: a row saved before they existed renders as `content` / `auto`.

import type { Block, Field } from 'payload'

import {
  BlocksFeature,
  FixedToolbarFeature,
  HeadingFeature,
  InlineToolbarFeature,
  lexicalEditor,
} from '@payloadcms/richtext-lexical'

import { MediaBlockInline } from '@/blocks/MediaBlock/config'
import { link } from '@/fields/link'

const columnFields: Field[] = [
  {
    name: 'size',
    type: 'select',
    label: 'پهنای ستون',
    defaultValue: 'oneThird',
    admin: {
      description: 'ستون‌ها روی یک شبکهٔ ۱۲ستونه کنار هم می‌نشینند و در موبایل زیر هم می‌روند.',
    },
    options: [
      { label: 'یک‌چهارم', value: 'oneQuarter' },
      { label: 'یک‌سوم', value: 'oneThird' },
      { label: 'نصف', value: 'half' },
      { label: 'دوسوم', value: 'twoThirds' },
      { label: 'سه‌چهارم', value: 'threeQuarters' },
      { label: 'تمام عرض', value: 'full' },
    ],
  },
  {
    name: 'richText',
    type: 'richText',
    editor: lexicalEditor({
      features: ({ rootFeatures }) => {
        return [
          ...rootFeatures,
          HeadingFeature({ enabledHeadingSizes: ['h2', 'h3', 'h4'] }),
          // An image in a column is what makes «text beside a photo» buildable.
          BlocksFeature({ blocks: [MediaBlockInline] }),
          FixedToolbarFeature(),
          InlineToolbarFeature(),
        ]
      },
    }),
    label: false,
    localized: true,
  },
  {
    name: 'enableLink',
    type: 'checkbox',
    label: 'افزودن پیوند',
  },
  link({
    overrides: {
      admin: {
        condition: (_data, siblingData) => {
          return Boolean(siblingData?.enableLink)

    },
  }),
]

import type { Block } from 'payload'

import { sectionIntro } from '../fields'

/**
 * Contact *details*, not a contact form — the form-builder block covers that, and a
 * business site usually wants both.
 *
 * ponytail: no embedded map. An iframe needs a `frame-src` CSP entry and ships the
 * visitor's IP to the map provider on load; add it when a customer asks.
 */
export const Contact: Block = {
  slug: 'contact',
  interfaceName: 'ContactBlock',
  fields: [
    ...sectionIntro,
    {
      name: 'address',
      type: 'textarea',
      label: 'نشانی',
      localized: true,
    },
    {
      type: 'row',
      fields: [
        { name: 'latitude', type: 'number', min: -90, max: 90, label: 'عرض جغرافیایی' },
        { name: 'longitude', type: 'number', min: -180, max: 180, label: 'طول جغرافیایی' },
      ],
    },
    {
      name: 'mapUrl',
      type: 'text',
      label: 'پیوند نقشه',
      validate: (value: unknown) => {
        if (!value) return true
        try {
          return new URL(String(value)).protocol === 'https:' || 'پیوند نقشه باید HTTPS باشد.'
        } catch {
          return 'پیوند نقشه نامعتبر است.'
        }
      },
    },
    {
      type: 'row',
      fields: [
        {
          name: 'phones',
          type: 'text',
          label: 'شماره تماس',
          hasMany: true,
          admin: {
            description: 'با رقم انگلیسی بنویسید؛ روی سایت فارسی خودکار فارسی می‌شود.',
          },
        },
        {
          name: 'email',
          type: 'email',
          label: 'رایانامه',
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      name: 'hours',
      type: 'textarea',
      label: 'ساعات کاری',
      localized: true,
    },

4	/**
5	 * Font provisioning.
6	 *
7	 * Persian product type is **Shazde 100–900**. The licensed files are not distributed
8	 * with this repository, so the loader looks for them in `public/fonts/shazde/` at
9	 * build time and, when any are absent, keeps Persian on the shipped Vazirmatn
10	 * variable face — it never maps a missing weight onto another file. Missing filenames
11	 * are reported (`distinctFonts().missing`) instead of being swallowed.
12	 *
13	 * The CSS is emitted by hand rather than through `next/font/local` for one concrete
14	 * reason: the Shazde step is conditional. A `next/font/local` call needs its `src`
15	 * list at build time and would fail the build for every deployment that has not
16	 * dropped in the licensed files — the opposite of "implement the fallback and identify
17	 * the missing files".
18	 */
19	
20	export const SHAZDE_WEIGHTS = [100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900] as const
21	
22	const SHAZDE_STEMS: Record<(typeof SHAZDE_WEIGHTS)[number], string> = {
23	  100: 'Shazde-Thin',
24	  200: 'Shazde-ExtraLight',
25	  300: 'Shazde-Light',
26	  400: 'Shazde-Regular',
27	  500: 'Shazde-Medium',
28	  600: 'Shazde-SemiBold',
29	  700: 'Shazde-Bold',
30	  800: 'Shazde-ExtraBold',
31	  900: 'Shazde-Black',
32	}
33	
34	const SHAZDE_EXTENSIONS = ['woff2', 'woff'] as const
35	
36	const fontsDir = () => join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'fonts')
37	const shazdeDir = () => join(fontsDir(), 'shazde')
38	
39	export type FontFile = { file: string; weight: number; format: 'woff2' | 'woff' }
40	
41	export const shazdeFiles = (): { found: FontFile[]; missing: string[] } => {
42	  const found: FontFile[] = []
43	  const missing: string[] = []
44	  for (const weight of SHAZDE_WEIGHTS) {
45	    const stem = SHAZDE_STEMS[weight]
46	    const match = SHAZDE_EXTENSIONS.map((ext) => `${stem}.${ext}`).find((name) =>
47	      existsSync(join(shazdeDir(), name)),
48	    )
49	    if (!match) {
50	      missing.push(`${stem}.woff2`)
51	      continue
52	    }
53	    found.push({ file: match, weight, format: match.endsWith('.woff') ? 'woff' : 'woff2' })
54	  }
55	  return { found, missing }
56	}

58	/** Files that must be preloaded for first paint: the Persian body face and Latin body. */
59	export const preloadFiles = (): string[] => {
60	  const { found } = shazdeFiles()
61	  return found.length
62	    ? ['/fonts/shazde/' + (found.find((f) => f.weight === 400)?.file ?? found[0]!.file)]
63	    : ['/fonts/vazirmatn-arabic.woff2']

66	/* `format('woff2')` is correct for both static and variable WOFF2: the spec dropped the
67	   `-variations` suffix, and engines that never recognised it (Safari) would skip a
68	   static Shazde face labelled that way. The variable axis is declared by `font-weight`. */
69	const face = (family: string, file: string, format: string, weight: string, unicodeRange?: string) =>
70	  `@font-face{font-family:'${family}';font-style:normal;font-weight:${weight};font-display:swap;` +
71	  `src:url('/fonts/${file}') format('${format}');` +
72	  (unicodeRange ? `unicode-range:${unicodeRange};` : '') +
73	  '}'
74

77	const VAZIRMATN_LATIN_RANGE =

83	 * English body sizes", so English stays on Inter until a design owner validates the
84	 * Latin cut (`docs/TYPOGRAPHY.md` records the check that would flip this).
85	 */
86	export const ENGLISH_USES_BRAND_FONT = false

88	export type FontReport = {
89	  persianFamily: 'Shazde' | 'Vazirmatn Variable'
90	  shazdePresent: boolean
91	  shazdeMissing: string[]
92	  englishFamily: 'Inter Variable'
93	  preload: string[]
94	}
95	
96	export const fontReport = (): FontReport => {
97	  const { found, missing } = shazdeFiles()
98	  return {
99	    persianFamily: found.length ? 'Shazde' : 'Vazirmatn Variable',
100	    shazdePresent: found.length > 0,
101	    shazdeMissing: missing,
102	    englishFamily: 'Inter Variable',
103	    preload: preloadFiles(),

107	export const fontFaceCss = (): string => {
108	  const { found } = shazdeFiles()
109	  const parts: string[] = []
110	
111	  if (found.length) {
112	    // Only the weights actually present are declared; `--font-fa` lists Shazde first.
113	    for (const entry of found) {
114	      parts.push(face('Shazde', `shazde/${entry.file}`, entry.format, String(entry.weight)))
115	    }
116	  } else {
117	    parts.push(face('Vazirmatn Variable', 'vazirmatn-arabic.woff2', 'woff2', '100 900', VAZIRMATN_ARABIC_RANGE))
118	    parts.push(face('Vazirmatn Variable', 'vazirmatn-latin.woff2', 'woff2', '100 900', VAZIRMATN_LATIN_RANGE))
119	  }
120	
121	  parts.push(face('Inter Variable', 'inter-latin.woff2', 'woff2', '100 900', INTER_LATIN_RANGE))
122	
123	  return parts.join('')
124	}

126	/** Reminder used by scripts and `/api/health`; never throws, never blocks a build. */
127	export const missingFontNotice = (): null | string => {
128	  const { found, missing } = shazdeFiles()
129	  if (!missing.length) return null
130	  // A partially installed family must not claim the Vazirmatn fallback: any installed
131	  // Shazde weight keeps Persian on Shazde, and an absent weight resolves to the nearest
132	  // installed one (never a synthesised face).
133	  const persian = found.length
134	    ? 'the nearest installed Shazde weight'
135	    : 'Vazirmatn'
136	  return `Shazde weights not installed (${missing.length}/9): ${missing.join(', ')} — Persian renders on ${persian}. Drop the licensed files into public/fonts/shazde/.`
137	}

5	/**

9	 *
10	 *   x-eshobe-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, rawBody)>

12	 *
13	 * The timestamp is deliberately not part of the signed string — signing `<timestamp>.<body>`
14	 * would be a v2 contract. Verification happens before any cache is purged.
15	 */
16	
17	export function verifyRawBodySignature(
18	  rawBody: string | Buffer,
19	  signatureHeader: string | null | undefined,
20	  secret: string | null | undefined,

22	  if (!signatureHeader || !secret) return false
23	  const expected = `sha256=${createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody).digest('hex')}`
24	  const provided = Buffer.from(signatureHeader, 'utf8')
25	  const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected, 'utf8')
26	  if (provided.length !== expectedBuffer.length) return false
27	  return timingSafeEqual(provided, expectedBuffer)
28	}

55	export function mapRevalidationPath(rawPath: string, domain: string | null): string | null {

Do not implement Stage 3 (live lead handoff, CRM, funnel analytics, live price sourcing, wallet/signup) or Stage 4 (sitemap/robots automation, visual baselines in CI, GHCR workflow, preview→release→rollback).\n- **No fabricated content**: never hardcode testimonials, customer logos, success metrics, prices, licence fees, or product capabilities in theme code. Only CMS blocks may render those, and empty collections are omitted.\n- **No tenant leakage**: every CMS read uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`. Never rewrite `Host` to select a tenant. Never send the site key, draft content, or CMS session cookies to the browser.\n- **Drafts**: public rendering always sends `draft=false` + `where[_status][equals]=published` for pages/posts/products. Globals, categories and search read with `publishFilter:false`. Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.\n- **RTL-first**: logical utilities only (`ms/me/ps/pe/start/end/text-start`); `ml/mr/pl/pr/text-left/text-right/left-*/right-*` fail lint. Persian never gets negative letter-spacing. All dates/numbers/prices go through `@eshobe/site-runtime`.\n- **No copied Vercel assets**: no Vercel marks, screenshots, proprietary graphics, font binaries, or page copy. The DesignMD page is a design reference only; its live content may be re-fetched during implementation (Task 3).\n- **Visual constraints**: CMS `radius` maps to `0 / 4 / 10 / 16px` for cards and controls; pill marketing CTAs ignore it. CMS `lineHeight` is clamped to 1.4–2.4. No arbitrary hardcoded brand colors in components.\n- **Licensing**: only OFL fonts, with LICENSE + PROVENANCE files committed next to the binaries. Demo mockups are AI-generated, fixture-only, and visibly labelled illustrative.\n- **Verification**: every task runs `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test`; final gate is `pnpm verify` (typecheck → lint → vitest → production build).\n- **Known App Router limit**: a page cannot set HTTP 503. The CMS-outage surface renders from the error boundary with `noindex`; exact 503 requires platform support and is documented in `README.md`, not faked.\n\n---\n\n## File eslint.config.mjs / vitest.config.ts\n├── pnpm-workspace.yaml\n├── demo-packs/biza-miz/            CMS-importable page/form JSON + import script\n├── packages/site-runtime/          vendored @eshobe/site-runtime (MIT)\n├── public/\n│   ├── demo/                       AI-generated fixtures, labelled illustrative\n│   └── fonts/                      woff2 + LICENSE + PROVENANCE\n├── src/\n│   ├── app/\n│   │   ├── layout.tsx              html lang/dir, theme CSS, fonts, no-flash script\n│   │   ├── page.tsx                not used (delete after catch-all exists)\n│   │   ├── [[...path]]/page.tsx    single locale-aware page\n│   │   ├── error.tsx / not-found.tsx / loading.tsx\n│   │   └── api/\n│   │       ├── health/route.ts\n│   │       ├── revalidate/route.ts\n│   │ Create the health route and its test**\n\n`src/app/api/health/route.ts`:\n\n```ts\nimport { NextResponse } from 'next/server'\n\nexport type HealthPayload = {\n  ok: true\n  theme: string\n  contractVersion: 1\n  cms: boolean\n  uptime: number\n}\n\n/** Local liveness only: a CMS outage must not make the platform kill a healthy container. */\nexport function healthPayload(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): HealthPayload {\n  return {\n    ok: true,\n    theme: 'eshobe-corporation',\n    contractVersion: 1,\n    cms: typeof env.ESHOBE_CMS_URL === 'string' && The system is Persian-first: Vazirmatn sets the\nPersian voice, Latin display tracking is disabled for Persian, and body leading stays at 1.8.\nThe reference is a design direction, not a source of assets or copy.\n\n## Layout\n\n- Container 1400px; gutters 16 / 24 / 32 / 40px by breakpoint.\n- Breakpoints 600 / 960 / 1200 / 1400.\n- Section rhythm 96–128px desktop, 56–64px mobile; 4px spacing base.\n- Surfaces alternate canvas → soft deterministically; inverted bands only for the\n  hero-adjacent showcase and the final CTA.\n- RTL uses logical properties everywhere; the start edge is the right edge in Persian.\n\n## Elevation\n\nFive stacked-shadow levels (L1–L5), each with an inset hairline. Stacked offsets only — no\nsingle blurred blob. In dark mode the ring becomes `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)`.\n\n## Do / Don't\n\n- Do use `--primary` for action surfaces and `--accent` for links/focus.\n- Do let one strong element own a section; don't compete with the hero.\n- Don't invent metrics, quotes, logos, prices or product claims to fill a layout.\n- Don't use physical direction utilities (`ml-*`, `text-left`, `left-*`).\n- Don't add a block type the CMS contract does not define.\n- Don't copy Vercel marks, screenshots, fonts or page copy.\n\n## Persian adaptations\n\n- Vazirmatn for Persian; Inter for Latin; JetBrains Mono for technical labels only.\n- No negative tracking on Persian; display leading ~1.25, body leading 1.8.\n- Persian digits and Jalali dates via `@eshobe/site-runtime`.\n- Phone numbers keep leading zeros via `toLocaleDigits`, not `formatNumber`.\n- Mixed-direction strings use `unicode-bidi: plaintext`.\n\n## Accessibility\n\n- 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large-text contrast; focus ring visible on every interactive element.\n- 44px minimum touch targets; skip link; labelled fields with `aria-describedby`.\n- Accordion and mobile menu expose `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`; no keyboard traps.\n- `prefers-reduced-motion` removes reveals and smooth scrolling.\n- Form status is announced through `aria-live`; errors are inline and preserved.\n\n## Motion\n\n150–250ms state transitions; reveal stagger ≤80ms; transform/opacity only. No parallax,\ninfinite loops, or layout-shift animation. error.message : 'network error'}`,\n    )\n  }\n\n  if (response.status === 404) return { status: 404, data: null }\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    if (RETRYABLE_STATUS.has(response.status)) {\n      throw new CmsUnavailableError(`CMS returned ${response.status}`, response.status)\n    }\n    throw new CmsUnavailableError(`CMS returned ${response.status}`, response.status)\n  }\n\n  try {\n    return { status: response.status, data: (await response.json()) as T }\n  } catch {\n    throw new CmsUnavailableError('CMS returned malformed JSON', response.status)\n  }\n}\n\n/** A 404 is a legitimate \"no such document\"; every other failure is loud. */\nexport async function cmsFetchOptional<T>(\n  path: string,\n  options: CmsFetchOptions,\n): Promise<T | null> {\n  const result = await cmsFetchJson<T>(path, options)\n  return result.status === 404 ? console.warn('[eshobe-corporation] draft mode is on for a canonical host — drafts disabled')\n  }\n  return allowed\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Write the fixture content pack (minimal but confirmation.\n\n- [ ] **Step 6: Write `src/cms/fixture.ts`**\n\n```ts\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\n\nimport type { Page } from './types'\n\nexport type FixtureResult = { status: number; data: unknown }\n\nconst PACK = join(process.cwd(), 'demo-packs', 'biza-miz')\nconst cache = new Map<string, unknown>()\n\nconst readJson = (file: string): unknown => {\n  const cached = cache.get(file)\n  if (cached !== undefined) return cached\n  const value = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))\n  cache.set(file, value)\n  return value\n}\n\nconst exists = (file: string): boolean => existsSync(file)\n\nconst localeOf = (query: Record<string, unknown>): string =>\n  typeof query.locale === 'string' && query.locale !== '' ? query.locale : 'fa'\n\nconst pageFiles = (): string[] => {\n  const dir = join(PACK, 'pages')\n  if (!exists(dir)) return []\n  return readdir(dir).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.json'))\n}\n\n// Local import keeps this module usable in vitest without node:path globals.\nimport { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'\nconst readdir = (dir: string): string[] => readdirSync(dir)\n\nconst pageFor = (file: string): Page => readJson(file) as Page\n\nconst docs = (items: unknown[]): unknown => ({\n  docs: items,\n  totalDocs: items.length,\n  limit: items.length,\n  totalPages: 1,\n  page: 1,\n  hasPrevPage: false,\n  hasNextPage: false,\n  prevPage: null,\n  nextPage: null,\n})\n\nconst pages = (query: Record<string, unknown>): FixtureResult => {\n  const locale = localeOf(query)\n  const slug = query['where[slug][equals]']\n  const id = query['where[id][equals]']\n  const matches = pageFiles()\n    .filter((file) => file.endsWith(`.${locale}.json`))\n    .map((file) => pageFor(join(PACK, 'pages', file)))\n    .filter((page) => {\n      if (typeof id === 'string') return String(page.id) === id\n      if (typeof slug === 'string') return page.slug === slug\n      return true\n    })\n  return { status: 200, data: docs(matches) }\n}\n\nconst site = (): FixtureResult => {\n  const raw = readJson(join(PACK, 'site.json')) as Record<string, unknown>\n  return {\n    status: 200,\n    data: {\n      ...raw,\n      contractVersion: 1,\n      blocks: [\n        'content', 'mediaBlock', 'cta', 'features', 'testimonials', 'faq', 'contact',\n        'formBlock', 'gallery', 'team', 'pricing', 'logos', 'archive',\n      ],\n      media: { origin: '' },\n      themeRuntime: {\n        theme: { key: 'eshobe-corporation' },\n        settings: raw.settings ?? {},\n        bindings: raw.bindings ?? {},\n      },\n    },\n  }\n}\n\nconst singleton = (name: 'header' | 'footer', query: Record<string, unknown>): FixtureResult => {\n  const locale = localeOf(query)\n  const file = join(PACK, `${name}.${locale}.json`)\n  return exists(file) ? { status: 200, data: docs([readJson(file)]) } : { status: 404, data: null }\n}\n\nconst form = (query: Record<string, unknown>): FixtureResult => {\n  const locale = localeOf(query)\n  const id = query['where[id][equals]']\n  const file = join(PACK, 'forms', `demo.${locale}.json`)\n  if (!exists(file)) return { status: 404, data: null }\n  const value = readJson(file) as { id?: unknown }\n  if (typeof id === 'string' && String(value.id) !== id) {\n    return { status: 200, data: docs([]) }\n  }\n  return { status: 200, data: docs([value]) }\n}\n\n/**\n * In-memory CMS for `ESHOBE_FIXTURE=1`. It implements the exact endpoints and\n * paginated envelopes the real client uses, so no query code changes in tests.\n */\nexport function fixtureResponse(path: string, query: Record<string, unknown>): FixtureResult {\n  if (path === '/api/site') return site()\n  if (path === '/api/pages') return pages(query)\n  if (path === '/api/header') return singleton('header', query)\n  if (path === '/api/footer') return singleton('footer', query)\n  if (path === '/api/forms') return form(query)\n  return { status: 404, data: null }\n}\n```\n\nKeep imports at the top in the real file (`readdirSync` belongs with the other `node:fs` imports). The comment above the import is only to explain why it is local; do not literally leave an import after a statement — move it to the top when implementing:\n\n```ts\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { join } from 'node:path'\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 7: Write `src/cms/site.ts`**\n\n```ts\nimport 'server-only'\n\nimport { headers } from 'next/headers'\nimport { cache } from 'react'\n\nimport { defaultLocale as runtimeDefaultLocale, isLocale, type Locale } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'\n\nimport { assertUsableOrigin, CmsConfigError } from './env'\nimport {\n  cmsFetchJson,\n  getCmsContext,\n  SITE_REVALIDATE_SECONDS,\n  UnknownHostError,\n} from './client'\nimport { isPreviewActive } from './preview'\nimport type { BoundContent, SiteDescriptor, SiteStatus } from './types'\nimport { CONTRACT_VERSION } from './types'\nimport { readThemeSettings, type SettingDiagnostic, type ThemeSettings } from '@/lib/theme/settings'\n\nexport class ContractMismatchError extends Error {\n  readonly kind = 'contract-mismatch'\n  constructor(message: string) {\n    super(message)\n    this.name = 'ContractMismatchError'\n  }\n}\n\nconst SUPPORTED_STATUS: readonly SiteStatus[] = ['active', 'suspended', 'archived']\n\nfunction pickStatus(value: unknown): SiteStatus {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && (SUPPORTED_STATUS as readonly string[]).includes(value)\n    ? (value as SiteStatus)\n    : 'suspended'\n}\n\nexport type SiteView = {\n  descriptor: SiteDescriptor\n  status: SiteStatus\n  locales: Locale[]\n  defaultLocale: Locale\n  mediaOrigin: string\n}\n\nfunction firstHeader(value: string | null): string | null {\n  const first = value?.split(',')[0]?.trim()\n  return first ? first : null\n}\n\nexport async function requestOrigin(): Promise<string> {\n  const incoming = await headers()\n  const host = firstHeader(incoming.get('x-forwarded-host')) ?? firstHeader(incoming.get('host'))\n  const proto = firstHeader(incoming.get('x-forwarded-proto')) === 'https' ? 'https' : 'http'\n  return host ? `${proto}://${host}` : 'http://localhost:3000'\n}\n\n/** Validate the descriptor once; throw loudly rather than render a half-known tenant. */\nexport function readSiteView(descriptor: SiteDescriptor, fixture: boolean): SiteView {\n  if (typeof descriptor.name !== 'string' || descriptor.name.trim() === '') {\n    throw new CmsConfigError('GET /api/site returned no site name; identity must come from the CMS')\n  }\n  const locales = Array.isArray(descriptor.availableLocales)\n    ? descriptor.availableLocales.filter(isLocale)\n    : []\n  if (locales.length === 0) {\n    throw new CmsConfigError('GET /api/site advertises no locale this theme supports (fa, en)')\n  }\n  const declared = typeof descriptor.defaultLocale === 'string' ? descriptor.defaultLocale : ''\n  const siteDefault = locales.includes(declared as Locale)\n    ? (declared as Locale)\n    : (locales[0] as Locale)\n\n  const rawOrigin =\n    typeof descriptor.media?.origin === 'string' ? descriptor.media.origin.trim().replace(/\\/+$/, '') : ''\n  if (rawOrigin === '') {\n    if (!fixture) throw new CmsConfigError('site descriptor is missing media.origin')\n  } else {\n    assertUsableOrigin(rawOrigin)\n  }\n\n  return {\n    descriptor,\n    status: pickStatus(descriptor.status),\n    locales,\n    defaultLocale: siteDefault,\n    mediaOrigin: rawOrigin,\n  }\n}\n\nexport const getSiteDescriptor = cache(async (): Promise<SiteDescriptor> => {\n  const result = await cmsFetchJson<SiteDescriptor>('/api/site', {\n    resource: 'site',\n    revalidate: SITE_REVALIDATE_SECONDS,\n    publishFilter: false,\n  })\n  if (result.status === 404 || !result.data) throw new UnknownHostError()\n  const site = result.data\n  const version = site.contractVersion\n  if (typeof version !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(version) || version < 1) {\n    throw new ContractMismatchError(`GET /api/site returned contractVersion ${String(version)}`)\n  }\n  if (version > CONTRACT_VERSION) {\n    throw new ContractMismatchError(\n      `CMS contractVersion ${version} is newer than this theme implements (${CONTRACT_VERSION})`,\n    )\n  }\n  return site\n})\n\nexport function readBindings(raw: unknown): Record<string, BoundContent | null> {\n  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) return {}\n  const out: Record<string, BoundContent | null> = {}\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {\n    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {\n      out[key] = null\n      continue\n    }\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>\n    out[key] = {\n      id: typeof record.id === 'string' || typeof record.id === 'number' ? String(record.id) : null,\n      type: typeof record.type === 'string' ? record.type : null,\n      slug: typeof record.slug === 'string' ? record.slug : null,\n      title: typeof record.title === 'string' ? record.title : null,\n    }\n  }\n  return out\n}\n\nexport type SiteContext = SiteView & {\n  site: SiteDescriptor\n  settings: ThemeSettings\n  settingsDiagnostics: SettingDiagnostic[]\n  bindings: Record<string, BoundContent | null>\n  themeKey: string | null\n  origin: string\n  preview: boolean\n}\n\nasync function resolveSiteOrigin(\n  view: SiteView,\n  options: { publicOrigin: string | null; fixture: boolean },\n): Promise<string> {\n  if (options.publicOrigin) {\n    assertUsableOrigin(options.publicOrigin)\n    return options.publicOrigin.replace(/\\/+$/, '')\n  }\n  if (options.fixture) return requestOrigin()\n  const domain = typeof view.descriptor.domain === 'string' ? view.descriptor.domain.trim() : ''\n  return domain === '' ? requestOrigin() : `https://${domain.replace(/\\/+$/, '')}`\n}\n\nexport const getSiteContext = cache(async (): Promise<SiteContext> => {\n  const cms = await getCmsContext()\n  const descriptor = await getSiteDescriptor()\n  const view = readSiteView(descriptor, cms.mode === 'fixture')\n  const { settings, diagnostics } = readThemeSettings(descriptor.themeRuntime?.settings)\n  const themeKey = descriptor.themeRuntime?.theme?.key ?? descriptor.themeRuntime?.package?.key ?? null\n\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && themeKey && themeKey !== 'eshobe-corporation') {\n    console.warn(\n      `[eshobe-corporation] descriptor reports theme \"${themeKey}\" but this build is \"eshobe-corporation\"`,\n    )\n  }\n\n  const [origin, preview] = await Promise.all([\n    resolveSiteOrigin(view, {\n      publicOrigin: cms.env.publicOrigin,\n      fixture: cms.mode === 'fixture',\n    }),\n    isPreviewActive(descriptor.domain),\n  ])\n\n  return {\n    ...view,\n    site: descriptor,\n    settings,\n    settingsDiagnostics: diagnostics,\n    bindings: readBindings(descriptor.themeRuntime?.bindings),\n    themeKey,\n    origin,\n    preview,\n  }\n})\n\nexport { runtimeDefaultLocale }\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 8: Write `src/cms/queries.ts`**\n\n```ts\nimport 'server-only'\n\nimport { cmsFetchOptional } from './client'\nimport type { FooterGlobal, Form, HeaderGlobal, Page, Paginated } from './types'\n\nexport type ReadOptions = { locale: string; drafts?: boolean }\n\nconst single = <T>(result: Paginated<T> | null): T | null => result?.docs?.[0] ?? null\n\nexport async function getPageBySlug(slug: string, options: ReadOptions): Promise<Page | null> {\n  const result = await cmsFetchOptional<Paginated<Page>>('/api/pages', {\n    query: {\n      locale: options.locale,\n      fallbackLocale: 'false',\n      depth: 2,\n      'where[slug][equals]': slug,\n      limit: 1,\n    },\n    locale: options.locale,\n    resource: 'page',\n    drafts: options.drafts,\n  })\n  return single(result)\n}\n\nexport async function getPageById(id: string, options: ReadOptions): Promise<Page | null> {\n  const result = await cmsFetchOptional<Paginated<Page>>('/api/pages', {\n    query: {\n      locale: options.locale,\n      fallbackLocale: 'false',\n      depth: 2,\n      'where[id][equals]': id,\n      limit: 1,\n    },\n    locale: options.locale,\n    resource: 'page',\n    drafts: options.drafts,\n  })\n  return single(result)\n}\n\n/** Globals are collections with `isGlobal`; the response is still a paginated envelope. */\nexport async function getHeader(locale: string): Promise<HeaderGlobal | null> {\n  const result = await cmsFetchOptional<Paginated<HeaderGlobal>>('/api/header', {\n    query: { locale, depth: 1 },\n    locale,\n    resource: 'navigation',\n    publishFilter: false,\n  })\n  return single(result)\n}\n\nexport async function getFooter(locale: string): Promise<FooterGlobal | null> {\n  const result = await cmsFetchOptional<Paginated<FooterGlobal>>('/api/footer', {\n    query: { locale, depth: 1 },\n    locale,\n    resource: 'navigation',\n    publishFilter: false,\n  })\n  return single(result)\n}\n\n/** Forms carry no publish status; string\n      landing: boolean\n    }\n\nconst SLOT_ORDER: readonly Exclude<ThemeSlot, 'home'>[] = ['restaurants', 'features', 'pricing', 'demo']\n\nconst slugFor = (slot: ThemeSlot, settings: 'fa')\n\n  const first = input.path[0]\n  let locale: Locale = siteDefault\n  let rest = input.path\n\n  if (isLocale(first)) {\n    if (!available.includes(first)) return { kind: 'not-found' }\n    if (first === siteDefault) {\n      const remaining = input.path.slice(1)\n      return { kind: 'redirect', to: remaining.length === 0 ? { id: binding.id }\n      : { slug: typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== '' ? binding.slug : HOME_SLUG }\n    return { kind: 'page', locale, slot: 'home', pageRef, publicPath: '/', landing: true }\n  }\n\n  if (rest.length === 1) {\n    const segment = rest[0] as string\n    const slot = SLOT_ORDER.find((candidate) => slugFor(candidate, input.settings) === segment)\n    if (slot) {\n      const binding = input.site.themeRuntime?.bindings?.[slot] ?? null\n      const pageRef = binding?.id\n        ? { id: binding.id }\n        : {\n            slug:\n              typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== ''\n                ? binding.slug\n                : slugFor(slot, input.settings),\n          }\n      return {\n        kind: 'page',\n        locale,\n        slot,\n        pageRef,\n        publicPath: `/${segment}`,\n        landing: true,\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const siteRoute = resolveSiteRoute(rest)\n  if (siteRoute.kind !== 'page') return { kind: 'not-found' }\n\n  return {\n    kind: 'page',\n    locale,\n    slot: null,\n    pageRef: { slug: siteRoute.slug },\n    publicPath: `/${siteRoute.slug}`,\n    landing: false,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function routeLocalePath(plan: RoutePlan, locale: Locale, siteDefault: string): string | null {\n  if (plan.kind !== 'page') return null\n  return localeHref(plan.publicPath, locale, siteDefault)\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/lib/nav.ts`**\n\n```ts\nimport { HOME_SLUG, localeHref } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'\n\nimport type { CmsLink, FooterGlobal, HeaderGlobal } from '@/cms/types'\n\nexport type NavLink = { href: string; label: string; newTab: boolean }\n\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\n  Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)\n\nconst safeUrl = (value: string): string | null => {\n  const trimmed = value.trim()\n  if (trimmed === '') return null\n  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed\n  try {\n    const url = new URL(trimmed)\n    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null\n  } catch {\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\n/** CMS link → href. Reference links use the populated page slug; ids alone cannot route. */\nexport function linkHref(raw: unknown, locale: string, siteDefault: string): string | null {\n  if (!isRecord(raw)) return null\n  const link = raw as CmsLink\n  let href: string | null = null\n\n  if (link.type === 'custom') {\n    href = typeof link.url === 'string' ? safeUrl(link.url) : null\n  } else if (link.type === 'reference') {\n    const value = link.reference?.value\n    if (isRecord(value) && typeof value.slug === 'string') {\n      const slug = value.slug === HOME_SLUG || value.slug === '' ? '/' : `/${value.slug}`\n      href = localeHref(slug, locale, siteDefault)\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (!href) return null\n  // Internal hrefs were localized above; external hrefs must never be prefixed.\n  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href) || href.startsWith('//')) return href\n  return localeHref(href, locale, siteDefault)\n}\n\nexport function normalizeNav(\n  global: HeaderGlobal | FooterGlobal | null | undefined,\n  locale: string,\n  siteDefault: string,\n): NavLink[] {\n  const items = Array.isArray(global?.navItems) ? global.navItems : []\n  const links: NavLink[] = []\n  for (const item of items) {\n    const raw = isRecord(item) ? item.link : null\n    const href = linkHref(raw, locale, siteDefault)\n    const label = isRecord(raw) && typeof raw.label === 'string' ? raw.label.trim() : ''\n    if (!href || label === '') continue\n    links.push({\n      href,\n      label,\n      newTab: isRecord(raw) && raw.newTab === true,\n    })\n  }\n  return links\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 6: Run tests and typecheck**\n\nRun: `pnpm vitest run tests/unit/routing.test.ts tests/unit/nav.test.ts && pnpm typecheck`\nExpected: PASS.
