This header is\n * a hint only: routing validates it against the site's advertised locales.\n */\nexport function middleware(request: NextRequest) {\n  const first = request.nextUrl.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0]\n  const prefix = isLocale(first) ? first : ''\n  const headers = new Headers(request.headers)\n  headers.set('x-theme-locale-prefix', prefix)\n  return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } })\n}\n\nexport const config = {\n  matcher: ['/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|fonts|demo|favicon.ico|.*\\\\..*).*)'],\n}\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Write the header, footer and client islands**\n\n`src/components/theme-toggle.tsx`:\n\n```tsx\n'use client'\n\nimport { Moon, Sun } from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react'\n\nimport { uiStrings } from '@/lib/i18n'\n\nexport function ThemeToggle({ locale }: { locale: string }) {\n  const strings = uiStrings(locale)\n  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>('light')\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const current = document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n    setTheme(current)\n  }, [])\n\n  const toggle = () => {\n    const next = theme === 'dark' ? 2462	  const pick = <T extends string>(key: string, allowed: readonly T[], fallback: T): T => {
2463	    const value = source[key]
2464	    if (value === undefined) return fallback
2465	    if (typeof value === 'string' && (allowed as readonly string[]).includes(value)) return value as T
2466	    diagnostics.push({ key, reason: 'invalid', fallback })
2467	    return fallback
2468	  }

2510	/** Canonical hosts must never serve an unauthenticated draft, whatever cookie is present. */
2511	export function isPreviewHost(host: string, domain: string): boolean {
2512	  const incoming = host.split(',')[0]?.trim().toLowerCase().split(':')[0] ?? ''
2513	  const canonical = domain.trim().toLowerCase().split(':')[0] ?? ''
2514	  if (incoming === '' || canonical === '') return false
2515	  if (incoming === canonical || incoming === `www.${canonical}`) return false
2516	  return true
2517	}
2518	
2519	function incomingHost(value: string | null, forwarded: string | null): string {
2520	  return (forwarded ?? value ?? '').split(',')[0]?.trim() ?? ''
2521	}
2522	
2523	export async function isPreviewActive(domain: string): Promise<boolean> {
2524	  const draft = await draftMode()
2525	  if (!draft.isEnabled) return false
2526	  const incoming = await headers()
2527	  const host = incomingHost(incoming.get('host'), incoming.get('x-forwarded-host'))
2528	  const allowed = isPreviewHost(host, domain)
2529	  if (!allowed && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
2530	    console.warn('[eshobe-corporation] draft mode is on for a canonical host — drafts disabled')
2531	  }
2532	  return allowed
2533	}

4258	```ts
4259	import type { Media } from '@/cms/types'
4260	
4261	type MediaInput = Media | string | number | null | undefined
4262	
4263	const asMedia = (value: MediaInput): Media | null =>
4264	  value && typeof value === 'object' ? (value as Media) : null
4265	
4266	/**
4267	 * Same-origin media only. A CMS-provided absolute URL is reduced to its path so the
4268	 * browser streams through this deployment's proxy; an off-origin host is refused.
4269	 */
4270	export function mediaSrc(value: MediaInput, mediaOrigin: string): string | null {
4271	  const media = asMedia(value)
4272	  const raw = typeof media?.url === 'string' ? media.url.trim() : ''
4273	  if (raw === '') return null
4274	  if (raw.startsWith('/') && !raw.startsWith('//')) return raw
4275	
4276	  let url: URL
4277	  try {
4278	    url = new URL(raw)
4279	  } catch {
4280	    return null
4281	  }
4282	  if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return null
4283	
4284	  let origin: string
4285	  try {
4286	    origin = mediaOrigin ? new URL(mediaOrigin).origin : ''
4287	  } catch {
4288	    return null
4289	  }
4290	  return origin !== '' && url.origin === origin ? `${url.pathname}${url.search}` : null
4291	}
4292	
4293	export function mediaDimensions(value: MediaInput): { width: number; height: number } | null {
4294	  const media = asMedia(value)
4295	  const width = typeof media?.width === 'number' ? media.width : 0
4296	  const height = typeof media?.height === 'number' ? media.height : 0
4297	  return width > 0 && height > 0 ? { width, height } : null
4298	}
4299	
4300	export const mediaAlt = (value: MediaInput): string => {
4301	  const media = asMedia(value)
4302	  return typeof media?.alt === 'string' ? media.alt : ''
4303	}
4304	
4305	export const isSvg = (value: MediaInput): boolean => {
4306	  const media = asMedia(value)
4307	  return typeof media?.mimeType === 'string' && media.mimeType.includes('svg')
4308	}
4309	```

4421	import Image from 'next/image'
4422	
4423	import type { Media } from '@/cms/types'
4424	import { mediaAlt, mediaDimensions, mediaSrc, isSvg } from '@/lib/media'
4425	
4426	export function MediaImage({
4427	  media,
4428	  mediaOrigin,
4429	  sizes,
4430	  className,
4431	  priority = false,
4432	}: {
4433	  media: Media | string | number | null | undefined
4434	  mediaOrigin: string
4435	  sizes: string
4436	  className?: string
4437	  priority?: boolean
4438	}) {
4439	  const src = mediaSrc(media, mediaOrigin)
4440	  if (!src) return null
4441	  const alt = mediaAlt(media)
4442	  const dimensions = mediaDimensions(media)
4443	
4444	  if (!dimensions || isSvg(media)) {
4445	    // An SVG must never be inlined; an unknown-size bitmap cannot use next/image.
4446	    return <img src={src} alt={alt} className={className} loading={priority ? 'eager' : 'lazy'} decoding="async" />
4447	  }
4448	
4449	  return (
4450	    <Image
4451	      src={src}
4452	      alt={alt}
4453	      width={dimensions.width}
4454	      height={dimensions.height}

4473	const safeHref = (value: unknown): string | null => {
4474	  if (typeof value !== 'string') return null
4475	  const trimmed = value.trim()
4476	  if (trimmed === '') return null
4477	  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed
4478	  try {
4479	    const url = new URL(trimmed)
4480	    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null
4481	  } catch {
4482	    return null
4483	  }
4484	}

4486	const formatBits: readonly { bit: number; open: string; close: string }[] = [
4487	  { bit: 1, open: '<strong>', close: '</strong>' },
4488	]
4489	
4490	function renderText(node: LexicalTextNode, key: string): ReactNode {
4491	  let content: ReactNode = node.text ?? ''
4492	  const format = typeof node.format === 'number' ? node.format : 0
4493	  if (format & 16) content = <code key={`${key}-code`}>{content}</code>
4494	  if (format & 8) content = <u key={`${key}-u`}>{content}</u>
4495	  if (format & 4) content = <s key={`${key}-s`}>{content}</s>
4496	  if (format & 2) content = <em key={`${key}-em`}>{content}</em>
4497	  if (format & 1) content = <strong key={`${key}-strong`}>{content}</strong>
4498	  if (format & 32) content = <sub key={`${key}-sub`}>{content}</sub>
4499	  if (format & 64) content = <sup key={`${key}-sup`}>{content}</sup>
4500	  return <span key={key}>{content}</span>
4501	}
4502	
4503	function renderChildren(nodes: LexicalNode[] | undefined): ReactNode[] {
4504	  if (!Array.isArray(nodes)) return []
4505	  return nodes.map((node, index) => renderNode(node, `${index}`))
4506	}
4507	
4508	function renderNode(node: LexicalNode, key: string): ReactNode {
4509	  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return null
4510	  if (node.type === 'text') return renderText(node, key)
4511	  const element = node as LexicalElementNode
4512	
4513	  switch (element.type) {
4514	    case 'paragraph':
4515	      return <p key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</p>
4516	    case 'heading': {
4517	      const tag = ['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'h6'].includes(element.tag ?? '') ? element.tag! : 'h2'
4518	      const Heading = tag as 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6'
4519	      return <Heading key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</Heading>
4520	    }
4521	    case 'list': {
4522	      const ordered = element.listType === 'number'
4523	      return ordered
4524	        ? <ol key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</ol>
4525	        : <ul key={key}>{renderChildren(element.children)}</ul>
4526	    }
4527	    case 'listitem':

4529	    case 'quote':

4537	          {children}
4538	        </a>
4539	      )

4580	'use client'
4581	
4582	import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
4583	
4584	import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'
4585	
4586	export function Reveal({
4587	  children,
4588	  delay = 0,
4589	  className,
4590	}: {
4591	  children: ReactNode
4592	  delay?: number
4593	  className?: string
4594	}) {
4595	  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
4596	  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
4597	
4598	  useEffect(() => {
4599	    const node = ref.current
4600	    if (!node) return
4601	    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
4602	      setVisible(true)
4603	      return
4604	    }
4605	    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
4606	      (entries) => {
4607	        for (const entry of entries) {
4608	          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
4609	            setVisible(true)
4610	            observer.disconnect()
4611	          }
4612	        }
4613	      },
4614	      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px', threshold: 0.1 },
4615	    )
4616	    observer.observe(node)
4617	    return () => observer.disconnect()
4618	  }, [])
4619	
4620	  return (
4621	    <div
4622	      ref={ref}
4623	      data-visible={visible ? 'true' : 'false'}
4624	      style={{ transitionDelay: `${Math.min(delay, 80)}ms` }}
4625	      className={cn(
4626	        'motion-safe:transition-[opacity,transform] motion-safe:duration-200 motion-safe:ease-theme',
4627	        visible ? 'opacity-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 translate-y-2',
4628	        'motion-reduce:translate-y-0 motion-reduce:opacity-100 motion-reduce:transition-none',
4629	        className,
4630	      )}
4631	    >
4632	      {children}
4633	    </div>
4634	  )
4635	}

# Eshobe Corporation Theme — Design Specification

- **Date**: 2026-10-24
- **Status**: Approved for planning
- **Issue**: [hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme#1](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/cms-corporation-theme/issues/1)
- **Theme key / name**: `eshobe-corporation` / "Eshobe Corporation" / «پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه»
- **References**: [Eshobe Theme API](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/THEME_API.md), [theme deployments](https://github.com/hamidnoshady/eshobe-cms/blob/main/docs/theme-deployments.md), [DesignMD Vercel reference](https://www.designmd.co/d/vercel)

## 1. Purpose and scope

Build a production-grade, reusable, Eshobe-native corporate/SaaS theme with a Vercel-inspired visual language, demonstrated first with Biza Miz restaurant/café marketing content.

**In scope (this pass): Stage 1 + Stage 2 of the issue**

- Committed `DESIGN.md` translated from the DesignMD reference, plus `AGENTS.md` that mandates reading it and the Theme API before UI edits.
- Eshobe theme manifest, design tokens, typography, layout shell, theme switch, responsive RTL navigation.
- CMS-driven page system: homepage, restaurant/café landing, pricing explainer, features page, demo/contact form, light/dark, fa/en.
- Fixture-backed local development, content pack for Biza Miz, test and verification harness.

**Out of scope (Stages 3–4)**: live lead handoff/CRM and attribution, funnel analytics, live Biza Miz price sourcing, wallet/signup destinations, sitemap/robots, production preview→health→release→rollback, GHCR artifact workflow, full visual-regression baselines.

Nothing in this pass may claim a deployed integration or fabricate testimonials, metrics, prices, or product capabilities.

## 2. Decisions

| # | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Composition model B: contract block vocabulary with theme-owned designed variants | Keeps CMS authoring authority while reaching reference-level art direction; no invented block types |
| D2 | Theme key `eshobe-corporation` | Owner decision; matches repo identity in the CMS picker |
| D3 | Product showcase imagery is AI-generated, stored under `public/demo/`, fixture-only, labelled illustrative | Owner decision; contained so no fabricated imagery reaches production theme code |
| D4 | Stack mirrors `cms-arch2-theme`: Next 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, standalone Docker | Contract-proven sibling implementation |
| D5 | Vendor `@eshobe/site-runtime` as a workspace package instead of an ad-hoc alias shim | npm package is unpublished and missing documented exports (`resolveSiteRoute`, `siteOrigin`, `localeCodes`) |
| D6 | Announcement banner deferred | No localized announcement field exists in `header`, page blocks, or manifest settings; shipping a Persian-only banner would break fa/en parity |
| D7 | Blog/archive deferred | Issue schedules learning/blog for a later phase; `archive` block warns and renders nothing |

## 3. Design system

`DESIGN.md` is a first-class deliverable with machine-readable frontmatter (colors, typography, rounded, spacing, components) and human sections (overview, layout, elevation, do/don't, Persian adaptations, accessibility, motion). It records attribution to the DesignMD reference and every deliberate deviation.

### 3.1 Reference translation

| Reference trait | Adaptation |
|---|---|
| Ink `#171717` primary CTA, near-white canvas, 1px hairlines | Kept as neutral core, tokenised |
| Four-step surface ladder (white / 98% / 95% / polarity-flipped ink) | Kept; inverted pair is semantic and self-flips in dark mode |
| Multi-stop mesh gradient, hero scale only | Original CSS multi-radial composition with our stops and geometry; never a copy of Vercel's SVG |
| Geist / Geist Mono | Vazirmatn (Persian, Eshobe standard) + Inter Variable (Latin) + JetBrains Mono (technical labels), all openly licensed, self-hosted. No Vercel font binaries, marks, copy, or screenshots |
| Aggressive negative display tracking | Latin only; Persian exempt (no negative tracking on connected script), 1.8 body leading, ~1.25 display leading |
| 4px spacing, 1400px container, 600/960/1200/1400 breakpoints | Kept; section rhythm 96–128px desktop, 56–64px mobile |
| Stacked shadows L1–L5 + inset hairline | Kept; dark mode ring becomes `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%)` |
| Radius 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100 pills | Theme owns scale; CMS `radius` maps to control/card radius only. Marketing CTAs stay pill; nav CTAs 6px |

### 3.2 Tokens

- **Colors (light)**: `ink #171717`, `body #4d4d4d`, `mute #888888`, `hairline #ebebeb`, `hairline-strong #a1a1a1`, `canvas #ffffff`, `canvas-soft #fafafa`, `canvas-soft-2 #f5f5f5`, `link #0070f3`, semantic success/warning/error with soft/deep variants.
- **Colors (dark)**: `canvas #0a0a0a`, `canvas-soft #111111`, `canvas-soft-2 #171717`, `ink #ededed`, `body #a1a1a1`, `mute #737373`, `hairline #262626`, `hairline-strong #525252`.
- **CMS-editable only**: `primary`, `accent`, `background`, `foreground`, `radius (none|sm|md|lg)`, `lineHeight (1.4–2.4)`, emitted on `body` scope via `themeCss(site.theme)` in a `#site-theme` style element. Every other token lives in theme CSS. The platform maps radius to `0 / 4 / 10 / 16px`; the default `md` is the nearest step to the reference's 8px card radius and is recorded as a deliberate deviation. When a tenant overrides it, cards and controls follow the tenant value; pill CTAs keep their brand shape.
- **Type scale**: display-xl 48/48/−2.4, display-lg 32/40/−1.28, display-md 24/32/−0.96, display-sm 20/28/−0.6, body-lg 18/28, body-md 16/24, body-sm 14/20/−0.28, caption 12/16, mono 12–13. Persian overrides tracking to 0 and leading to 1.8 body / ~1.25 display.
- **Radii**: 4/6/8/12/16 + 64/100/full. **Spacing**: 4px base; 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192.
- **Elevation**: L1 inset hairline; L2 soft drop; L3 soft stack; L4 float stack; L5 modal. Stacked offsets only, always with inset ring.
- **Token parity**: CSS variables and a TS mirror are asserted by a unit test.

### 3.3 Components

Nav (sticky 64px, mobile overlay, locale/theme switches), buttons (primary pill, secondary, ghost; sm/md/lg; full state matrix), badge + mono eyebrow, marketing/soft cards, product mockup chrome, section header, feature grid, sticky-stack band, pricing card + featured, testimonial card, FAQ accordion, logo strip, announcement primitive (deferred in pages), inputs/select/textarea with helper and error text, submit states (idle/pending/sent/error), contact card, CTA band, footer.

### 3.4 Motion, accessibility, performance

- Motion: 150–250ms state transitions; scroll reveals ≤80ms stagger; transform/opacity only; no parallax, infinite loops, or layout-shift animation. `prefers-reduced-motion` removes all of it.
- Accessibility: 4.5:1 body / 3:1 large text, visible focus ring, 44px touch targets, skip link, `aria-expanded/controls`, labelled fields with `aria-describedby`, `aria-live` status, no keyboard traps, logical properties only (`ms/ps/text-start`; `ml/pl/text-left` banned by lint).
- Performance: server components by default; client islands limited to nav/mobile menu, theme toggle, accordion, form, reveal observer; no animation library; self-hosted subset woff2 with `font-display: swap` and preload; `next/image` with explicit `sizes`; CSS hero mesh. Budgets: CLS < 0.1, LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms; sections usable without JS except the islands.

## 4. Architecture

### 4.1 Repository layout

```text
eshobe-corporation-theme/
├── eshobe.theme.json
├── DESIGN.md
├── AGENTS.md
├── README.md
├── Dockerfile
├── package.json / pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── demo-packs/biza-miz/           # page JSON, form schema, nav links, import script
├── packages/site-runtime/         # vendored @eshobe/site-runtime workspace package
├── public/
│   ├── demo/                      # fixture-only generated mockups, labelled illustrative
│   └── fonts/                     # Vazirmatn, Inter, JetBrains Mono + licenses
├── src/
│   ├── app/[[...path]]/           # resolve → dispatch → RouteShell
│   ├── app/api/health/
│   ├── app/api/revalidate/
│   ├── app/api/[...segments]/     # allowlisted CMS proxy
│   ├── app/api/exit-preview/
│   ├── cms/                       # client, site descriptor, typed queries, draft policy, cache tags
│   ├── sections/                  # hero, showcase, feature-grid, sticky-stack, pricing, logos, testimonial, faq, cta, form, media, editorial, gallery, team, contact
│   ├── blocks/                    # blockType → section + variant resolver
│   ├── components/                # ui primitives, nav, footer, mockup chrome
│   ├── lib/{i18n,routing,theme,seo,media}
│   └── styles/                    # globals.css @theme tokens, fonts.css
└── tests/{unit,browser,fixtures}
```

### 4.2 Routes and bindings

- `fa` is unprefixed; `en` is prefixed (`/en/...`). A locale absent from `availableLocales` is a 404. `dir` derives per request.
- Theme-owned routes: `/`, `/restaurants`, `/pricing`, `/features`, `/demo`, plus `/<cms-page-slug>`.
- Each route resolves `themeRuntime.bindings[slot]` by page ID first, then the matching theme setting slug (`restaurantsSlug`, `pricingSlug`, `featuresSlug`, `demoSlug`). A missing binding is a 404; no bundled fallback copy.
- Page content is fetched by ID/slug with `depth=2` (single doc), media resolved via `site.media.origin`, and header/footer globals fetched in parallel.
- Nav comes from the `header` global. Footer columns use `footer.navItems`, followed by brand and legal line; no contact or social fields are invented, and no CMS fields beyond `navItems` are assumed.

### 4.3 Block → section resolution

| Contract block | Section | Variant rule |
|---|---|---|
| `cta` | hero / cta-band / inline | First `cta` on a landing route → hero (mesh backdrop unless `heroTreatment=plain`; link 1 primary pill, link 2 secondary). Last → inverted CTA band. Else inline |
| `mediaBlock` | showcase / editorial figure | Immediately after hero → 16:10 mockup chrome unless `showcaseTreatment=editorial`; else framed by `size`/`aspect`, `auto` derived from orientation with viewport cap |
| `features` | feature grid / sticky-stack | `columns` 2–4; sticky-stack when `featureTreatment=sticky`, disabled under reduced motion |
| `pricing` | pricing grid | `featured` plan polarity-flipped in both themes; price via `formatNumber` + `unit` |
| `testimonials` | quote cards | CMS items only; empty → section omitted |
| `faq` | accordion | Radix single-collapsible, keyboard complete |
| `logos` | logo strip | Monochrome via `logosMonochrome`, colour on hover |
| `content` | editorial columns | Lexical `direction` per field, `unicode-bidi: plaintext` |
| `gallery` | image grid | Columns from block |
| `team` | team grid | CMS members only |
| `contact` | contact card | Phones via `toLocaleDigits` |
| `formBlock` | CMS form | Renders `forms.fields[]` verbatim plus hidden honeypot |
| `archive` | deferred | Dev warning, null in production |

- Section surfaces alternate `canvas` → `canvas-soft` deterministically; inverted bands reserved for hero-adjacent showcase and final CTA.
- Unknown `blockType`: log and render nothing. Never invent a block type.

### 4.4 Manifest

- `contractVersion: 1`, `key: "eshobe-corporation"`, `name: "Eshobe Corporation"`, `nameFa: "پوستهٔ شرکتی اشوبه"`, `siteTypes: ["business"]`, `locales: ["fa","en"]`.
- `capabilities`: `rtlFirst`, `multiLocale`, `pageBuilderBlocks`, `forms`.
- `design` defaults: `primary "#171717"`, `accent "#0070f3"`, `background "#fafafa"`, `foreground "#171717"`, `radius "md"`, `lineHeight 1.8`.
- `build`: `dockerfile`, port 3000, `healthCheckPath: "/api/health"`, `isStatic: false`; no `deployment` block (Coolify build strategy).
- `env: []` (all `ESHOBE_*` variables are platform-injected).
- `settings`: `heroTreatment` (select mesh|plain, default mesh), `featureTreatment` (select cards|sticky, default cards), `showcaseTreatment` (select mockup|editorial, default mockup), `logosMonochrome` (boolean, default true), `restaurantsSlug` (text, default "restaurants"), `pricingSlug` (text, default "pricing"), `featuresSlug` (text, default "features"), `demoSlug` (text, default "demo").
- `contentSlots`: `home` (type `page`, required), `restaurants` (type `page`), `pricing` (type `page`), `features` (type `page`), `demo` (type `page`).

## 5. Data flow, caching, preview, security

- **Bootstrap**: one cached `GET /api/site` per request (key-authenticated) validates `contractVersion`, media origin, locales, settings, bindings.
- **Tenancy**: every CMS call uses `ESHOBE_CMS_URL` + `Authorization: Bearer $ESHOBE_API_KEY`; never a rewritten `Host` (loops back into the theme container). No `?site=` anywhere. The key never reaches the browser.
- **Draft policy**: centralized. A site key can read drafts, so public rendering always sends `draft=false` and `where[_status][equals]=published` for pages, posts, products and form submissions. Globals (`header`, `footer`, theme, store), `categories` and `search` do not carry a publish status, so they are read with the publish filter disabled but still tenant-scoped. Preview requires Next `draftMode()` **and** a non-canonical host, then uses `no-store`, `draft=true`, `noindex`.
- **Cache**: `force-cache`, site 30s / content 60s, tags `cms:all` and `tnt:<site>:<locale>:<resource>`.
- **Revalidation**: `POST /api/revalidate` verifies raw-body HMAC-SHA256 (`x-eshobe-signature`), a timestamp tolerance of ±5 minutes, a 64KB cap, purges payload tags/paths, at-most-once, 3s.
- **Proxy**: `/api/[...segments]` allowlists CMS heads (`site, pages, posts, products, categories, header, footer, forms, form-submissions, search, media, theme, store, checkout, payments, redirects, globals`), drops visitor cookies/auth, refuses recursion, and forwards to the CMS with its own host.
- **Media**: URLs resolved against `site.media.origin`; SVGs via `<img>`, never inline; remote patterns restricted to the CMS origin.

## 6. Forms

The demo/contact form is a CMS `formBlock` submitted to `/api/form-submissions`:

```json
{ "form": "<formId>", "submissionData": [{ "field": "name", "value": "…" }] }
```

- Tenant is derived server-side from the form document; the client cannot choose it.
- Required consent is a **checkbox field in the CMS form schema** shipped with the content pack; the renderer never injects fields beyond the hidden honeypot.
- Inline validation with `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`; Persian-digit normalisation via `toAsciiDigits`; values preserved on failure; disabled submit while pending; success/error announced via `aria-live`; retry control.
- Hidden honeypot; spam rate-limiting is deferred to Stage 3.
- CRM handoff, attribution and analytics are **not** implemented in this pass.

## 7. Failure states

| Condition | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Unknown route | Themed 404, `noindex` |
| Missing binding | 404, no bundled copy |
| CMS unreachable | Cached content when available; else themed 503 with retry; health endpoint stays local |
| Site suspended/archived | Contract holding page, HTTP 200, `noindex` |
| Contract version mismatch | Loud developer-facing error page; no silent render |
| Empty collection block | Section omitted |
| Premium/featured content | No placeholder testimonials, logos, metrics, or prices |

## 8. Biza Miz content

- Theme code stays tenant-neutral; Biza Miz copy, page structures, nav links and form schema ship in `demo-packs/biza-miz/`.
- The content pack mirrors the issue's homepage rhythm: hero → dashboard showcase → benefits → feature/industry grid → pricing explanation → proof/FAQ → final CTA. Priority pages: restaurants/cafés, demo request, pricing, features.
- Product messaging follows the proven POS workflow **menu → table/order → payment/receipt → shift/sales report**; Accounting, CRM, Growth and Website capabilities are only described at their actual release readiness.
- The pack carries **no invented prices**. Pricing renders CMS `pricing` plans; when a plan is not sourced from the Biza Miz catalogue it must be marked illustrative in the content, never presented as a live licence fee.
- Account signup, activation, wallet and payment stay Biza Miz's; the theme links out to tenant-supplied destinations and implements no checkout, wallet or identity.
- An idempotent import script uses only capabilities a site key has (pages, posts, forms, header/footer). Media must be uploaded by an editor because a site key cannot create media.
- The fixture provider mirrors the content pack and serves generated mockups from `public/demo/`, visibly labelled illustrative. Production renders CMS media only.
- Demo form is the only lead path in this pass; Stage 3 owns the sales-process handoff.

## 9. Verification

- `pnpm verify` = typecheck → lint → vitest → production build.
- Unit (vitest): route/locale resolution, binding resolution, variant resolver, band rhythm, draft policy, cache tags, HMAC revalidation, form validation, token parity, manifest validation mirroring the CMS parser.
- Browser (Playwright, fixture CMS): five routes × three breakpoints × fa/en × light/dark; keyboard navigation; mobile menu; theme persistence; locale switch; form success/failure; reduced motion; axe; RTL overflow (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth`); visual snapshots.
- Manual/recorded: retry of the DesignMD live reference and a written deviation list in `DESIGN.md`.
- No claim of deployment, live CMS integration, or production performance until those are actually run.

## 10. Risks and open items

1. **Live DesignMD reference** returned HTTP 429 during design. Reconciliation is deferred to implementation; every deviation must be recorded, not assumed.
2. **AI-generated showcase imagery** conflicts with the issue's "authentic product demonstration visuals" and "no fabricated claims". Mitigation: fixture-only, labelled, no invented metrics; real screenshots can replace them via CMS media at any time.
3. **Unpublished runtime package**: vendored workspace package; parity tested against the CMS source.
4. **No live tenant in this pass**: content pack + fixtures replace a claimed deployment.
5. **Spam protection** is honeypot-only until Stage 3.
6. **Font licensing**: only OFL-licensed families; licenses committed with the binaries.

## 11. Acceptance mapping (Stage 1 + 2)

| Issue criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| `DESIGN.md` committed, attributed, original, agent guidance refers to it | DESIGN.md + AGENTS.md deliverables |
| Reusable components, responsive homepage, visual review at 3 widths | Component set, Playwright snapshots |
| RTL Persian first-class; English LTR; dark/light; reduced motion; keyboard | i18n/RTL + a11y sections and tests |
| CMS edits publish without theme changes; no cross-tenant exposure | Block/variant architecture, key-only server access, cache/tag tests |
| Demo CTA and form work end-to-end | CMS form + submission route, verified against fixtures and a tenant where credentials exist |
| Preview/health/release/rollback tested through Eshobe | `/api/health` implemented; preview→release→rollback **deferred to Stage 4** |
| No fabricated testimonials, metrics, prices, claims | Omit-empty policy, fixture labelling, no hardcoded content |

## 12. Implementation outline

1. **Foundation**: scaffold, manifest, vendored runtime, tokens, fonts, layout shell, nav/footer, theme switch, health/proxy/revalidate routes, fixtures, unit harness.
2. **Design contract**: write `DESIGN.md` + `AGENTS.md`; retry the live reference; record deviations.
3. **Sections**: primitives and all business-block sections with variant resolution.
4. **Routes**: home, restaurants, pricing, features, demo, generic CMS pages; metadata and locale switching.
5. **Forms and states**: CMS form island, error/empty/holding pages.
6. **Content pack**: Biza Miz page JSON, form schema, import script, generated mockups.
7. **Verification**: Playwright suite, axe, RTL overflow, snapshots; run `pnpm verify`.

3385	  const siteDefault: Locale =
3386	    isLocale(declared) && available.includes(declared)
3387	      ? declared
3388	      : (available[0] ?? 'fa')
3389	
3390	  const first = input.path[0]
3391	  let locale: Locale = siteDefault
3392	  let rest = input.path
3393	
3394	  if (isLocale(first)) {
3395	    if (!available.includes(first)) return { kind: 'not-found' }
3396	    if (first === siteDefault) {
3397	      const remaining = input.path.slice(1)
3398	      return { kind: 'redirect', to: remaining.length === 0 ? '/' : `/${remaining.join('/')}` }
3399	    }
3400	    locale = first
3401	    rest = input.path.slice(1)
3402	  }
3403	
3404	  if (rest.length === 0) {
3405	    const binding = input.site.themeRuntime?.bindings?.home ?? null
3406	    const pageRef = binding?.id
3407	      ? { id: binding.id }
3408	      : { slug: typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== '' ? binding.slug : HOME_SLUG }
3409	    return { kind: 'page', locale, slot: 'home', pageRef, publicPath: '/', landing: true }
3410	  }
3411	
3412	  if (rest.length === 1) {
3413	    const segment = rest[0] as string
3414	    const slot = SLOT_ORDER.find((candidate) => slugFor(candidate, input.settings) === segment)
3415	    if (slot) {
3416	      const binding = input.site.themeRuntime?.bindings?.[slot] ?? null
3417	      const pageRef = binding?.id
3418	        ? { id: binding.id }
3419	        : {
3420	            slug:
3421	              typeof binding?.slug === 'string' && binding.slug !== ''
3422	                ? binding.slug
3423	                : slugFor(slot, input.settings),
3424	          }
3425	      return {
3426	        kind: 'page',
3427	        locale,
3428	        slot,
3429	        pageRef,
3430	        publicPath: `/${segment}`,
3431	        landing: true,
3432	      }
3433	    }
3434	  }
3435	
3436	  const siteRoute = resolveSiteRoute(rest)
3437	  if (siteRoute.kind !== 'page') return { kind: 'not-found' }
3438	
3439	  return {
3440	    kind: 'page',
3441	    locale,
3442	    slot: null,
3443	    pageRef: { slug: siteRoute.slug },
3444	    publicPath: `/${siteRoute.slug}`,
3445	    landing: false,
3446	  }
3447	}
3448	
3449	export function routeLocalePath(plan: RoutePlan, locale: Locale, siteDefault: string): string | null {
3450	  if (plan.kind !== 'page') return null
3451	  return localeHref(plan.publicPath, locale, siteDefault)
3452	}

3456	
3457	```ts
3458	import { HOME_SLUG, localeHref } from '@eshobe/site-runtime'
3459	
3460	import type { CmsLink, FooterGlobal, HeaderGlobal } from '@/cms/types'
3461	
3462	export type NavLink = { href: string; label: string; newTab: boolean }
3463	
3464	const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>
3465	  Boolean(value) && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
3466	
3467	const safeUrl = (value: string): string | null => {
3468	  const trimmed = value.trim()
3469	  if (trimmed === '') return null
3470	  if (trimmed.startsWith('/') && !trimmed.startsWith('//')) return trimmed
3471	  try {
3472	    const url = new URL(trimmed)
3473	    return ['http:', 'https:', 'mailto:', 'tel:'].includes(url.protocol) ? url.toString() : null
3474	  } catch {
3475	    return null
3476	  }
3477	}
3478	
3479	/** CMS link → href. Reference links use the populated page slug; ids alone cannot route. */
3480	export function linkHref(raw: unknown, locale: string, siteDefault: string): string | null {
3481	  if (!isRecord(raw)) return null
3482	  const link = raw as CmsLink
3483	  let href: string | null = null
3484	
3485	  if (link.type === 'custom') {
3486	    href = typeof link.url === 'string' ? safeUrl(link.url) : null
3487	  } else if (link.type === 'reference') {
3488	    const value = link.reference?.value
3489	    if (isRecord(value) && typeof value.slug === 'string') {
3490	      const slug = value.slug === HOME_SLUG || value.slug === '' ? '/' : `/${value.slug}`
3491	      href = localeHref(slug, locale, siteDefault)
3492	    }
3493	  }
3494	
3495	  if (!href) return null
3496	  // Internal hrefs were localized above; external hrefs must never be prefixed.
3497	  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(href) || href.startsWith('//')) return href
3498	  return localeHref(href, locale, siteDefault)
3499	}
3500	
3501	export function normalizeNav(
3502	  global: HeaderGlobal | FooterGlobal | null | undefined,
3503	  locale: string,
3504	  siteDefault: string,
3505	): NavLink[] {
3506	  const items = Array.isArray(global?.navItems) ? global.navItems : []
3507	  const links: NavLink[] = []
3508	  for (const item of items) {
3509	    const raw = isRecord(item) ? item.link : null
3510	    const href = linkHref(raw, locale, siteDefault)
3511	    const label = isRecord(raw) && typeof raw.label === 'string' ? raw.label.trim() : ''
3512	    if (!href || label === '') continue
3513	    links.push({
3514	      href,
3515	      label,
3516	      newTab: isRecord(raw) && raw.newTab === true,
3517	    })
3518	  }
3519	  return links
3520	}
3521	```

import type { Block } from 'payload'

import {
  FixedToolbarFeature,
  HeadingFeature,
  InlineToolbarFeature,
  lexicalEditor,
} from '@payloadcms/richtext-lexical'

import { linkGroup } from '../../fields/linkGroup'

export const CallToAction: Block = {
  slug: 'cta',
  interfaceName: 'CallToActionBlock',
  fields: [
    {
      name: 'richText',
      type: 'richText',
      editor: lexicalEditor({
        features: ({ rootFeatures }) => {
          return [
            ...rootFeatures,
            HeadingFeature({ enabledHeadingSizes: ['h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4'] }),
            FixedToolbarFeature(),
            InlineToolbarFeature(),
          ]
        },
      }),
      label: false,
      localized: true,
    },
    linkGroup({
      appearances: ['default', 'outline'],
      overrides: {
        maxRows: 2,
      },
    }),
  ],
  labels: {
    plural: 'Calls to Action',
    singular: 'Call to Action',
  },
}

import type { Block, Field } from 'payload'

import { TENANT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FIELD } from '@/admin/fields/mediaUploadComponentPath'

/**
 * How a photograph sits on the page. Themes read these to apply their own sizing rule
 * (a ratio from a short set plus a viewport-height cap), so an editor composes with
 * intent instead of every image rendering at its exact pixel size and full width.
 * All three are optional: a row saved before they existed renders as `content` / `auto`.
 */
export const mediaSizeField: Field = {
  name: 'size',
  type: 'select',
  label: 'پهنا',
  defaultValue: 'content',
  admin: { width: '33%' },
  options: [
    { label: 'باریک', value: 'narrow' },
    { label: 'هم‌پهنای متن', value: 'content' },
    { label: 'پهن', value: 'wide' },
    { label: 'تمام‌صفحه', value: 'full' },
  ],
}

export const mediaAspectOptions = [
  { label: 'خودکار (بر اساس جهت تصویر)', value: 'auto' },
  { label: 'افقی عریض ۱۶:۹', value: '16/9' },
  { label: 'افقی ۳:۲', value: '3/2' },
  { label: 'افقی ۴:۳', value: '4/3' },
  { label: 'مربع ۱:۱', value: '1/1' },
  { label: 'عمودی ۴:۵', value: '4/5' },
  { label: 'عمودی ۳:۴', value: '3/4' },
  { label: 'نسبت اصلی تصویر', value: 'original' },
]

export const mediaAspectField: Field = {
  name: 'aspect',
  type: 'select',
  label: 'نسبت قاب',
  defaultValue: 'auto',
  admin: {
    description: 'تصویر قاب را پر می‌کند و نقطهٔ کانونی رسانه حفظ می‌شود.',
    width: '33%',
  },
  options: mediaAspectOptions,
}

const mediaField: Field = {
  name: 'media',
  type: 'upload',
  label: 'تصویر',
  relationTo: 'media',
  required: true,
  // Also registered as a Lexical feature, which the generic schema traversal cannot
  // reach — so the tenant media picker is named here explicitly.
  admin: { components: { Field: TENANT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FIELD } },
}

const presentation = (localizedCaption: boolean): Field => ({
  type: 'row',
  fields: [
    mediaSizeField,
    mediaAspectField,
    {
      name: 'caption',
      type: 'text',
      label: 'زیرنویس',
      // Page layout rows localize their text; inside a rich-text field the whole
      // field is already localized, so the caption must not be localized again.
      localized: localizedCaption,
      admin: { width: '34%' },
    },
  ],
})

const labels = { plural: 'تصاویر', singular: 'تصویر' }

/** Page-layout block (`pages.layout`). */
export const MediaBlock: Block = {
  slug: 'mediaBlock',
  interfaceName: 'MediaBlock',
  labels,
  fields: [mediaField, presentation(true)],
}

/** The same block inside rich text (posts, columns): stored as JSON, caption unlocalized. */
export const MediaBlockInline: Block = {
  slug: 'mediaBlock',
  interfaceName: 'MediaBlockInline',
  labels,
  fields: [mediaField, presentation(false)],
}

import type { Field, GroupField } from 'payload'

import deepMerge from '@/utilities/deepMerge'

export type LinkAppearances = 'default' | 'outline'

export const appearanceOptions: Record<LinkAppearances, { label: string; value: string }> = {
  default: {
    label: 'Default',
    value: 'default',
  },
  outline: {
    label: 'Outline',
    value: 'outline',
  },
}

type LinkType = (options?: {
  appearances?: LinkAppearances[] | false
  disableLabel?: boolean
  overrides?: Partial<GroupField>
}) => Field

export const link: LinkType = ({ appearances, disableLabel = false, overrides = {} } = {}) => {
  const linkResult: GroupField = {
    name: 'link',
    type: 'group',
    admin: {
      hideGutter: true,
    },
    fields: [
      {
        type: 'row',
        fields: [
          {
            name: 'type',
            type: 'radio',
            admin: {
              layout: 'horizontal',
              width: '50%',
            },
            defaultValue: 'reference',
            options: [
              {
                label: 'Internal link',
                value: 'reference',
              },
              {
                label: 'Custom URL',
                value: 'custom',
              },
            ],
          },
          {
            name: 'newTab',
            type: 'checkbox',
            admin: {
              style: {
                alignSelf: 'flex-end',
              },
              width: '50%',
            },
            label: 'Open in new tab',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  }

  const linkTypes: Field[] = [
    {
      name: 'reference',
      type: 'relationship',
      admin: {
        condition: (_, siblingData) => siblingData?.type === 'reference',
      },
      label: 'Document to link to',
      relationTo: ['pages', 'posts'],
      required: true,
    },
    {
      name: 'url',
      type: 'text',
      admin: {
        condition: (_, siblingData) => siblingData?.type === 'custom',
      },
      label: 'Custom URL',
      // An external link often points at a different page per language.
      localized: true,
      required: true,
    },
  ]

  if (!disableLabel) {
    linkTypes.map((linkType) => ({
      ...linkType,
      admin: {
        ...linkType.admin,
        width: '50%',
      },
    }))

    linkResult.fields.push({
      type: 'row',
      fields: [
        ...linkTypes,
        {
          name: 'label',
          type: 'text',
          admin: {
            width: '50%',
          },
          label: 'Label',
          localized: true,
          required: true,
        },
      ],
    })
  } else {
    linkResult.fields = [...linkResult.fields, ...linkTypes]
  }

  if (appearances !== false) {
    let appearanceOptionsToUse = [appearanceOptions.default, appearanceOptions.outline]

    if (appearances) {
      appearanceOptionsToUse = appearances.map((appearance) => appearanceOptions[appearance])
    }

    linkResult.fields.push({
      name: 'appearance',
      type: 'select',
      admin: {
        description: 'Choose how the link should be rendered.',
      },
      defaultValue: 'default',
      options: appearanceOptionsToUse,
    })
  }

  return deepMerge(linkResult, overrides)
}

/**
 * The only place dates and numbers are formatted.
 *
 * Persian pages get Shamsi (Jalali) dates and Persian-Indic digits; every other
 * locale gets its own calendar and digits from the same call site. Nothing else
 * may call `Intl` directly, use `toLocaleDateString()`, or interpolate a raw
 * `Date` — see CLAUDE.md.
 */

import type { CurrencyCode } from './money'

import { currencies, minorToMajor } from './money'

// Payload locale codes are short forms; Intl wants a BCP 47 tag.
const intlLocale = (locale: string) => (locale === 'fa' ? 'fa-IR' : locale)

// ponytail: one platform timezone, so a UTC timestamp near midnight doesn't
// render as the previous day. Becomes a `timezone` field on `sites` if we ever
// host a customer outside Iran.
const PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE = 'Asia/Tehran'

// Cache Intl formatters to avoid the high overhead of instantiating them on every function call.
const dateTimeFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.DateTimeFormat>()
const numberFormatCache = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>()


export const formatDate = (
  date: Date | string | number | null | undefined,
  locale: string,
  options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { dateStyle: 'long' },
): string => {
  if (date === null || date === undefined || date === '') return ''

  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options)}`
  let formatter = dateTimeFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale(locale), {
      // 'persian' *is* the Jalali calendar — Intl ships it, so no date library.
      calendar: locale === 'fa' ? 'persian' : undefined,
      timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE,
      ...options,
    })
    dateTimeFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }

  return formatter.format(new Date(date))
}

export const formatNumber = (
  value: number,
  locale: string,
  options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
): string => {
  const cacheKey = `${locale}-${JSON.stringify(options || {})}`
  let formatter = numberFormatCache.get(cacheKey)
  if (!formatter) {
    formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(intlLocale(locale), options)
    numberFormatCache.set(cacheKey, formatter)
  }
  return formatter.format(value)
}

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 *
 * Re-exported from `src/lib/digits.ts` so money parsing can share the mapping without
 * importing this module; the rule that every rendered number goes through here stands.
 */
export { toLocaleDigits } from './digits'

/**
 * A price, in the site's currency, in the active locale's digits.
 *
 * `minor` is the stored integer — see `src/lib/money.ts` for why prices are minor
 * units of the *site's* currency and not of the product. The unit word is appended
 * from the currency registry, because a bare number on an Iranian storefront is
 * ambiguous by a factor of ten.
 *
 * Renders `۱٬۲۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان` on `fa` and `1,200,000 Toman` on `en` for the same
 * stored value.
 */
export const formatPrice = (
  minor: null | number | undefined,
  code: CurrencyCode,
  locale: string,
  options: { hideUnit?: boolean } = {},
): string => {
  if (typeof minor !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(minor)) return ''

  const currency = currencies[code]
  const amount = formatNumber(minorToMajor(minor, code), locale, {
    maximumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
    minimumFractionDigits: currency.minorDigits,
  })

  if (options.hideUnit) return amount

  const unit = currency.unit[locale as 'en' | 'fa'] ?? currency.unit.en

  return `${amount} ${unit}`
}

/**
 * Digit mapping between scripts — the primitive under `formatNumber` (render) and
 * `parsePrice` (input).
 */

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'

/**
 * Digit substitution for strings that only look numeric — phone numbers, postal
 * codes, anything with a leading zero that `formatNumber` would eat.
 */
export const toLocaleDigits = (value: string, locale: string): string =>
  locale === 'fa' ? toAsciiDigits(value).replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => PERSIAN_DIGITS[Number(d)]!) : value

/**
 * Persian-Indic and Arabic-Indic digits → ASCII, for anything typed *into* the
 * platform.
 */
export const toAsciiDigits = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))

url.toString() : null\n  } catch {\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\nexport function ContactSection({ block, locale, surface }: SectionRenderProps) {\n  const strings = uiStrings(locale)\n  const address = asString(block.address)\n  const phones = asArray(block.phones).map(asString).filter((phone) => phone !== '')\n  const email = asString(block.email)\n  const hours = asString(block.hours)\n  const mapUrl = httpsUrl(block.mapUrl)\n  if (!address && phones.length === 0 && !email && !hours && !mapUrl) return null\n\n  return (\n    <SectionShell surface={surface}>\n      <SectionHeader heading={asString(block.heading)} intro={asString(block.intro)} />\n      <dl className=\"mt-8 grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4\">\n        {address ?
